frase: Third, unlike price stability, financial stability does not fall under the exclusive competence of a single institution.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Thus, in all these respects, financial stability is still not a settled field of public policy in the same way that price stability is.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: The basic Treaty provision to start from is Article 127 of the TFEU under the chapter on monetary policy, which contains the objectives and tasks of the ECB/ESCB.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: The primary objective is defined there as being the maintenance of price stability.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: First in the list is, of course, the basic task of defining and implementing the monetary policy of the Union.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: That contribution can be exercised through its monetary policy task or its supervisory task, both of which embed financial stability as a contribution to competent authorities.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Exactly how the ECB should carry out this contributory role is not specified in either the Treaty or the Statute of the ESCB – unlike monetary policy, for which the ECB’s functions and operations are set out in detail.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: In any case, the contributory role of the ECB needs to support its monetary policy tasks or the tasks conferred upon it relating to the prudential supervision of credit institutions and other financial institutions.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Monetary policy and financial stability As Article 25 of the Statute of the ESCB refers to prudential supervision, Article 127(5) is the only reference to the ECB/ESCB.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: This leads to the following considerations: First, it should be noted that the ECB, when pursuing the objective of maintaining price stability, follows a two-pillar strategy that takes account of monetary and economic analysis, and includes financial stability considerations.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: The ECB’s two-pillar strategy forms the basis for the Governing Council's overall assessment of the risks to price stability and its monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: In principle, this applies to all the basic tasks of the ECB listed in Article 127(2) of the TFEU, but it is most important for monetary policy.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Financial stability, namely the proper functioning of the financial system, is necessary for the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: In Gauweiler, the Court accepted that measures intended to preserve the monetary transmission mechanism may be regarded as pertaining to the objective of maintaining price stability, thus falling within the mandate of the ECB.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Addressing issues of financial stability in order to promote price stability is therefore possible with two caveats:

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: First, price stability enjoys primacy.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Within the current legal framework, and by contrast with other jurisdictions, price stability is the ECB’s only primary objective.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: If there is a conflict between price stability, which is primarily concerned with the business cycle, and financial stability, which is more concerned with the financial cycle, and some trade-off between the two is required, the Treaties require primacy to be given to price stability.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Financial stability cannot take precedence over price stability.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: The principle of proportionality was also used by the Court of Justice to assess the legality of the ECB’s Outright Monetary Transactions (OMT) programme as a means to achieve price stability.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: This means that ECB policies regarding financial stability that serve monetary policy need to be appropriate for maintaining price stability and should not go beyond what is necessary to achieve this objective.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: In principle, therefore, financial stability-oriented instruments can be used if necessary to carry out the basic tasks, but subject to serving the primary objective of price stability and within proportionality limitations.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: This brings me back to the first point of my speech: financial stability might be an objective less well suited to independent expertise-based bodies than a price stability objective.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Even though the Treaty does not give a definition of price stability, it is an objective that is quantifiable.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: The ECB Governing Council aims to maintain inflation rates below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Putting a figure on price stability makes monetary policy more transparent and provides a clear and measurable yardstick against which European citizens can hold the ECB accountable.

titolo: Financial stability and the ECB
frase: Beyond that, the ECB’s financial stability role is embedded within the ECB’s basic monetary policy task and the ECB’s microprudential supervisory tasks.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Forward guidance has become a valuable and effective policy instrument in central banking over recent years.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: There is by now compelling international evidence confirming that forward guidance has been successful in boosting growth and inflation outcomes by steering future interest rate expectations while central banks have been constrained in their policy space.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: More recently, some central banks, including the ECB, have also started to use forward guidance when heralding the transition out of a phase characterised predominantly by the use of non-standard monetary policy measures.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In my remarks this morning I would like to explain why the need for policymakers to enhance transparency increases at times when past policy regularities may offer less guidance, or when the inflation outlook is surrounded by exceptional uncertainty.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In these circumstances, forward guidance may not only be helpful, but also highly effective in reducing unwarranted uncertainty.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: I will show evidence that this claim holds true for the enhanced forward guidance that the ECB’s Governing Council delivered at its June monetary policy meeting.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In the future, there might be a case for the Governing Council to extend its current forward guidance beyond the timing to lift-off.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: If warranted, I will argue that this should be done by further clarifying policymakers’ reaction function rather than publishing a numerical forecast of the future path of short-term interest rates.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Forward guidance on the timing to interest rate lift-off Let me start with a simple observation.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: To fill this policy void, in July 2013 the ECB started to use state-contingent forward guidance that has contributed to reducing both interest rates, including at longer tenors, and the sensitivity of money market rates to macroeconomic and political news.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: This eased financial conditions and insulated them from external shocks that would have otherwise resulted in an unwarranted tightening.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Starting in June 2014, forward guidance has been complemented by a series of credit easing measures that have also entailed large-scale asset purchases and the adoption of negative interest rates.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Empirical evidence confirms that these measures have jointly provided substantial additional policy accommodation that has been instrumental in securing a return of inflation to levels closer to 2%.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: What my first slide also suggests, however, is that recently – judging from these simple rule prescriptions – the policy gap has vanished as the growth and inflation outlook has improved.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In other words, one may conclude from this chart that there is no longer a need for policymakers to resort to forward guidance as a means to provide the monetary stimulus that would be consistent with simple benchmark prescriptions.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: But the chart nevertheless raises the legitimate question of why the Governing Council, at its June monetary policy meeting, decided to be more explicit about its expectations for the timing to interest rate lift-off.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: After all, in the past major central banks typically did not issue any specific guidance on the timing and pace of future rate hikes.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Central banks rather signalled future policy intentions implicitly, by revealing information other than the future policy path – most notably, information about the economic outlook and the broader monetary policy strategy, including an arithmetic definition of price stability that could serve as a long-term nominal anchor for the economy.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: This approach to communication and transparency reflected the risks inherent in any type of explicit forward guidance: that such guidance could crowd out the important diversity of market views, thereby aggravating the risks of herding, and that it could potentially be taken by outsiders as an unconditional commitment.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Our experience with forward guidance has at times confirmed this risk, although its benefits have by far exceeded its costs.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Too often, academics and market participants have interpreted forward guidance as Odyssean, while for policymakers it can only be Delphic.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: The case for the ECB’s enhanced forward guidance Why then didn’t the Governing Council decide, in June 2018, to simply return to the well-tested pre-crisis framework of managing expectations when there was no longer a need to provide additional policy accommodation?

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: What you can see here is that, compared to a year earlier, uncertainty around the future path of short-term interest rates had increased measurably.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Once policy has succeeded in shifting upwards the distribution of risks around the growth and inflation outlook, uncertainty about the future path of interest rates naturally begins to increase.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: I would argue, however, that our environment is characterised by two factors that vindicate the need for stronger forward guidance and that have contributed to amplifying uncertainty around our near-term policy intentions.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: The first has to do with the peculiar anatomy of the inflation process we are currently facing.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Although uncertainty around the inflation outlook is receding and a sustained convergence of inflation to levels closer to our aim is in sight, underlying inflationary pressures have long proven stubbornly weak – to an extent that, in the past, threatened to destabilise public confidence in the return of inflation to levels closer to 2%.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In addition, there is still considerable uncertainty as to whether the key parameters underlying our workhorse Phillips curve models have undergone structural change – whether inflation has become less responsive to economic slack, be it through globalisation, technological progress or structural product and labour market reforms.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: At a time when policy rates remain deeply in negative territory, such parameter and model uncertainties imply that the costs of committing a type II error – of failing to anticipate a much slower than usual return of inflation to pre-crisis levels – may be uncomfortably high.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Communicating our expectation that the ECB key interest rates would remain at their present levels at least through the summer of 2019 was therefore consistent with the “risk management” approach to monetary policy that the Governing Council has repeatedly applied in recent years, including in our earlier decisions to clarify our reaction function or to change our policy stance pre-emptively in the face of tail risks.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: The second factor that has called for more transparency around our policy intentions relates to the effects of unconventional monetary policy measures.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Unwinding policy accommodation in a multi-dimensional policy space is terra incognita for both financial markets and policymakers.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: For this reason, the Governing Council started a long time ago to communicate its expectation that the key ECB interest rates would remain at their present levels for an extended period of time, and well past the horizon of our net asset purchases.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Yet, on my next slide you can see that, at some point in early 2018, markets expected the ECB to hike its deposit facility rate one month after the expected end of net asset purchases.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Given our previous indications, and the experience of other central banks, this was an extraordinarily early expectation, in particular as changes to our key policy rates would have affected the entire term structure of interest rates.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In other words, the slide suggests that gradual progress towards a sustained convergence in the path of inflation increasingly injected volatility into the expected future rate path.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: We therefore judged that more clarity on the timing to lift-off could help condense the focus of market uncertainty from two variables – the end-date of asset purchases and the definition of “well past” – to one variable – “at least through the summer” – which the Governing Council could more easily control with its communication.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: On my next slide you can see that our enhanced forward guidance has been effective in reducing uncertainty around the short end of the EONIA forward curve.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: A natural question to ask, then, is: should policymakers also provide guidance on the envisaged subsequent path of future short-term interest rates and, ultimately, on the expected level of the terminal rate, and if so, how?

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: The first is to publish policymakers’ projection of the future path of short-term interest rates conditional on the macroeconomic outlook.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: A number of pioneering central banks, led by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand in 1997, regularly publish numerical interest rate forecasts to reinforce their inflation targeting commitment, very much in line with modern monetary theory.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: And, in 2012, the Federal Reserve started publishing FOMC participants’ assessments of the appropriate future policy rate, in the form of the “dot plot” in the Summary of Economic Projections.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Put simply, transparency around future policy intentions is likely to be welfare enhancing if the central bank has established a convincing track record of systematically beating private sector inflation forecasts.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: But neither the private sector nor central banks have been particularly good recently at predicting inflation.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Back in 2004, Alan Blinder already pointed out that a monetary policy committee that releases dispersed views could cause a “cacophony” in communication and ultimately create more confusion than clarity.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Indeed, I believe that one reason why the ECB’s enhanced forward guidance has been so effective is precisely the fact that it represents the Governing Council’s unanimous view.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: For a large committee to agree on an entire path of future policy rates is, however, a completely different endeavour and unlikely to be possible in practice, in particular when global uncertainty severely clouds the medium-term outlook.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Second, even a credible interest rate path may cause misperceptions.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: A third source of confusion, specific to the ECB, relates to the policy rate the central bank should provide a numerical path for.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In the current environment of large excess liquidity the deposit facility rate is de facto our key policy rate.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: At longer tenors in particular, it would be difficult for markets to disentangle the fraction of the path that reflects a genuine change in policy rates from that reflecting changes in excess liquidity.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Numerical guidance on our main refinancing rate, by contrast, might be of little value to market participants at shorter horizons, unless we were to convey, in parallel, information on the expected width of the rate corridor.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In fact, one might even argue that would the Governing Council decide to publish a path for future interest rates, it would have to anticipate decisions on the ECB’s long-term operational framework, such as whether we intend to retain the pre-crisis framework of steering short-term rates within an interest rate corridor or whether we plan to adopt a floor system.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Finally, it is difficult to communicate about a concept on which the central bank itself has little or poor information, such as the “terminal rate”, or the neutral level of the policy interest rate that is expected to prevail once all shocks have dissipated.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: It is a well-known fact that estimates of the natural rate of interest, commonly referred to as r*, are highly uncertain no matter which approach is used.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: For example, the Holston-Laubach-Williams estimate of the US natural rate could currently be anywhere between -3% and +5%.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: So, all in all, a central bank needs to carefully weigh these risks against the potential benefits of publishing a numerical forecast of the future policy rate path.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: That is, rather than publishing a full numerical interest rate path, policymakers may continue to signal their inclinations by clarifying their reaction function, even in the period of instrument normalisation.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: For example, state-contingent forward guidance could clarify the pace with which policymakers expect to remove policy accommodation beyond the timing to lift-off.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Such guidance can help improve policy predictability, while avoiding the pitfalls that precise numerical guidance on the future path of short-term interest rates might entail.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: One of the benefits of this type of forward guidance is that it remains a product of the economic conditions that give rise to it – in other words, it remains Delphic, as it has always been.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Forward guidance linked to specific economic regimes – “Aesopian” forward guidance as it has recently been dubbed – has also been found to be more effective.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: This is certainly our experience with forward guidance in the current uncertain environment but it also suggests that, in the future, given the complexity of chartering a multidimensional policy space, a further clarification of our reaction function might help market participants and the broader public to better anticipate the likely future path of short-term interest rates.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Empirical evidence demonstrates that the enhanced forward guidance that the Governing Council adopted in June 2018 has been effective in reducing uncertainty around the expected future path of short-term interest rates.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: It has helped to preserve the current accommodative financial conditions on which the sustained convergence of inflation to levels that are below, but close to, 2% over the medium term is based.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: Looking ahead, should economic conditions warrant, there might be a case for the Governing Council to go beyond the timing to lift-off in further clarifying the pace at which it expects to remove policy accommodation.

titolo: Forward guidance and policy normalisation
frase: In the euro area context, I believe that the risks of publishing a precise numerical forecast of the future path of policy rates are, however, likely to outweigh the benefits.

titolo: The Benefits of European Supervision
frase: Research finds that during the sovereign debt crisis Italian banks tightened their lending and increased interest rates more than foreign banks operating in Italy.

titolo: The Benefits of European Supervision
frase: But while NPLs are washing out as the economy strengthens, supported by our accommodative monetary policy, the NPL ratios of euro area banks are still higher than those of US banks.

titolo: Economic and Monetary Union: past and present
frase: The European Stability Mechanism cannot fully fill the gap, as it typically leads to procyclical fiscal tightening.

titolo: Economic and Monetary Union: past and present
frase: There ought to be an instrument that complements monetary policy in delivering macroeconomic stability both at the euro area level and, crucially, in each of its Member States.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The underlying strength of the economy supports our confidence that the sustained convergence of inflation to our aim will proceed and will be maintained even after a gradual winding-down of our net asset purchases.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Significant monetary policy stimulus is still needed to support the further build-up of domestic price pressures and headline inflation developments over the medium term.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: At our June monetary policy meeting, we initiated a rotation of our policy instruments from our asset purchase programme (APP) towards our conventional instruments of monetary policy – the policy interest rates and forward guidance on their likely future evolution.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: First, we said that we anticipated that we would gradually wind down our net asset purchases, subject to incoming data confirming our outlook for inflation.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Our projections currently foresee that inflation will rise gradually but consistently towards levels below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Second, we updated and enhanced our forward guidance on the path for interest rates, which is now expressed in terms of the expectation that our key ECB interest rates will remain at their present levels “at least through the summer of 2019, and in any case for as long as necessary to ensure the continued sustained convergence of inflation to levels that are below, but close to, 2% over the medium term”.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Finally, we maintained our intention to reinvest principal payments from maturing securities purchased under the APP “for an extended period of time after the end of our net asset purchases, and in any case for as long as necessary to maintain favourable liquidity conditions and an ample degree of monetary accommodation”.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: At our September meeting last week, and in line with the conditional plan announced in June, we decided to reduce the monthly pace of our net asset purchases, from €30 billion to €15 billion a month, for the period from October to December.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: In addition, we reiterated the forward guidance on the path of all our monetary policy instruments, as mapped out in June.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The first is why we anticipate that it is likely to be appropriate to terminate net asset purchases by the end of December this year.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The second is why we need to maintain an ample degree of monetary accommodation.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The rotation from the asset purchase programme to rate forward guidance The ECB’s APP has been a central component of the comprehensive package of measures which the Governing Council has deployed since June 2014 to safeguard price stability.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: In addition to the APP and forward guidance on our key interest rates, a negative deposit facility rate and targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) make important contributions to monetary accommodation.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: This combination of instruments allows for complementary and mutually reinforcing interactions in providing monetary accommodation, including possibilities to compensate for one another.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: First, risk-free interest rates have been compressed at all maturities, thus reducing the basis that banks and the capital markets adopt for determining the conditions at which credit is made available to borrowers (Chart 1).

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The APP broke that vicious circle by forcing fresh liquidity into the system, as the Eurosystem started paying for the purchased securities by creating reserves and deposits.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: However, almost as soon as our net asset purchases started, bank credit to the economy began to be a source of money creation.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: More recently, as we embarked on reducing the pace of monthly purchases, we have observed a gradual shift in the growth momentum of M3 from the exogenous source of money creation through the APP to a rising contribution from endogenous deposit creation by banks due to a sustained pick-up in credit (Chart 2).

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The APP has allowed banks to rebalance their portfolios and use their renewed balance sheet capacity to extend credit to the real economy.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Since the start of the APP in 2015, the Governing Council has made net asset purchases under the APP conditional on progress towards a sustained adjustment in the path of inflation to levels below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: To measure progress towards a sustained adjustment in the path of inflation, we have applied three criteria: first, convergence of projected headline inflation to our medium-term aim; second, confidence in the realisation of this projected convergence path; and third, the resilience of inflation convergence even after the end of our net asset purchases.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: In terms of convergence, the June 2018 Eurosystem staff projections foresaw inflation at a level of 1.7% in 2018, 2019 and 2020.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Second, on confidence, the uncertainty around the inflation outlook has been receding significantly and the risk of deflation has vanished.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Inflation expectations – both survey and market-based – have been gradually improving and are increasingly consistent with our inflation aim.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The dispersion of the predictive distribution of market- and survey-based measures of inflation expectations has been compressed considerably since 2014 (Charts 4 and 5).

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Moreover, domestic cost pressures are strengthening amid high levels of capacity utilisation, tightening labour markets and rising wages.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The last criterion, resilience, has been pivotal to our decisions relating to net asset purchases.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Why did we judge inflation and the economy to have become sufficiently robust as to allow a gradual end to net purchases?

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The fundamental mechanism that has justified our outright interventions works through the market price of duration risk, which is the interest rate risk borne by price-sensitive investors in long-term bonds.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: This pushes up the long-term interest rate.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: If the central bank wants to exert downward pressure on long-term interest rates, then it can absorb extra duration risk from the market by purchasing securities with a relatively longer maturity.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: These effects are complemented by the signalling channel that asset purchases imply for the path of interest rates.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The bonds we have purchased will remain on our balance sheet for an extended period of time after the end of our net asset purchases.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The roll-over of the portfolio will also continue to preserve adequate liquidity conditions, despite the decline in the volume of banks’ excess reserves that we anticipate will follow the expiration of our outstanding TLTROs.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: You can see this in the following charts, which show the term-premium compression that our portfolio is estimated to bring about across time (Chart 6) and the estimated evolution of excess liquidity over the period stretching beyond the maturity of the TLTROs (Chart 7).

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: In June we judged that the withdrawal of duration risk was approaching levels at which, subject to underlying and external conditions evolving in line with our projections, a gradual slowing and an eventual end of net purchases would not hamper the return of inflation to our aim.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The signalling that comes together with a quantitative easing programme was reinforced in our case by the Governing Council’s decision to tie the expected path of the policy rates to the end of the net asset purchases.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: From March 2016 until June 2018, we provided guidance on the likely timing of a rate lift-off by saying that we expected the key ECB interest rates “to remain at their present levels for an extended period of time, and well past the horizon of our net asset purchases”.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Predicting at the June meeting what market participants would infer about future policy from the Governing Council’s announcements concerning its asset purchase plans – in other words, how investors would process the signalling implicit in such purchases – was particularly challenging.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Had market participants drawn wrong inferences from the anticipated end to net asset purchases regarding the Governing Council’s rate expectations, this could have implied a more rapid increase in short-term interest rates than the Governing Council judged to be consistent with continued progress towards the policy objective.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The attendant tightening in financial conditions could have driven the path of inflation convergence off course.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: To minimise this risk, we decided to re-anchor our policy interest rates through a new conditionality formulation that – by and large – mirrored the one we had used for steering securities purchase expectations right from the beginning of the APP.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Given our favourable experience with the two-leg conditionality of guidance regarding the APP, we have expressed our rate guidance as a two-pronged statement.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: There is the date-based element that interest rates are expected to remain at their present levels “at least through the summer of 2019”.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: In addition, there is a state-contingent element that rates will remain unchanged “in any case for as long as necessary to ensure the continued sustained convergence of inflation to levels that are below, but close to, 2% over the medium term”.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: As it turned out, our enhanced guidance on the rate path successfully kept the signalling channel of the APP communication under control (Chart 10).

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The latest surveys of market participants’ expectations regarding the most likely date for a lift-off indicate that the “at least through the summer” of 2019 formulation has been solidly internalised in markets’ risk-neutral expectations, although interest rate swap contracts price in the possibility that the first rate hike might be postponed somewhat beyond the summer of 2019, due to potential risks to the global economy.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: We do not see this disagreement between economists – who participate as panellists in the surveys on rate expectations – and rank-and-file traders – who make the investment decisions underpinning the interest rate swap curve – as necessarily puzzling.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: After all, our rate forward guidance has a time-based and a state-based element to it.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Accordingly, given our data-dependent approach to monetary policy, that path may change in line with the evolving investors’ assessment of the economy and the inflation outlook (Chart 11).

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: And, in the more distant future, when the associated impact on long-term rates does eventually become significant, the measured tightening in financial conditions will be justified by the advanced phase of economic expansion which the economy will be enjoying at that point in time.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: Why is an ample degree of monetary accommodation needed?

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: The ongoing economic expansion gives us confidence that inflation dynamics will strengthen in the period ahead.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: However, underlying price pressures are building up only gradually.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation
frase: So, the process of inflation convergence is expected to take time – meaning we have to be patient – and it remains contingent on a very substantial degree of monetary policy accommodation – meaning we have to be persistent in our monetary policy.

titolo: Challenges to monetary policy normalisation

titolo: Central bank independence

frase: An area that has received less attention though, both in policy and in academia, is the impact of climate change on the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and climate change

titolo: Monetary policy and climate change

frase: The prize has specifically been awarded for Benjamin’s “path-breaking contributions to incorporate consumer and firm heterogeneity into macroeconomic models and use such models to study rich interactions between inequality and the macroeconomy.” Traditionally, much of the macroeconomic research disregarded the role heterogeneity across households plays in macroeconomic outcomes, such as aggregate output or inflation.

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics
frase: These channels include the standard intertemporal substitutional channel, which has long been the sole monetary policy channel in the representative agent models often used for policy analysis.

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics
frase: The intertemporal substitution channel suggests that, following a cut in the policy rate, households increase their consumption and reduce their saving because the return on saving falls.

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics
frase: Changes in policy interest rates also affect households via an “indirect” channel, which operates as follows.

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics

titolo: Benjamin Moll’s contribution to macroeconomics

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: This phase was characterised by a deleveraging process that fed into a renewed macroeconomic downturn, producing a pernicious cycle of contracting credit growth and weak demand dynamics that required a forceful monetary policy response.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Additional accommodation was initially provided by further reductions in the key ECB interest rates – eventually to negative levels – and the introduction of forward guidance on their expected path, while targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) were conducted to support bank lending to the real economy.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Following its announcement in January 2015, our expanded asset purchase programme (APP) was recalibrated a number of times in response to changes in the inflation outlook.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: The aim of the APP was to prevent acute and persistent disinflationary pressures from destabilising medium-term inflation expectations and potentially spiralling into outright deflation.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: That intention was hard-wired in the conditionality – or, in academic parlance, the “policy rule” – that governed the forward guidance on the evolution of the APP from its inception.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: The programme was to continue at a pre-set monthly pace of purchases until the Governing Council saw inflation on a sustained adjustment path towards levels below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: We’ve come a very long way since the APP was launched.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Last December, we took a first step on the path towards “normalisation” by completing the rotation of instruments from a configuration relying on the pace and horizon of monthly bond purchases to one founded on forward guidance on our policy interest rates as the principal instrument of monetary policy.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: There is an important distinction to be made here between the normalisation of the hierarchy of policy instruments and the normalisation of the monetary policy stance – that is, the degree of monetary stimulus that we provide to the economy.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: The normalisation of instruments was implemented in such a way as to preserve the degree of accommodation necessary for continued inflation convergence even after the end of net asset purchases.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Rotation back to the “normal” instrument of monetary policy When announcing our APP in January 2015, we made clear that we intended to conduct net asset purchases until we saw inflation on a sustained adjustment path towards levels below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: While further accommodation was initially provided by additional cuts in policy rates into negative territory, the APP became the tool for adjusting the level of monetary accommodation.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: In March 2016 we adjusted our forward guidance on the key ECB interest rates to imply a sequencing between the interest rate policy and the net asset purchases, thereby exploiting the complementarities between these two key components of our monetary policy conduct.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: The APP enhanced the effectiveness of our forward guidance on policy rates via the signalling channel, underscoring our commitment to keep rates low for as long as necessary to achieve the stated objective of our policy.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: In addition, the APP gave rise to a portfolio rebalancing channel; this put downward pressure on longer-term interest rates, thereby complementing the impact of forward guidance on short to medium-term interest rates.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: The APP, as well as the TLTROs, also resulted in a liquidity creation effect.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: In conjunction with our negative interest rate policy, which increased the opportunity cost of holding reserves, the abundance of liquidity in the system reinforced the compression of longer-term interest rates.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: In assessing progress towards a sustained adjustment in inflation, the Governing Council was guided by three criteria: convergence, confidence and resilience.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: First, headline inflation needed to be on a trajectory to converge to levels below, but close to, 2% by the end of a meaningful medium-term horizon.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Second, we needed to be confident that the upward adjustment in inflation would be realised with a sufficiently high probability.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Third, the convergence of inflation towards our aim needed to be resilient to the ending of net asset purchases.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: By June last year, substantial progress had been made on the inflation front in terms of our three criteria.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Inflation was projected to be on a gradual upward path, uncertainty around the inflation outlook had narrowed sharply and the inflation trajectory was tested to be sufficiently robust to an ending of net asset purchases.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: So the time had come to bring net asset purchases gradually to an end.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: We therefore initiated a rotation away from net asset purchases and back to interest rates as the principal instrument of monetary policy by signalling our intention to end net purchases in December 2018, subject to incoming data, and by enhancing our forward guidance on the key interest rates.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: We also expressed our intention to maintain our policy of reinvesting maturing securities for an extended period of time after the end of our net asset purchases and in any case for as long as necessary.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Our net asset purchases had borne fruit, and in December 2018 we assessed that they had set inflation on a sustained adjustment path towards our aim, but that continued inflation convergence still required significant monetary policy stimulus.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: Our successive downward adjustments in the volume of monthly purchases had supported our confidence that inflation convergence would be sustained even after the end of net asset purchases, underlining the increasing role of the stock of acquired assets in determining the stance of our monetary policy.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments
frase: In the process of rotating back to forward guidance on policy rates as our main instrument, it was essential to preserve the degree of monetary accommodation required for continued inflation convergence.

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: Providing monetary policy stimulus after the normalisation of instruments

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: The monetary policy stance Against this overall background, the Governing Council took a number of monetary policy decisions at its recent meeting in Vilnius in early June.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: First, the Governing Council decided to adjust its forward guidance on the key ECB interest rates.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: There is a date-based element – that interest rates are expected to remain at their present levels “at least through the first half of 2020”.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: Shifting the date-based part of our rate guidance outwards ensures that our monetary accommodation is not weakened by premature expectations of a rate hike.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: In addition, the state-dependent element ensures that our monetary policy stance will remain accommodative for as long as necessary and will evolve gradually following incoming economic data.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: Second, we reiterated our forward guidance on reinvestment.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: We intend to continue reinvesting, in full, the principal payments from maturing securities purchased under the asset purchase programme for an extended period of time, past the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates, and in any case for as long as necessary to maintain favourable liquidity conditions and an ample degree of monetary accommodation.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: In fact, by linking the reinvestment horizon to the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates, we are reinforcing the stimulative effects of our forward guidance as market expectations for the reinvestment horizon should evolve in line with expectations for the date of rate lift-off.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: Third, we decided on the pricing modalities of the new series of quarterly targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III), which we had already announced in March.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: The aim of these operations is to offer long-term funding at attractive conditions to banks, which will help to preserve favourable bank lending conditions and support the smooth and efficient bank-based transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: At our last meeting, we decided that the interest rate in each operation will be set at a level that is 10 basis points above the average rate applied in the Eurosystem’s main refinancing operations over the life of the respective TLTRO.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: For banks whose eligible net lending exceeds a benchmark, the rate applied in TLTRO III will be lower and can be as low as the average interest rate on the deposit facility prevailing over the life of the operation plus 10 basis points.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: We also assessed the impact of negative rates on the euro area economy and concluded that, at this point in time, the positive contribution of negative rates to the accommodative monetary policy stance and to the sustained convergence of inflation is not undermined by possible side effects on bank-based intermediation.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: However, we will continue to monitor carefully the bank-based transmission of monetary policy and the case for mitigating measures.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: Overall, we are confident that the monetary policy measures will provide the monetary accommodation necessary for inflation to remain on a sustained path towards levels that are below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: Indeed, they ensure that financial conditions will remain very favourable, supporting the euro area expansion, the ongoing build-up of domestic price pressures and, thus, headline inflation developments over the medium term.

titolo: The euro area economy and our monetary policy stance
frase: The Governing Council is, therefore, determined to act in case of adverse contingencies and also stands ready to adjust all of its instruments, as appropriate, to ensure that inflation continues to move towards the Governing Council’s inflation aim in a sustained manner.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The second decade, however, has seen profound shifts in the prevailing environment – including both financial and sovereign debt crises – and our monetary policy strategy has had to adapt with it.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: I would like to discuss this morning why this evolution came about and how it was achieved – and what the past twenty years can tell us about the ECB’s monetary policy in the future.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Monetary policy before the crisis The ECB’s mandate is given by the Treaty as price stability.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In 1998, the Governing Council defined price stability as inflation within a range of 0-2% over the medium term, which constitutes the ECB’s objective.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: This was a formulation that differed from the standard inflation-targeting framework of the time, which was typically based around a point target for inflation.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In common with central banks across the world, the ECB faced a macroeconomic environment before the crisis that was predominantly defined by low volatility and moderate shocks, with the distribution of shocks to inflation almost exclusively to the upside.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In the euro area, HICP energy prices rose by 80% between January 1999 and September 2008.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Under these conditions, establishing a strong reaction function against high inflation was seen as crucial to anchor inflation expectations.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Emphasising an aim of “below, but close to, 2%” was seen to imply a stronger commitment than a standard inflation-targeting regime.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: But monetary policy in the euro area also faced a special challenge.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The ECB was a new central bank operating in a very heterogeneous monetary union, which created a particular imperative to establish inflation credibility.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Establishing a commitment to controlling inflation was seen as critical to cement lower inflation expectations across the euro area – especially as moderate inflation was a relatively new phenomenon in several Member States.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Over the two decades up to 1999, inflation had averaged above 3% in 10 of the 12 original members.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The decline in inflation in many countries in the run-up to EMU was in large part due to expectations of joining, as well as to a number of extraordinary actions taken by national authorities to meet the convergence criteria.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: From 1989-99, long-term inflation expectations had fallen from a range of between 2.5-4.5% in the four largest euro area economies to below 2% across the board.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: It was now the task of the new central bank to lock in this moderate-inflation environment – and it did so successfully.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Over the next decade, inflation expectations internalised the ECB’s commitment to keep inflation down and remained below 2%.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: But this process of building inflation credibility had implications for the ECB’s reaction function.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: As a matter of accounting, stabilising headline inflation largely caused by its volatile components must mean that core inflation adjusts downwards.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Rolling cross-correlations between energy inflation and core inflation show that an episode of high energy inflation between 1999 and 2007 was accompanied by a period of rapidly softening core inflation.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: As a result, between January 1999 and September 2008 headline inflation in the euro area averaged 2.35%, while core inflation averaged 1.7% and exceeded 2% less than 15% of the time.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: But differences in mandates – and length of track records in fighting inflation – led to differences in how much energy price pass-through to headline inflation others were comfortable accommodating.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: For example, energy prices in the US CPI rose by 160% over the same period and headline inflation averaged 2.9%.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The Federal Reserve reacted less to headline inflation, and core CPI inflation averaged 2.2%.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The upshot was that the euro area entered the crisis having succeeded in establishing its anti-inflation credentials, but with underlying inflation dynamics that were perhaps relatively weaker.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: This was not immediately apparent, as inflation stayed at fairly elevated levels for more than four years after the Lehman crash.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Monetary policy responded decisively to the global financial crisis and disinflationary threats seemed to pass quickly.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: But in hindsight it seems reasonable to conclude that the inflation process was vulnerable to a shift in the environment – which is what transpired from around mid-2012 onwards.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: New challenges for monetary policy At this point, headline inflation in the euro area began what was, in retrospect, a prolonged downward drift, and core inflation fell by almost a percentage point from mid-2012 to early 2014.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: There are two factors that help explain the switch to a disinflationary trend.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: First, the distribution of shocks to inflation moved strongly to the downside and the amplitude of the shocks increased.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: ECB analysis shows that negative demand shocks have weighed on euro-area inflation by more than 1 percentage point on average since the start of the crisis.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: While in the first phase of the crisis fiscal and monetary policy had eased in tandem – with fiscal policy loosening by a total of about 3% of potential GDP between 2008 and 2010 – thereafter the stance of monetary and fiscal policy decoupled.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The euro area fiscal stance turned contractionary in response to the sovereign debt crisis, tightening by around 4 percentage points of potential GDP until 2013 – years the euro area was mostly in recession.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In sum, the ECB faced an environment where there was both an increasing need to counter demand shocks, and an increasing burden on monetary policy to do so.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Monetary policy responded first in the summer of 2012 by acting to defuse the sovereign debt crisis, which had evolved from a tail risk for inflation into a material threat to price stability.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Announcing Outright Monetary Transactions (OMT) established our commitment to counter unwarranted redenomination risks in sovereign debt markets and acted as a powerful circuit breaker.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: While OMT was never activated, the effect of its announcement was equivalent to that of a large-scale asset purchase programme: spreads in vulnerable countries fell on average by more than 400 basis points over the next two years.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The macroeconomic impact of OMT was also analogous to other purchase programmes: ECB research finds that the GDP and price effects of OMT were broadly in line with those estimated for the QE that took place in the United States and the United Kingdom.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: But the lingering effects of the sovereign debt crisis dented the capacity of this stimulus to counter the new disinflationary trend.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The ECB therefore reacted again in 2013 by cutting its main refinancing rate twice, from 0.75% to 0.25%, and by seizing the opportunity of the launch of European banking supervision.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: But at this point, the euro area economy was hit by a further downward shock to inflation in the form of a 60% collapse in oil prices in mid-2014, which pushed inflation into negative territory.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: With underlying inflation already weakening, inflation expectations began to be affected.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: As the scope for further interest rate cuts was now limited, it became increasingly clear that our reaction function needed to evolve to address these new challenges.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Indeed, since our policy framework had never been systematically tested by persistent disinflationary risks, the ECB had not yet had a chance to demonstrate its intolerance for inflation remaining below its aim for protracted periods of time.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Unlike in other major economies, the ECB had not resorted to large-scale asset purchases during the global financial crisis and its aftermath.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Some even questioned the legality of asset purchases in Europe and their effectiveness in our bank-based economy.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: If these uncertainties were not removed, there was a material risk that falling inflation could become self-fulfilling: the public could begin expecting a smaller monetary policy response to future inflation undershoots, and revise their inflation expectations further downwards.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In other words, credibility now relied not just on perceptions of the ECB’s commitment to our aim, but also on perceptions of our capability to fight low inflation.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: While the quantitative definition of price stability was instrumental in establishing credibility in the first decade, its asymmetric formulation may have led to misperceptions in a low-inflation environment.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In addition, we clarified that symmetry meant not only that we would not accept persistently low inflation, but also that there was no cap on inflation at 2%.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: As I emphasised on a number of occasions, our medium-term orientation implies that inflation can deviate from our aim in both directions, so long as the path of inflation converges back towards that focal point over the medium-term policy horizon.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: The second part of our response was to lay out the tools we would use to counteract downside inflation risks, which began with a speech I gave in Amsterdam in April 2014 that described three contingencies and the instruments we would use to react to them.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: There was nothing institutionally or legally special about the euro area that prohibited monetary policy from adding accommodation once the lower bound was approached.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: We broke through the zero bound by lowering our deposit rate into negative territory, launched our targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) to provide incentives for banks to lend, and implemented a large-scale asset purchase programme (APP) of public and private securities.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Asset purchases in tandem compressed yields at the longer end of the curve, pushing down mortgage rates and, at the same time, making bank lending to firms more attractive in risk-adjusted terms.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: And bank-based transmission was amplified by the TLTROs, which lowered funding costs and increased competition among banks.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Over time, we also enhanced this framework with state- and date-based forward guidance, allowing us to rotate the marginal tool for determining the policy stance from asset purchases to forward guidance as the economic outlook improved.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Today, this forward guidance links our expectations on the path of future rates to the path of inflation towards our aim, leading to automatic easing if the convergence path towards 2% is delayed.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: This means that the impact of negative rates on inflation and financing conditions via the exchange rate is more powerful.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Unconventional measures proved suitable substitutes for conventional ones: using market prices to construct a so-called “shadow short rate”, the stimulus provided appears broadly in line with the recommendation of monetary policy rules as suggested by recent academic research.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: This not only affirmed that asset purchases are a legal instrument of monetary policy in the euro area, but emphasised the broad discretion of the ECB in using all our tools in a necessary and proportionate way to achieve our objective.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: However, although we have seen the successful transmission of monetary policy to financing conditions, and from financing conditions to GDP and employment, the final legs of the transmission process to wages and inflation have been slower than we expected.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Wage growth is now strengthening as slack in the labour market diminishes.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Current challenges for monetary policy In this environment, what matters is that monetary policy remains committed to its objective and does not resign itself to too-low inflation.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: And, as I emphasised at our last monetary policy meeting, we are committed, and are not resigned to having a low rate of inflation forever or even for now.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: We have described the overall orientation of our monetary policy as being “patient, persistent and prudent”.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Persistent, because monetary policy will remain sufficiently accommodative to ensure the sustained convergence of inflation to our aim.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: And prudent, because we will pay close attention to underlying inflation dynamics and to risks and will adjust policy appropriately.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: This orientation is expressed in our current policy framework, which allows us to adapt our forward guidance and react flexibly as the macroeconomic situation evolves.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: That was illustrated by the monetary policy decisions taken at our meeting earlier in June.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In the absence of improvement, such that the sustained return of inflation to our aim is threatened, additional stimulus will be required.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In our recent deliberations, the members of the Governing Council expressed their conviction in pursuing our aim of inflation close to 2% in a symmetric fashion.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: In the coming weeks, the Governing Council will deliberate how our instruments can be adapted commensurate to the severity of the risk to price stability.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: We remain able to enhance our forward guidance by adjusting its bias and its conditionality to account for variations in the adjustment path of inflation.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: This applies to all instruments of our monetary policy stance.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Further cuts in policy interest rates and mitigating measures to contain any side effects remain part of our tools.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: And the APP still has considerable headroom.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: If the crisis has shown anything, it is that we will use all the flexibility within our mandate to fulfil our mandate – and we will do so again to answer any challenges to price stability in the future.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: What matters for our policy calibration is our medium-term policy aim: an inflation rate below, but close to, 2%.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: That aim is symmetric, which means that, if we are to deliver that value of inflation in the medium term, inflation has to be above that level at some time in the future.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Over the last 10 years, the burden of macroeconomic adjustment has fallen disproportionately on monetary policy.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: If the unbalanced macroeconomic policy-mix in the euro area in part explains the slide into disinflation, so a better policy mix can help bring it to a close.

titolo: Twenty Years of the ECB’s monetary policy
frase: Monetary policy can always achieve its objective alone, but especially in Europe where public sectors are large, it can do so faster and with fewer side effects if fiscal policies are aligned with it.
