titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: And without private risk sharing, country-specific shocks will continue to cause persistent dispersion in economic outcomes across euro area countries, undermining real convergence and hampering the conduct of the single monetary policy.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: And they create more policy space in downturns, for both fiscal and monetary policy.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: The ECB is a key stakeholder in this discussion, as the transmission of our single monetary policy crucially depends on the degree of financial integration in the euro area.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: This is particularly important for the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: All this suggests that more needs to be done to further diversify external funding of euro area firms, in particular for SMEs, which are typically the first to suffer from tightening credit conditions when the tide turns and risk aversion rises.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: Benchmark rates and the need for fallback options Before concluding, let me say a word on a matter that is very much related to the resilience of European financial markets, namely the ongoing interest rate benchmark reform, where a lot of progress has been made this year.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: EURIBOR plays an important role in the transmission of the ECB’s monetary policy.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: It is closely linked to the interest rates that affect many businesses and households in the euro area.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: For this reason, it is important that the working group on euro risk-free rates continues its ongoing work on identifying fallbacks for EURIBOR, based on the ECB’s euro short-term rate (€STR) that will be published as of 2 October this year.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: As a first step, earlier this year the working group recommended a methodology for calculating forward-looking term rates based on the €STR.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: However, at the current stage, it is not certain whether and when forward-looking term rates based on €STR will become available, and for which use cases they would be suitable.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: For this fallback solution to ultimately gain ground, we need the market to start preparing for the use of €STR as soon as possible and to build up liquid derivatives markets.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: The reform of interest rate benchmarks comes at a time when more far-reaching and encompassing reforms to European capital markets are needed to promote integration, strengthen investment and boost private risk sharing.

titolo: European capital markets: priorities and challenges
frase: More integrated capital markets will support the transmission of the single monetary policy and increase its resilience in periods of stress.

titolo: Euro area banks: the profitability challenge
frase: First, the broadening economic expansion, coupled with low interest rates, has made it easier for borrowers to repay their loans, leading to better credit quality and lower bank provisions.

titolo: Euro area banks: the profitability challenge
frase: In this context, it is important to recall that the overall effect of our monetary policy on bank profitability has so far been broadly neutral.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: Looking at developments in major economies beyond the euro area, activity in the United States is supported by the strong labour market, accommodative financial conditions and current fiscal stimulus.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: At the same time, in China the slowdown in domestic demand has been cushioned by the implementation of a series of fiscal and monetary policy measures.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: Turning to inflation, headline inflation was 1.2% in June, according to Eurostat’s flash estimate, unchanged from May, which conceals lower energy prices and a recovery in services inflation, while measures of underlying inflation remained very subdued.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: On the basis of current futures prices for oil, headline inflation is likely to decline over the coming months before rebounding towards the end of the year.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: This scenario is broadly in line with the latest Eurosystem staff projections, which foresee annual headline inflation of 1.3% in 2019, rising gradually to 1.4% in 2020 and 1.6% in 2021, broadly confirming the March outlook.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: This is due to high levels of capacity utilisation and tightening labour markets, which is translating into a pick-up in wage growth.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: The monetary policy stance This led the ECB’s Governing Council, at its meeting on 6 June, to take a series of decisions in pursuit of its price stability objective.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: First, we decided to adjust our forward guidance on the key ECB interest rates.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: We now expect them to remain at their present levels at least through the first half of 2020, and in any case for as long as necessary to ensure the continued sustained convergence of inflation to levels that are below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: The decision to shift the date-based part further into the future, from “at least through the end of 2019” to “at least through the first half of 2020”, transparently conveys to the public the Governing Council’s genuine expectation that the current outlook for price stability very likely will not warrant a tightening of monetary policy at least for another year.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: Second, we confirmed the ongoing full reinvestment of the principal payments from the maturing securities purchased under the asset purchase programme for an extended period of time past the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates, and in any case for as long as necessary to maintain favourable liquidity conditions and an ample degree of monetary accommodation.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: Finally, we determined the modalities of the new series of quarterly targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III), which were announced in March.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: TLTRO III operations will start in September 2019 and end in March 2021, each with a maturity of two years.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: We decided that the interest rate in each operation will be set at a level that is 10 basis points above the average rate applied in the Eurosystem’s main refinancing operations over the life of the respective TLTRO.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: For banks whose eligible net lending exceeds a benchmark, the rate applied in TLTRO III will be lower, and can be as low as the average interest rate on the deposit facility prevailing over the life of the operation plus 10 basis points.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: The schedule defining the borrowing costs under TLTRO III is marginally less generous than that applied under the outstanding TLTRO II, in line with our intent of not discouraging banks that can afford to fund themselves in the market on attractive terms from doing so at TLTRO II maturity.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: At the same time, the pricing schedule incorporates features that can greatly enhance our accommodative monetary policy stance, as banks with strong lending performance will retain the opportunity to borrow at negative interest rates.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: The pricing remains sufficiently generous – especially when compared with alternative sources of funding – for banks to keep credit flowing to firms and households on a scale that can continue to support the economy and inflation.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: All in all, this set of decisions will provide the monetary accommodation necessary for inflation to remain on a sustained path towards levels that are below, but close to, 2% over the medium term, while also preserving favourable bank lending conditions and supporting a smooth transmission of our monetary policy.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: This being said, the Governing Council remains ready to act in case of adverse contingencies and to use its instruments – as appropriate – to ensure price stability.

titolo: Economic and monetary policy at a turning point – where is the economy heading in Europe, the United States and China?
frase: A reliable strategy is an anchor for credible monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In my contribution, I wish to share some thoughts on the conduct of monetary policy in a low-inflation environment.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: To a significant extent, this sequence of low inflation rates reflects the prolonged adjustment dynamics that characterise the aftermath of a major global financial crisis, together with a substantial downward shift in the realisation of shocks to inflation that we have observed in recent years.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: At the same time, regardless of the underlying origins of the current low inflation environment, some observers may be tempted to query whether and how central banks will meet their inflation objectives, especially under conditions in which monetary accommodation is already quite extensive.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: To address these concerns in respect of the euro area, I will demonstrate the effectiveness of the policy instruments that we have deployed to ensure that inflation climbs to meet our objective over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: As will be explained in the analysis, my assessment is that the evidence shows that our package of monetary policy measures has been an effective response to the environment that the ECB has faced in recent years.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Furthermore, the effectiveness of the policy toolkit means that we can add further monetary accommodation if it is required to deliver our objective.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Finally, especially when inflation deviates from its objective for an extended period, central banks ‒ including the ECB ‒ should adopt clear communication strategies that leave no doubt about their absolute commitment to meeting the inflation objective over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: As a summary device, Chart 1 shows some key interest rates and developments in excess liquidity in recent years.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The chart underlines the primary role of the deposit facility rate – which has been in negative territory since 2014 – in anchoring the key EONIA market interest rate in a world in which the money market operates in conditions of excess liquidity.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: From mid-2014 onwards, net liquidity provision from refinancing operations and asset purchases has markedly increased.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In part, this expansion of liquidity provision depended on banks choosing to take up funding support in refinancing operations, especially conventional longer-term refinancing operations (LTROs) and, more recently, targeted LTROs (TLTROs).

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: However, the expansion during 2014-18 was dominated by our asset purchase programme (APP).

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Excess liquidity is computed as the sum of credit institutions’ central bank liquidity holdings with the Eurosystem in their current accounts and deposit facility minus their reserve requirements.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: EONIA stands for the euro overnight unsecured interbank rate, DFR for the deposit facility rate and MLF for the marginal lending facility.Last observation: 25 June 2019.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In recent years, the ECB has deployed an innovative, multi-pronged approach in the design of its policy stance.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: While it is always possible to envisage a wider range of instruments, the current policy mix includes four elements: (i) pushing the policy rate into negative territory, (ii) forward guidance on the future policy path, (iii) the APP, and (iv) TLTROs.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Doing so shows the capacity of our policy framework to provide the monetary accommodation required to return inflation to the medium-term goal, even when the policy rate is no longer in conventional positive territory.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Negative policy rate (deposit facility rate) The 2014 decision by the ECB to push the relevant policy rate (the deposit facility rate) into negative territory was a crucial policy innovation.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Subsequent cuts have taken the deposit facility rate to its current level of minus 40 basis points.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: An important mechanism that reinforces the impact of negative interest rates relates to the way expectations about the future path of monetary policy are reflected in market interest rates.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: At any point in time, a wide range of future interest rate paths is conceivable and market participants assign probabilities to different parts of this distribution.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: A perceived binding lower bound on monetary policy rates skews the predictive distribution upward, since it truncates the distribution of conceivable future short-term rates from below: as the overnight interest rate reaches the lower bound, interest rate paths that would have embodied expectations of a further cut at a higher level of the actual overnight rate are, by definition, eliminated from the set of conceivable outcomes; conversely, rates above the lower bound receive a higher relative weight and the expected value of interest rates is mechanically pushed up.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The resultant tightening bias, in turn, can be quite costly, since it tends to arise in situations of strong and persistent disinflationary pressures and in the wake of a previous sequence of sizeable rate cuts.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: A policy of negative interest rates mitigates this tightening bias.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In particular, the observation that a central bank is prepared to take interest rates to levels below zero induces a re-evaluation of technical feasibility constraints.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Via this re-evaluation, negative rates loosen the perceived lower bound on the future distribution of short-term interest rates.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Through this mechanism, negative interest rates have a marked impact on transmission, particularly in the euro area, as they push down the short and medium segment of the risk-free curve, which for the most part is the segment of the curve that determines the pricing of loans to non-financial corporations.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: To illustrate the effectiveness of negative policy rates, ECB staff undertook a counterfactual exercise.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: They constructed the forward curve that would prevail in a scenario without either the negative interest rate policy or the forward guidance on the future path of the policy rates.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: While this mainly serves as an illustration, as it is based on a number of assumptions and input parameters, it is indicative of the sort of tighter interest rate constellations that the euro area economy would face in the absence of this important policy tool.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Our negative policy rate thus contributes substantially to providing monetary accommodation.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Accordingly, the Governing Council will continue to assess the case for mitigating measures, which is especially relevant if further rate cuts are envisaged.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Forward guidance on interest rates Our interest rate forward guidance with its state-contingent and date-based legs has become the principal tool for adjusting the monetary policy stance, especially following the end of net asset purchases.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The state-contingent leg expresses the anchor of our policy-setting expectations: policy rates will not be raised until we are sufficiently confident that inflation will reach levels that we consider most consistent with the ECB’s price stability objective.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This, in turn, allows interest rate expectations to adjust dynamically in a data-dependent manner, which results in automatic easing if the convergence path is delayed.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Through the date-based leg, the Governing Council affects interest rate expectations by expressing its views about the rate path in the near term that, given the outlook for inflation, is most conducive to reaching the objective over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This removes unnecessary uncertainty about the policy orientation over horizons that are not stretching too far into the future and prevents an unwanted weakening of the monetary policy stimulus.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The evidence shows that our enhanced forward guidance has been effective.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Since the second half of 2018, when we enhanced our forward guidance on interest rates (and especially since the monetary policy meeting of the Governing Council in March 2019), the reassessment by investors of information regarding the outlook has led them to expect a somewhat longer horizon over which rates are more likely than not to remain unchanged.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In light of this endogenous adaptability of the state-contingent leg through investor behaviour, occasional gaps may emerge vis-à-vis the date-based leg, since the latter can only be recalibrated at each Governing Council monetary policy meeting.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In March and June 2019, the Governing Council assessed that the risks to price stability warranted a recalibration of the date-based leg, thereby conveying the Governing Council’s updated assessment of the direction that the ECB’s key interest rates will have to follow.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The Governing Council now expects to keep policy rates unchanged “at least through the first half of 2020”.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Finally, the inherent flexibility in our forward guidance framework always allows for additional enhancements to ensure that inflation remains on a sustained adjustment path.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: APP The significant stock of assets purchased through the APP and the subsequent reinvestments once net purchases ended in December 2018 have been providing substantial monetary accommodation to the euro area.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: My colleague Benoît Cœuré recently provided a thorough assessment and Chart 4 and Chart 5 illustrate the contribution of the APP to the easing of financial conditions through the reduction of yields.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: According to those estimates, after the last recalibration of the APP in June 2018, the ten-year bond yield would have been around 95 basis points higher in the absence of the APP.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Asset purchases work through a variety of mechanisms.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The duration channel is complemented by the signalling channel through which asset purchases can affect the expected path of short-term policy rates.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The reinvestment horizon is linked to the forward guidance on policy rates: we now say that we will “continue reinvesting, in full, the principal payments from maturing securities purchased under the asset purchase programme for an extended period of time past the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates […]”.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This means that any recalibration of the date-based leg of forward guidance by construction extends the period over which investors expect the ECB to continue reinvesting in full; this prolongs the favourable liquidity conditions and reinforces the downward effect of our rate forward guidance on long-term rates by suppressing term premia (see Chart 5).

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: If warranted by our policy assessment, net purchases under the APP could be restarted in the future.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In the event of any resumption of net purchases, associated revisions to the framework of forward guidance would have to be considered in order to make sure that the different instruments continue to be tightly linked and that their synergies are maximised.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: TLTROs The Governing Council recently decided to start a third series of TLTROs (TLTRO III) to help preserve favourable bank lending conditions and support the smooth transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The generous borrowing conditions offered to banks should not only provide a backstop to the banking system but also lower aggregate funding costs, which contributes to the overall accommodative monetary policy stance.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The funding cost relief is direct for those banks that switch from more expensive options to TLTRO financing.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: However, there is also an indirect channel that benefits the entire banking system: while looking ahead banks will have to step up their issuance in order to satisfy regulatory requirements, the TLTRO programme will help avoid cliff effects by allowing banks drawing TLTRO funds to cancel or postpone plans to issue bonds in the market.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This reduction in the supply of securities relative to what we would see in the absence of TLTRO III creates a scarcity channel that puts further downward pressure on bank bond yields, resulting in funding cost relief across the board.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Impact of TLTRO on lending rates (upper chart) and lending volumes (lower chart)

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In fact, our experience with previous TLTROs (TLTRO I and II) was that these operations had a significant effect on funding costs, particularly in more vulnerable euro area countries.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Particularly in vulnerable countries, banks that participated in TLTROs cut their lending rates by more than their non-participating peers (see Chart 6).

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: First, the negative interest rate policy has supported the portfolio rebalancing channel of the APP by encouraging banks to lend to the broad economy instead of holding onto liquidity.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: At the same time, the extra liquidity from the APP has dampened volatility at the short end of the curve.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Second, the APP and its reinvestments have supported our enhanced forward guidance via the signalling channel.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Asset purchases provide a strong signal that policy rates will remain low for an extended period of time.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This effect is reinforced by the sequencing of our instruments, which is embedded in the structure of our forward guidance.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: At the same time, our forward guidance on rates reinforces the APP and reinvestments, since it anchors the short end of the risk-free curve and thereby ensures that the stimulus from the APP and the reinvestments is not offset.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The improved financing conditions have made a considerable contribution to the macroeconomic performance of the euro area.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: A counterfactual exercise undertaken by ECB staff shows that growth and inflation would have been notably lower in the absence of our non-standard measures (see Chart 8 and Chart 9).

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: That said, as the Governing Council has emphasised many times, in order to reap the full benefits from our monetary policy measures, it is important that other policy areas make a more decisive contribution.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: In particular, growth-enhancing and vulnerability-reducing measures would combine to improve confidence in the long-term potential of the euro area economy, which is a central factor in determining assessments of steady-state real interest rates.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Let me now turn to the importance of effective communication in maintaining focus on the inflation objective, especially during phases of extended deviations.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Central bank communication The Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union establishes price stability as the primary objective of the ECB.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The ECB strategy makes the primary objective of price stability operational through the medium-term orientation of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This medium-term orientation provides the necessary flexibility to combat excessive volatility in output and inflation in responding to shocks.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The medium term refers to a time span that is long enough to be consistent with a central bank’s capacity to control inflation, taking into account the typical transmission lag.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The horizon should be short enough for the public to be able to assess the performance of the central bank in delivering its inflation goal.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: A demand shock that pushes inflation away from its desired level and output away from potential in the same direction calls for a policy horizon as short as the typical transmission lag: the policy response to such a shock is faster and stronger than otherwise.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: By contrast, if the economy is hit by persistent supply-side shocks, for example, the medium-term interval can stretch well beyond the standard transmission lag of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Furthermore, a medium-term orientation implies that inflation can deviate from our aim in both directions, so long as the path of inflation can be expected to converge back to the objective.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Maintaining a medium-term orientation is facilitated by a credible commitment to the inflation goal, such that inflation expectations remain well anchored even during a prolonged phase of inflation deviation.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: The responses indicated that trends in inflation emerged as a substantial driving factor, and it is fair to assume that such trends build to a very large extent on historical and thereby backward-looking data on actual inflation.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: However, the ECB’s inflation objective has remained the most important factor informing the longer-term expectations of SPF participants.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: Given that trends in actual inflation have clearly weakened in recent years, the role of the inflation objective as an anchor of expectations has been brought more strongly to the fore.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: One sign of this is the looser association in recent times of longer-term inflation expectations with the average of actual inflation calculated cumulatively over the history of monetary union (Chart 10).

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: While this average ‒ and the same holds for averages taken over shorter time spans ‒ has come down over the period of low inflation, longer-term expectations have declined to a much lesser extent.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: This suggests that participants have not been overly extrapolative in forming their expectations about inflation.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: ILS stands for inflation-linked swaps, a financial asset which hedges against the risk of inflation.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation
frase: SPF (Survey of Professional Forecasters) and Consensus Economics denote the expected long-term inflation expectations (in five years and in six to ten years, respectively) as inferred from the average point estimate of both surveys.

titolo: Monetary Policy and Below-Target Inflation

frase: Compared with the June projections, the profile for headline inflation has been revised down by 0.1 percentage points in 2019 and 2021, and by 0.4 percentage points in 2020.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Although the downward revisions to headline inflation are partly due to the volatile energy component, projections for HICP inflation excluding food and energy have also been revised down on account of weaker data outturns, softer activity, indirect effects from lower energy prices and persistent past over-predictions.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This suggests that there is a substantial shared component in the decline in long-term rates that reflects a significant weight being attached to sub-par long-term outcomes for growth and inflation across advanced economies.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The downward revision in long-term yields incorporates the market’s assessment that central banks will respond (both in the near term and the long term) to adverse developments in the inflation outlook by lowering policy rates and further contributing to the easing of financial conditions through the compression of term premia (Chart 14).

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: While the lower rates that we have observed have contributed to an overall loosening of financial conditions since the start of the year, it is important to keep in mind that long-term rates that are declining due to a deterioration of the economic outlook, an adverse shift in the risk distribution or revised calculations of the equilibrium real interest rate offer only limited easing potential, especially if they are not backed up by active use of the policy toolkit.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Monetary policy At our meeting last week, the Governing Council was hence confronted with a more extended slowdown of the euro area economy than previously anticipated, persistent and salient downside risks to the growth outlook, and a further delay in the convergence of inflation towards our medium-term inflation aim (Chart 15).

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The case for a monetary policy response was clear, and a comprehensive package of measures was judged to be the most effective way to support the convergence of inflation to our aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The policy response to the continued shortfall of inflation from our aim also reflects our commitment to symmetry in the inflation aim, which we emphasised in the statement following the Governing Council’s July meeting.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This was essentially a clarification of our reaction function: our determination to act when inflation falls short of our medium-term inflation aim is just as strong as our determination to act when inflation exceeds that aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Stating clearly our commitment to symmetry is important, since the formulation of our aim – “below, but close to, 2 percent” – risks being misunderstood, particularly in an environment of falling inflation expectations.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: We also stressed in July that both realised and projected inflation have been persistently below levels that are in line with our aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This was also an important facet of our communication because the “close to” formulation of our inflation aim does not provide a precise numeric anchor for inflation expectations.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In line with our commitment to symmetry, the downward revisions to the projected inflation path warranted a vigorous policy response.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Our measures will lock in financial conditions across various segments of the market that are sufficiently supportive to foster a reacceleration of growth and the anchoring of inflation expectations.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Favourable financing conditions will pass through to the borrowing costs of businesses and households, which will sustain investment and consumption.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Greater business and household expenditure, in turn, is one key condition for inflation to converge to our aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In addition, our policies create a cushion to insulate the economy from the materialisation of downside risks by reducing uncertainty about future financing conditions and underpinning confidence.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Let me first outline our adjustments to the instruments that primarily affect the expected path of short-term interest rates and thereby the expectations component of long-term interest rates: the level of the key policy rates and forward guidance on the expected path of these rates.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: We decided to lower the interest rate on the deposit facility by 10 basis points to -0.5 percent.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In the context of ample excess liquidity, the deposit facility rate is the anchor for the EONIA market interest rate – which is the starting point of the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Lowering the deposit facility rate therefore affects the entire term structure of interest rates and, ultimately, the funding costs that matter for businesses and households.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Negative rates have supported the portfolio rebalancing channel of the asset purchase programme (APP) by encouraging banks to lend to the broad economy instead of holding onto liquidity.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The impact of the cut in the deposit facility rate on the term structure of interest rates is reinforced by our forward guidance, which now strengthens the conditionality criteria for interest rate normalisation.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: We strengthened our state-contingent forward guidance in a number of ways.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: These enhancements complement our emphasis on symmetry by clarifying our reaction function with respect to developments in the inflation outlook: the strengthened guidance provides a clear signpost for rate expectations by linking our policy to more stringent conditions for the inflation outlook.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Specifically, the guidance now gives a clearer indication of what we want to see before policy interest rates start to normalise.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: As communicated last week, we expect to keep the key ECB interest rates at present or lower levels until we have seen the inflation outlook robustly converge to a level sufficiently close to, but below, 2 percent within our projection horizon, and such convergence has been consistently reflected in underlying inflation dynamics.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: First, we want to see inflation rising to a level that is sufficiently close to, but below, 2 percent.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This reflects our communication in July: realised and projected inflation are too low relative to our aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Second, we have preserved the forward-looking formulation of our forward guidance, since the guidance has a medium-term orientation.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This reflects the general principle that monetary policy takes time to display its full effects and thus should be forward-looking.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The phrase “robustly converge” means that the Governing Council wants to be sure that the process of convergence is sufficiently mature and realistic before starting to lift policy rates.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The qualification that convergence needs to be “consistently reflected in underlying inflation dynamics” means that the trajectory of realised inflation should underpin our inflation outlook.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: State-contingent forward guidance is especially effective under conditions of elevated uncertainty since it facilitates a smooth adjustment to the evolution of macroeconomic and financial conditions in both directions: expectations about the future policy path will respond in a stabilising manner to the emergence of positive or negative news.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: We also retained the so-called easing bias by stating our expectation to keep the key ECB interest rates “at present or lower” levels.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: We judge that, if needed, we can further lower the deposit facility rate and, with it, the overnight money market rate.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Finally, we dropped the date-based leg of our forward guidance since the strengthened state-contingent information, which links our policy more tightly to the inflation outlook, provides sufficient guidance to markets on the future path of monetary policy.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: We also decided to restart net asset purchases at a monthly pace of €20 billion as from the beginning of November.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Our purchases are expected to run for as long as necessary to reinforce the accommodative impact of our policy rates, and to end shortly before we start raising the key ECB interest rates.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In addition, we reiterated our intention to continue reinvesting, in full, maturing principals for an extended period of time past the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates, and in any case for as long as necessary to maintain favourable liquidity conditions and an ample degree of monetary accommodation.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Renewed net asset purchases and the revised forward guidance on policy rates also imply an expansion of the reinvestment envelope and the automatic response of the reinvestment horizon to the evolution of the inflation outlook.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Finally, based on our projections on the size and evolution of the purchasable universe, we are confident that the envisaged purchase volumes will be consistent with the current parameters of the APP for an extended period of time.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Additional net asset purchases and, by implication, the revised reinvestment horizon reinforce the accommodative impact of our policy rates in several ways.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: First, by affecting term premia, net purchases and reinvestment complement the downward impact on long-term interest rates exerted by our policy rate forward guidance.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The APP therefore provides further support to the funding costs that matter for businesses and households.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Second, asset purchases entail a signalling channel by demonstrating our commitment to use all instruments in pursuit of our aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This not only influences the expected path of short-term policy rates, and thereby long-term interest rates, it can also have a powerful effect on the formation of inflation expectations.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Third, the APP entails wealth effects on the balance sheets of banks and other entities, providing further impetus to investment and consumption.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Fourth, new net purchases and a prolonged reinvestment horizon mitigate the passive tightening in the monetary policy stance that happens mechanically as the APP portfolio ages.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: One of the channels through which asset purchases work is the duration channel.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: By absorbing duration risk from the market, the APP reduces the risk compensation required by investors, which puts downward pressure on term premia and yields.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: As a result, the downward impact on risk premia – and thereby on long-term interest rates – resulting from the duration channel weakens over time.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Adding to the stock of asset purchases – both directly and through the reinvestment channel – will keep this portfolio ageing effect at bay (Chart 16).

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: To ensure the continued smooth transmission of our monetary policy stance, we decided to adjust the parameters of the new series of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III) and announce a two-tier system for reserve remuneration.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Both measures serve to mitigate the risk of possible side effects of the ECB’s accommodative monetary policy stance on bank-based intermediation undermining the sustained convergence of inflation.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: With respect to the TLTROs, we eliminated the 10 basis point spread over the key policy rates entailed in the initial pricing of the operations.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The interest rate in each operation will now be set at the level of the average rate applied in the main refinancing operations over the life of the respective TLTRO.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: For banks whose eligible net lending exceeds a benchmark, the rate applied in the TLTRO III operation will be lower, and can be as low as the average interest rate on the deposit facility prevailing over the life of the operation.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: These changes will not only ensure the smooth transmission of monetary policy, they will also preserve favourable bank lending conditions and support the accommodative stance of monetary policy.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In particular, extending the maturity from two to three years will better align the operations with the typical maturity of bank-based financing of investment projects, thereby enhancing the support that TLTRO III provides to the financing of the real economy.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The adjustments to the TLTRO III parameters signal that the Governing Council can act in an agile manner and fine-tune its monetary policy instruments, as needed, to ensure that they are efficient, effective and proportionate to the risks to price stability.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Complementing the TLTRO III operations, the two-tier system for reserve remuneration – which will take effect on 30 October 2019 – supports the bank-based transmission mechanism, as it will mitigate the adverse side effects of negative interest rates on banks.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: This system has been calibrated to strike a balance between, on the one hand, offsetting the direct cost of negative interest rates on bank profitability, thereby helping to sustain the pass-through of low policy rates to bank lending rates, and on the other, preserving the positive contribution of negative rates to the accommodative stance of monetary policy and the continued sustained convergence of inflation to our aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: That marginal cost will continue to be set by the rate on our deposit facility, and it will not be influenced by the higher remuneration that banks will receive on the portion of their reserves that will be exempt under the new scheme.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In any case, we will actively monitor conditions in the money market and adjust parameters as necessary to maintain an active trading environment and to ensure that the easing effects of a reduction in the overnight interest rate are transmitted effectively through the entire yield curve.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: As I previously noted, the evidence shows that our monetary policy measures have been an effective response to the environment that the ECB has faced in recent years.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The cut in the deposit facility rate lowers the anchor for the entire term structure of interest rates, while the forward guidance on interest rates steers expectations of the short-term interest rate path.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The forward guidance protects the short to medium-term segment of the yield curve from unnecessary volatility by eliminating residual uncertainty about the expected rate path over the forward guidance horizon.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: In addition, it helps to steer the long end of the yield curve by affecting the expectations component of long-term interest rates.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Renewed net asset purchases reinforce the downward pressure on long-term rates by reducing risk premia, and also complement the impact of forward guidance on the expected short-term rate path by signalling the Governing Council’s commitment to maintain a highly accommodative monetary policy stance for a prolonged period of time.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: New net asset purchases will also mitigate the mechanical upward pressure on long-term rates that ensues from the gradual ageing of our portfolio and the associated loss of duration.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Both the net asset purchase horizon and the reinvestment horizon are linked to our interest rates.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: They will therefore adjust dynamically to changes in the inflation outlook and work in the background to keep a lid on medium to long-term interest rates.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Meanwhile, the changes in the TLTRO III parameters and the two-tier system for reserve remuneration will ensure that lower market interest rates are effectively passed through to the interest rates banks charge their customers.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Concluding remarks The convergence of inflation towards the Governing Council’s aim has recently slowed and partly reversed.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The comprehensive package of measures decided last week will help to support the convergence of inflation to levels that are below, but close to, 2 percent in a sustained manner.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Our policy decisions will affect inflation by supporting favourable financing conditions, and thereby growth, as well as by underpinning inflation expectations.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: It is clear that a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy will be necessary for a prolonged period of time.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Forward guidance on the key ECB policy rates is a very powerful instrument and remains our principal tool, together with the level of our key policy rates, for adjusting the monetary policy stance.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The asset purchase programme is an important complement to our interest rate policy and will dynamically adjust in line with our policy rate forward guidance.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Backed by our assessment of the empirical evidence, we are confident that our monetary policy measures remain effective in fostering a reacceleration of growth and, thereby, inflation convergence, and we are determined to adjust all of our instruments, as appropriate, to ensure that inflation converges durably to our aim, in line with our commitment to symmetry.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: The ECB’s mandate for price stability is unconditional, and the Governing Council is unwavering in its commitment to achieve its inflation aim.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Finally, as I have outlined today, our monetary policy decisions are driven by our assessment of the macroeconomic and financial environment.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: All else being equal, the more fiscal policy contributes to boosting long-term growth potential and providing cyclical stabilisation, the quicker will be the effects of monetary policy interventions on inflation and the economy.

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: After the procyclical tightening of the aggregate fiscal stance in response to the euro area sovereign debt crisis, and a neutral stance during the economic upswing, the current mildly expansionary euro area fiscal stance is providing some support to economic activity (Charts 17 and 18).

titolo: Reflections on monetary policy
frase: Where fiscal sustainability is ensured, the potential effectiveness of countercyclical fiscal policy is reinforced in the current environment, given that fiscal multipliers are higher in a low interest rate environment.

titolo: Digital challenges to the international monetary and financial system
frase: Price stability remains, and will remain, a precondition for a currency to gain widespread use, whether digital or not.

titolo: Digital challenges to the international monetary and financial system

titolo: Digital challenges to the international monetary and financial system

frase: The “stablecoinisation” would likely start in economies with stubbornly high inflation or weak institutions – Gresham’s law in reverse.

frase: The decline in the prime legal tender would, in turn, undermine the effectiveness of monetary policy in these economies.

titolo: Digital challenges to the international monetary and financial system
frase: Global “stablecoins” would likely also increase capital flow volatility, with potential effects on exchange rates and financial conditions, and hence on domestic inflation outcomes.

frase: In my contribution, I wish to share some thoughts about the yield curve and monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The post-crisis monetary policy of the ECB shares many similarities with that of the Federal Reserve: having largely exhausted the conventional space for moving its policy instrument (the short-term policy rate), the ECB turned to a broad set of unconventional measures in pursuit of its statutory objective.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In particular, the ECB moved into negative territory with its policy rate, employed targeted refinancing operations to promote credit growth and customised its asset purchase programme (APP) to the specific context of the euro area.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In my remarks today, I will discuss our experience with the non-standard measures in our monetary toolbox and explain our monetary policy reaction function in the current below-target inflation environment.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The nature of our reaction function is spelled out in our forward guidance, which provides a unified framework across our different policy instruments – with the guidance on the rate path at its centre – and facilitates automatic adjustment in market conditions in response to shocks that are assessed as influencing the future path of interest rates.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The case for unconventional measures in a low interest rate environment Interest rates in advanced economies have been on a broad downward path for more than three decades and remain close to historical lows.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: As a result, the real neutral interest rate (r*) has declined across advanced economies.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: While the factors that have reduced r* are beyond the control of the central bank, the fact that the level of r* is lower has significant implications for monetary policy: the short-term policy interest rate hits the zero bound more often and, when it does so, remains at the lower bound for a longer time.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Lower real rates reduce the available policy space to counter low inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy toolbox The Governing Council’s monetary policy reaction function is laid out in our forward guidance on the path of our policy instruments.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Together with the forward guidance on the rate path at the centre, this provides a coherent framework for the various non-standard measures which the ECB has deployed: negative interest rates, asset purchases and targeted long-term refinancing operations (TLTROs).

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Forward guidance Initially expressed in qualitative terms, the ECB’s rate guidance has evolved over time, with the current formulation made explicitly conditional on a set of criteria regarding the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The cross-country experience with forward guidance indicates that its effectiveness can differ considerably depending on the type of conditionality attached to the policy rate path.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Conversely, the evidence indicates that rate forward guidance over long horizons, or state-based guidance, is more effective in reducing the sensitivity of asset prices to macroeconomic news.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The state-contingent formulation links the Governing Council’s expected interest rate path to at least two conditions regarding the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: First, inflation has to “robustly converge to a level sufficiently close to, but below, 2 percent within our projection horizon.” Second, this convergence needs to be “consistently reflected in underlying inflation dynamics”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The first condition is forward-looking: inflation has to be seen to be converging to a level sufficiently close to 2 percent well before the end point of the horizon: this is the meaning of “robust convergence”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The second condition is backward-looking: we have to see the robust convergence in future inflation confirmed and verified in actual measures of underlying inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Importantly, the decision we took last September has established a unified framework for our forward guidance across policy instruments that links the horizon of both our net asset purchases and reinvestments to our forward guidance on the rate path: net purchases are expected to continue until “shortly” before we start raising the key ECB rates; and reinvestments are expected to run “for an extended period of time past the date when we start raising the key ECB interest rates”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

frase: This indicates that the link between our interest rate forward guidance and the inflation threshold is understood.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: More than that, thanks to its state-contingent nature, our rate guidance provides an automatic stabilisation mechanism that steers rate expectations – and expectations about our asset purchases – as a function of the evolving inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In practice, we have seen this automatic stabilisation function of our forward guidance operate effectively, with market expectations for a first increase of the policy rate accommodating short-term volatility in the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Negative interest rates Within our forward guidance framework, the negative interest rate policy has played a key role in enhancing this automatic stabilisation by lowering the effective lower bound.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: A corollary of relaxing the lower bound constraint has been that the propagation of negative interest rates through the term structure of interest rates is qualitatively different and more powerful than traditional interest rate cuts occurring in positive territory.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The primary mechanism is the way in which expectations about the future path of monetary policy are reflected in market interest rates when the central bank reduces the overnight interest rate to very low levels.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: If the central bank reduces its policy rate to zero and makes it clear that it will not lower its policy rate any further, then this declared and self-imposed non-negativity restriction influences rate expectations among market participants: looking to the future, they will see rate increases as being more likely than rate decreases.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: As a result, the predictive density of the future rate path will tend to be skewed upward, and interest rates at longer maturities will tend to decline by less than the reduction of the policy rate.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: By contrast, under a negative interest rate policy, where future rate cuts are possible, the distribution of rate expectations is more symmetric, putting downward pressure on longer-maturity interest rates.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Rate expectations can even be skewed downwards if the negative rate policy is flanked by communication that the interest rate might be reduced further.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: In this vein, the ECB’s forward guidance has reinforced the negative interest rate policy by stating that the Governing Council expects the ECB’s key interest rates “to remain at their present or lower levels for an extended period of time”.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The implementation of the tiering policy has been smooth: on the one side, it has reduced the direct cost of negative interest rates for banks and thereby helped sustain the pass-through of low policy rates to bank lending rates, while on the other side, money market rates have continued to be well aligned with the policy rate, thereby preserving the positive contribution of negative rates to the accommodative stance of monetary policy.

frase: Finally, we are alert to the possibility that there may be a level for the policy rate below which a policy easing would have perverse effects and in fact lead to a tightening of bank credit conditions: the reversal rate.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Targeted longer-term refinancing operations TLTROs are an effective tool for providing credit easing and are particularly useful if there is a risk of the bank-based transmission mechanism becoming impaired.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: Banks can use TLTROs to refinance with the ECB over an extended horizon and at very favourable conditions, provided that they meet the lending targets set by the ECB.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

frase: TLTROs lower bank funding costs via two distinct channels – direct and indirect.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area

frase: Finally, by linking the horizon of the APP – both in terms of net purchases and the reinvestment policy – to the forward guidance on policy rates, expectations on the purchase horizon of the APP adjust in line with the inflation outlook and automatically regulate term premia.

titolo: The monetary policy toolbox: evidence from the euro area
frase: The transmission of our asset purchases in the euro area has been similar to the transmission of other central banks’ asset purchases in their respective jurisdictions, with the most pronounced effects at longer maturities.

frase: Right from the start, the ECB has monitored developments in the international role of the euro, not only in order to measure our currency’s global appeal, but also because a stronger global role for the euro may have tangible consequences for the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: Next, I will discuss monetary policy considerations associated with a stronger use of the euro internationally, before moving on to the polices that could unleash the euro’s untapped potential at global level.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: The effects of international currency status on the ECB’s monetary policy Since the launch of Economic and Monetary Union, the Eurosystem has advocated a policy of neutrality towards the international role of the euro.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: With rapid financial globalisation, rising challenges to multilateralism and the adoption of new monetary policy frameworks by major central banks, the relevance of some of the traditional effects of international currency status has declined, while other effects have become more apparent.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: For instance, international currency status strengthens the transmission of monetary policy, notably if stronger use of a currency as an international funding unit amplifies the cross-border effects of monetary policy impulses.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: Through spillback effects, the resulting impact on demand across the world may give monetary policy a wider, and possibly larger, domestic impact.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: Moreover, international currency status lowers exchange rate pass-through, which helps shield inflation from foreign shocks.

titolo: Unleashing the euro’s untapped potential at global level
frase: All in all, changes in the global role of the euro may have consequences for the conduct of monetary policy, all of which must be understood and taken into account when designing the ECB’s actions.

titolo: Never waste a crisis: COVID-19, climate change and monetary policy

titolo: Never waste a crisis: COVID-19, climate change and monetary policy

titolo: Never waste a crisis: COVID-19, climate change and monetary policy

titolo: Never waste a crisis: COVID-19, climate change and monetary policy

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In June 2014, the ECB was the first major central bank to lower one of its key interest rates into negative territory.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: As experience with negative interest rates was scant, the ECB proceeded cautiously over time, lowering the deposit facility rate (DFR) in small increments of 10 basis points, until it reached -0.5% in September 2019.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: While negative interest rates have, over time, become a standard instrument in the ECB’s toolkit, they remain controversial, both in central banking circles and academia.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In my remarks today, I will review the ECB’s experience with its negative interest rate policy (NIRP).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: I will argue that the transmission of negative rates has worked smoothly and that, in combination with other policy measures, they have been effective in stimulating the economy and raising inflation.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: On balance, the positive effects of the NIRP have exceeded their side effects, in particular when taking into account the compensating effects of other policy innovations, such as the two-tier system and our targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: At the same time, like with other unconventional policy measures, side effects are likely to increase over time, if the negative interest rate environment were to persist for too long.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Setting the scene Over the past few decades, the global macroeconomic environment has changed in ways that pose significant challenges to the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: As the global financial crisis broke and conventional policy space was exhausted, most central banks resorted to forward guidance as a means to provide additional accommodation.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In mid-2014, however, when downside risks to the inflation outlook intensified, additional accommodation was required.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Negative interest rates were a crucial part of the measures that the Governing Council adopted at the time.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: The idea was, broadly speaking, twofold: to trigger a repricing of the expected future path of short-term interest rates by “breaking through” the zero lower bound and to encourage banks to provide more credit to the economy.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Transmission of monetary policy in an environment of negative policy rates After the DFR was lowered into negative territory, the entire 3-month Euribor forward curve shifted down further and eventually traded fully in negative territory, and it even started to exhibit a slight inversion (Chart 2).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In other words, the ECB had succeeded in shifting the perceived lower bound on interest rates firmly into negative territory, supported by forward guidance that left the door open for the possibility of further rate cuts.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: This restored a fundamentally important element of monetary policy: the possibility for the market to anticipate further policy cuts and to thereby frontload policy accommodation.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: As the market started repricing the full expected future interest rate path, the effects of the cut in the DFR extended well beyond short-term rates.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: The propagation of a rate cut in negative territory was therefore materially stronger along the yield curve than for a conventional rate cut, which typically has very little impact on longer maturities.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Negative interest rates reinforced the effects of our asset purchases for the same reasons: when banks’ excess reserves are remunerated at negative rates, there is a strong incentive to reduce them by shifting into riskier assets, such as longer-dated government bonds.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: This strengthens the portfolio rebalancing channel of asset purchases.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: The analysis shows that, since the start of the NIRP regime in mid-2014, the growth of loans extended to non-financial corporations (NFCs) would have been lower in the vast majority of counterfactual scenarios of non-negative policy rates (Chart 5).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In addition, several empirical studies exploiting bank-level data confirmed the causal link between negative policy rates and loan growth.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Taken together, these findings suggest that the lowering of policy rates into negative territory fostered monetary policy transmission in the euro area, as evidenced by the strong pass-through from policy rates to market rates and higher loan growth.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Effect of negative policy rates on bank profitability and bank lending In spite of these positive effects on the effectiveness of monetary policy, the NIRP has often been criticised for its potential side effects, particularly on the banking sector.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Studies document that a surprise hike in the policy rate has a negative effect on banks’ stock prices in normal times, but a positive effect in an environment of negative policy rates, which is increasing in the dependence of banks on deposits as a source of funding (Chart 6).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In the extreme, the effect could be such that banks charge higher interest rates on their lending activities, thereby reversing the intended accommodative effect of monetary policy.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Yet, data on the volume of overnight deposits held by households in the euro area confirm the negligible pass-through of negative policy rates to banks’ retail deposit rates (Chart 7).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: There is also evidence that negative rates affect a growing proportion of the deposits held by NFCs, suggesting that the pass-through associated with negative policy rates has increased gradually over time (Chart 10).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: This is in line with empirical studies that demonstrate that the pass-through from policy rates to corporate deposit rates intensifies as rates become more negative.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: This induces firms to decrease their cash holdings through investments, thus supporting the standard monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Interest rate margins, however, are only one part of banks’ profitability.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: The second is our TLTROs through which banks can secure borrowing at highly favourable rates, provided they extend sufficient credit to the real economy.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In other words, the introduction of a “dual rate” system, where the pricing of TLTROs deviates from our key policy rate, directly lowers the funding conditions of banks and thereby compensates part of the costs that banks accrue by not being able to pass on negative rates to some of their customer base.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Effect of negative policy rates on bank risk-taking A second concern is the effect of negative policy rates on banks’ risk-taking behaviour, induced by a search for yield.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: A number of recent studies investigate the risk-taking behaviour of banks in an environment of negative policy rates.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: For example, Heider, Saidi and Schepens (2019) show that the introduction of negative policy rates by the ECB induced high-deposit banks to incur more risk by lending to borrowers with a larger return-on-assets (ROA) variation than low-deposit banks (Chart 12).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: In a similar vein, Bubeck, Maddaloni and Peydró (2019) investigate how negative policy rates affect banks’ investment choices in their securities portfolios.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: A longer-term perspective In spite of the overall positive assessment of the ECB’s experience with negative interest rates, a persistent period of negative rates may pose additional challenges.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Research based on a broad sample of pandemics by Jordà, Singh and Taylor (2020) suggests that pandemics were typically followed by a long period of depressed economic growth and a sustained drop in the real natural rate of interest (Chart 14).

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: While the ECB can mitigate potential negative effects, solutions to the underlying structural causes go beyond the remit of monetary policy.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: First, the ECB’s negative interest rate policy has been successful in turning the zero lower bound into an effective lower bound well below zero and supporting bank lending.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: This fundamentally improved monetary transmission and helped to stimulate the economy and raise inflation.

titolo: Going negative: the ECB’s experience
frase: Since negative rates largely reflect adverse macroeconomic trends outside the remit of central banks, a forceful policy response by governments to the pandemic is indispensable for raising potential growth, thereby paving the way for positive interest rates in the future.
