titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: Today, I will discuss the monetary policy measures taken by the ECB in response to the pandemic shock, take stock of the progress to date and outline the main challenges that lie ahead.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: From the outset, there were three challenges for the ECB: (i) to stabilise markets; (ii) to protect credit supply; and (iii) to neutralise the pandemic-related downside risks to the inflation path.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: Tackling the first pair of challenges is needed in order to achieve the inflation aim, since it is problematic to run an effective monetary policy under conditions of market instability or a credit crunch.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The lending performance for the temporary rate reduction of TLTROs is targeted towards the pandemic period.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The ECB reconfirmed its forward guidance on the path of policy interest rates and the asset purchase programme (APP) throughout this period.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The Governing Council expects the key ECB rates to remain at current or lower levels until the Governing Council has seen the inflation outlook robustly converge to a level that is below, but close to, 2 percent, and such convergence has been consistently reflected in underlying inflation dynamics.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The Governing Council also expects net purchases under the APP to continue at a monthly pace of €20 billion for as long as necessary to reinforce the accommodative impact of its policy rates, and to end shortly before the Governing Council starts raising the key ECB interest rates.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: In addition, the Governing Council intends to continue reinvesting, in full, the principal payments from maturing securities purchased under the APP for an extended period of time past the date when the Governing Council starts raising the key ECB interest rates, and in any case for as long as necessary to maintain favourable liquidity conditions and an ample degree of monetary accommodation.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: Our flagship policy initiative has been the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) that was announced on 18 March.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The PEPP was designed to play a dual role, both contributing to market stabilisation and enabling a substantial easing in the monetary policy stance.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The market stabilisation role of the PEPP was facilitated by its design, which allowed flexibility in the composition of purchases over time, across asset classes and among jurisdictions.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The significant drop in yields upon the announcement of the PEPP vividly illustrated the importance of central banks in underpinning market stability in the event of a large adverse shock.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: The additional asset purchases under the PEPP also serve to ease the monetary policy stance.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: In response to the substantial pandemic-related downward revision to inflation outlook in the June staff projection round, we expanded the size of the PEPP envelope by €600 billion to a total of €1,350 billion and extended the minimum expected horizon for net purchases by half a year, to at least the end of June 2021.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: In addition to stabilising markets and ensuring a sufficiently-accommodative monetary policy stance, it has also been imperative to limit the risk of a credit crunch.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: To counter this threat, we substantially eased the conditions under which banks can obtain liquidity under our targeted long-term refinancing operations (TLTROs), which strengthened the incentives for banks to continue lending to the real economy.

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB

titolo: The pandemic emergency: the three challenges for the ECB
frase: By successfully countering a tightening in financing conditions and by protecting credit supply, the measures taken in response to the pandemic have provided critical support to the outlook for the economy and inflation and have helped to limit tail risks around the baseline scenario.

frase: The ECB’s Governing Council has now decided that, from 2021, the Eurosystem will accept bonds with coupons linked to certain sustainable performance targets as collateral for credit operations and outright purchases for monetary policy purposes, provided that they comply with all other eligibility criteria.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The consensus that has governed monetary policy worldwide has been challenged on a number of fronts.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Most importantly, the last decade has been defined by a persistent decline in inflation among advanced economies.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In the euro area, annual inflation averaged 2.3% from 1999 to the eve of the great financial crisis in August 2008, but only 1.2% from then until the end of 2019.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: We need to thoroughly analyse the forces that are driving inflation dynamics today, and consider whether and how we should adjust our policy strategy in response.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In my remarks today I will cover three topics: first, the definition of our inflation objective; second, the relationship between inflation and the real economy; and third, the transmission and effectiveness of monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: I start with the inflation objective because it anchors the inflation process for the whole economy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The first is how to formulate the inflation aim.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The arguments in favour of central banks aiming for positive inflation rates with a sufficient buffer away from zero were articulated during our strategy review in 2003.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: It compensates for possible measurement bias, helps countries rebalance their economies within a monetary union and creates a buffer against deflation, as well as leading to higher nominal interest rates over the medium term.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: That helps ensure that monetary policy is not forced too often towards the effective lower bound – the level of interest rates at which further cuts do not have the desired positive impact – when faced with shocks that push inflation too low.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Since 2003, the ECB has used a double-key formulation to set our objective, defining price stability as a year-on-year increase in inflation of “below 2%”, while aiming for inflation of “below, but close to, 2%”.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This formulation was appropriate at a time when the ECB was seeking to establish credibility and too-high inflation was its main worry.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: As our research shows, it was a key factor in successfully capping inflation expectations.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: But in the current environment of lower inflation, the concerns we face are different and this needs to be reflected in our inflation aim.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Ensuring that there is sufficient space above zero to re-empower conventional monetary policy becomes more important.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: And, to underpin inflation expectations, we need to ensure that our aim is perceived to be symmetric by the public.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: So we should have an inflation aim that the public can easily understand.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The second issue is the horizon over which price stability should be achieved, which is captured by the ECB’s “medium term” orientation.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This forward-looking orientation reflects traditional and well-established principles of prudent monetary policy, which is consistent with the notion that monetary policy works with a lag and can influence inflation over the medium term rather than the near term.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: We have a hierarchical mandate with price stability at the top.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: But the medium term, which is a flexible concept, allows us to avoid unnecessarily constricting jobs and growth in the event of a supply shock which temporarily pushes up inflation and generates an economic slump.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The low inflation environment creates some new questions about how to operationalise the medium term.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: For instance, the existence of large and persistent disinflationary shocks related to, say, the ability to compare prices more actively via the internet and diversify suppliers is likely to call for more flexibility.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: But a persistent failure to meet the inflation aim can feed into inflation expectations and would call for a shorter policy horizon.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Cross-checking between the two helps determine the risks to price stability.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The monetary pillar could in principle be enhanced to provide information on financial stability which – over longer time horizons – could be relevant for the inflation outlook.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Central banks have also considered adding a backward-looking element to the policy horizon in response to the low inflation environment.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In the ECB’s case, the reference to underlying inflation dynamics in our forward guidance means that we already look at the past when deciding whether to change policy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The wider discussion today, however, is whether central banks should commit to explicitly make up for inflation misses when they have spent quite some time below their inflation goals.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: If credible, such a strategy can strengthen the capacity of monetary policy to stabilise the economy when faced with the lower bound.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This is because the promise of inflation overshooting raises inflation expectations and therefore lowers real interest rates.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The third issue is the measure of inflation that lies behind our inflation aim.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) has served us well so far and is continuously being improved.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: We need to keep track of broad concepts of inflation that capture the costs people face in their everyday lives and reflect their perceptions, including measures of owner-occupied housing.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This is not about moving the goalposts for monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: It is about future-proofing how we measure inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Likewise, to get a better sense of the evolution of the HICP over the medium term, we need to complement our analysis also by looking at more cyclical and less volatile measures of inflation, such as underlying inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The public rightly expects us to defend the purchasing power of money and that is why we target the overall HICP.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: But underlying inflation measures are more responsive to economic slack and tend to better predict inflation over the medium term.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The relationship between inflation and the real economy If the anchor for inflation is the inflation aim, the Phillips curve – the link between the real economy and inflation – plays a central role in allowing central banks to steer inflation towards that aim.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: But in the low inflation environment, prices appear to have become less responsive to the real economy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Broadly speaking, three factors might explain why inflation responded so weakly to improvements in the economy in the run-up to the pandemic.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The second possibility is that the relationship between slack and inflation was obscured by persistent structural forces.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: And the third is that the anchoring of inflation expectations might have loosened, affecting where inflation settles when both demand and supply shocks have passed and slack converges at zero.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Since it is the distance from full employment that matters in terms of moving inflation in the Phillips curve, if that distance is underestimated inflation may remain subdued even as measured slack gets smaller.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: What is striking, though, is that in the run-up to the pandemic we saw labour market slack diminishing and wages finally rising, but without inflation picking up.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In fact, ECB research finds that there was no missing wage inflation in recent years.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: For monetary policy, it matters whether firms did this because they expected slowing demand, or because they were affected by persistent structural changes that distorted historical regularities.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: How could they have weakened the link between the real economy and inflation and thereby require a revised approach to monetary policy?

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In theory, all these factors could have depressed price inflation, even as wage growth was being supported through productivity gains from technology.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Research suggests that these forces have affected inflation in the euro area in recent decades.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: A recent study finds that global factors, such as global commodity prices, global slack and producer price competition, can all significantly affect inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: ECB research also finds that digitalisation has been disinflationary in the euro area: since 2006, e-commerce has led to an average yearly decrease in non-energy industrial goods inflation of 0.06 percentage points.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: And empirical evidence suggests that a shrinking working-age population may depress inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: At the same time, structural forces need not be net deflationary, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In addition, a more active countercyclical role for fiscal policy after the pandemic may strengthen inflation dynamics.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: And we have to factor in a renewed focus on mitigating climate change, too, which could have an impact on inflation through progressive changes in the energy mix as we transition towards a carbon-neutral economy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Climate change affects all aspects of monetary policy: output and inflation, long-term interest rates and policy transmission.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In any event, structural factors can only have a lasting negative impact on inflation if they seep into inflation expectations.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This leads me to the third factor that may explain the apparent disconnect between the real economy and inflation.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Empirically, it is not straightforward to gauge the anchoring of inflation expectations.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: There can be differing interpretations depending on the approach used to define anchoring, as well as the measure and horizon of inflation expectations considered.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: That said, market-based measures of longer-term inflation expectations have fallen notably, even when adjusted for various risk premia that can distort the picture.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Since our last strategy review there has been more research on how consumers and firms form their inflation expectations.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: While data are still scarce and noisy, the general picture is that consumers hold very diverse expectations about inflation that appear far less well anchored to our aim than other measures of inflation expectations.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: In 2015 average perceived inflation among euro area households was just under 5%, while actual inflation was 0.3%.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: What emerges from the research in this area is that households take a long time to absorb new information on inflation, but when their expectations do adjust they can be hard to dislodge – and the direction in which people perceive inflation to be heading can affect their economic decisions.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This process is of course not exogenous to monetary policy: it is greatly influenced by the central bank’s objective and how policy is conducted and communicated in the pursuit of that objective.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This is why the discussion about the numerical definition of price stability and the instruments that can support it over time is so important.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: So it is crucial that we gain a much deeper understanding of their relevance and interactions in order to draw appropriate conclusions for how we conduct our monetary policy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: As part of this, we need to understand how they might have interacted with monetary policy approaching the lower bound.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This brings me to the final area I would like to discuss today: monetary policy transmission and effectiveness.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Monetary policy transmission and effectiveness As monetary policy everywhere has approached the lower bound, all major central banks have faced questions about their policy space and the traction of their tools on the economy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: A key challenge has been the long-term fall in estimates of the natural interest rate.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The natural rate is the unobservable interest rate that brings desired saving and investment into balance, or to put it another way, that brings output close to its potential.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Monetary policy is accommodative when the policy rate is below the natural rate, and restrictive when the policy rate is above it.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Estimates for the natural rate in the euro area have dropped from between 0.6% and 2.2% on average from 1999 to 2011, to between -1.3% and 0.5% thereafter.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This has required progressively lower policy rates in order to ease monetary policy – or even to prevent an unchanged policy stance from becoming more restrictive.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Before the pandemic, the ECB was able to offset the effects of a declining natural rate by taking its deposit facility rate into negative territory and by deploying forward guidance and asset purchases to ease financing conditions at longer maturities.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Indeed, asset purchases – by compressing longer-term bond yields – can induce an easing of financial conditions that can partly compensate for the diminishing scope for conventional rate cuts.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: We also launched a series of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs) to strengthen the pass-through of these measures via banks to the real economy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Considering all the measures taken since mid-2014, the overall impact on euro area real GDP growth is estimated to have been between 2.5 and 3 percentage points cumulatively until 2019, and the impact on inflation is estimated to have been between 1.7 and 2 percentage points cumulatively over the same period.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Our pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) and the new series of TLTROs have proven to be powerful tools for stabilising financing conditions and stimulating credit growth.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: According to ECB staff estimates, the measures we have taken since March this year will increase inflation by around 0.8 percentage points cumulatively between 2020 and 2022, and GDP growth by around 1.3 percentage points.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: However, we have to reflect on what will happen if natural rates remain low and inflation stays subdued – meaning central banks have to continue to resort frequently to balance sheet policies to deliver on their mandates.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: The implicit assumption since 2008 has been that policy “normalisation” will mean returning mainly to interest rate policy and winding down unconventional policies.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: We need to have a clear consensus – agreed within the Governing Council and understood by the public – on what tools are available to us when inflation is too low, and how they should be systematically deployed in response to different types of shock.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: For example, ECB research finds that without the use of large-scale asset purchases since 2015, our deposit facility rate would have had to fall to around -2% to achieve the same path of inflation we observed.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This is a level that would probably have triggered “reversal rate” dynamics, a situation where a rate cut would become contractionary because it harms the business models of financial intermediaries and disrupts monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Think, for example, of our TLTROs and our negative rate policy.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Unlike in a “reversal rate” scenario, this promotes credit creation – because banks can borrow at very low interest rates under TLTROs only on the condition that they lend on – without hurting banks’ profitability and impairing monetary transmission.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Fiscal policy empowers monetary policy by fostering demand, which brightens economic prospects for firms.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This encourages them to borrow and allows them to fully benefit from monetary policy stimulus.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: And monetary policy makes fiscal policy more effective, because when monetary policy is at the lower bound – and committed to staying there via forward guidance on rates and asset purchases – fiscal multipliers are higher.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Indeed, one explanation for the superior inflation performance of the United States relative to the euro area in recent times is that monetary and fiscal policies were more aligned.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: ECB analysis for the euro area finds that, while monetary policy was supporting inflation during this period, it was being offset by demand headwinds.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: And, in disinflationary conditions when the economy is running short of its potential, the goals of each policy are naturally aligned.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: This imperative has to cascade through all the elements of our review: our inflation aim, our inflation measure, our tools and their effectiveness, and how we take into account new challenges that people care about, like climate change or inequality.

titolo: The monetary policy strategy review: some preliminary considerations
frase: Monetary policy can only be credible if we ensure that our goals are truly understood and shared by the people we serve.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: I will provide a brief assessment of the macroeconomic outlook, discuss the ECB’s monetary policy response to the pandemic crisis and explain our current monetary policy challenge.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The pandemic shock has left its mark on inflation dynamics.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Euro area HICP inflation has been declining for several months: after turning negative to minus 0.2 percent in August, the flash estimate for September signals a further decline to minus 0.3 percent in September.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: While some temporary factors (such as the time-limited VAT cut in Germany) have contributed to this sharp decline, the drop in inflation also reflects weaker underlying pricing pressures across both the goods and services sectors.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: We expect headline inflation to remain negative for the remainder of the year, before returning to positive territory in early 2021.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The elevated level of economic slack, weak energy inflation and the recent appreciation of the euro are expected to continue to act as headwinds, such that our baseline projections expect average headline inflation only to gradually rise towards 1.0 percent in 2021 and 1.3 percent in 2022 (Chart 3).

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In parallel to the general economic outlook, there is considerable uncertainty surrounding this baseline projection, as indicated by the range of inflation outcomes that are spanned by the mild and severe scenarios for the inflation outlook in Chart 3.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: I will turn to the implications of the inflation outlook for monetary policy later in this speech.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The monetary policy response An accommodative monetary policy configuration was already in place before the pandemic: in September 2019, the main policy rate (the deposit facility rate) was lowered to minus 0.5 percent and there was a resumption of net asset purchases at a rate of €20 billion per month under our baseline asset purchase programme (APP), with these measures reinforced by forward guidance that ties future monetary policy to the inflation outlook.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In addition, credit supply was supported by the third series of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (the TLTRO III programme).

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Central elements included the escalation of asset purchases through the decision to add an extra €120 billion to the running APP and the launch of the specially-designed pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP), a revision in the structure and pricing of the TLTRO III programme, the easing of the collateral framework and a set of supervisory measures (taken by the supervisory wing of the ECB).

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The additional quantitative easing provided by the PEPP programme also eases the overall monetary stance, acting to reduce economic slack and boost inflation dynamics over the medium term.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The lending performance for the temporary rate reduction of TLTROs is targeted towards the pandemic period.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The ECB reconfirmed its forward guidance on the path of policy interest rates and the APP throughout this period.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: With the launch of the PEPP, our range of monetary policy measures currently consists of four main instruments: (a) the setting of our policy rates (with the deposit facility rate as the primary current margin); (b) the baseline asset purchase programme (APP); (c) the pandemic-specific temporary asset purchase programme (PEPP); and (d) the TLTRO III programme.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Our forward guidance about the future setting of our policy measures plays a central role in determining our overall monetary stance.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In relation to our policy rates, our current forward guidance links future rate-setting to the inflation outlook; in turn, net purchases and reinvestment under the APP are linked to the rate path.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The temporary nature of the PEPP means that the forward guidance is connected to the pandemic: net asset purchases will continue until at least the end of June 2021 and, in any case, until the Governing Council judges that the coronavirus crisis phase is over; reinvestment will be maintained until at least the end of 2022 and, in any case, the future roll-off of the PEPP portfolio will be managed to avoid interference with the appropriate monetary policy stance.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In terms of interest rate policy, the Governing Council expects to keep policy rates at their current or lower levels until we have seen the inflation outlook robustly converge to our inflation aim within our projection horizon, and such convergence has been consistently reflected in underlying inflation dynamics.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The concept of robust convergence signals that we require a high degree of confidence that the inflation outlook has durably approached the inflation aim, while the condition that convergence should also be evident in realised underlying inflation means that future rate tightening will not run ahead of the hard data in terms of the out-turns for underlying inflation.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Given this “double hurdle” set of conditions, our forward guidance represents a strong commitment to keep financial conditions at highly accommodative levels for as long as necessary to lift inflation to our inflation aim in a sustainable fashion.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In line with our forward guidance, market-based expectations of future policy rates and the future path of the APP have adjusted in response to changes to the inflation outlook.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Compared to September 2019, Chart 5 shows that the date of the policy rate lift-off implicit in the EONIA forward curve – the term structure of expectations for the overnight rate (and associated risk premia) – has shifted from December 2022 to August 2024.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Similarly, market surveys have shown a similar outward shift for the expected end date of net purchases under the APP.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Through these endogenous market responses, our forward guidance acts as an automatic stabiliser through the adjustment of monetary policy expectations – and hence the entire spectrum of monetary conditions – to changes in the inflation outlook.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The combination of our pre-pandemic and pandemic-specific monetary policy measures has successfully contributed to the stabilisation of markets and has thereby helped to ensure the smooth transmission of our monetary policy.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: As shown in Chart 6, the PEPP has also helped contain sovereign bond yields: today, the euro area GDP-weighted yield curve is back to its pre-crisis levels.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: This is central to the transmission of our monetary policy, since sovereign bond yields are the basis for funding costs for households, corporates and banks (in addition to governments).

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Credit supply has been supported by our TLTRO III operations.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The TLTROs were in high demand in June and September 2020, with a combined take-up of nearly €1.5 trillion.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Our estimates show that TLTRO III liquidity can be expected to boost loan volumes considerably, to the tune of 3 percentage points cumulatively by 2022.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In addition, the euro area bank lending survey indicates that TLTRO funding has been effective in easing the terms and conditions that banks apply in their lending.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Meeting the monetary policy challenge The pandemic represents a significant monetary policy challenge.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Weak demand and rising economic slack have added to disinflationary pressures in an environment that is already characterised by low inflation.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: As I set out in my speech at this year’s Jackson Hole conference, Chart 9 sketches in a stylised form the challenge the ECB is facing in reaching its inflation aim.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The initial negative impact of the pandemic shock – in the absence of additional monetary policy accommodation – is captured by the downward shift in the expected path from “A” to “B”.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The “BE” path (the yellow line) illustrates a transition path of inflation that is even lower than originally envisaged.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: By providing additional monetary policy accommodation, the central bank can aim towards the upper region of the “BCDE” zone, so that the adjustment is closer to the “BCD” path.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Before the onset of the pandemic (time t), inflation was expected to rise gradually towards the inflation aim (“π*”) along the “AD” path (the bold blue line).

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The initial negative impact of the pandemic shock on inflation is illustrated by the shift from “A” to “B”.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The monetary policy challenge since the onset of the pandemic crisis can be divided into two stages.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: In the first stage, the challenge for the ECB is to counter the negative inflation shock caused by the pandemic.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: One option would have been to simply accept a longer period of low inflation and an even more protracted path towards our inflation aim (as illustrated by the “BE” path in the chart).

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: It would imply higher real interest rates, thereby weakening the recovery of investment and consumption.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Second, it would also be a high-risk option: by tolerating a protracted period of even lower inflation, it might foster a downward drift in inflation expectations that could ultimately become entrenched, making it even more difficult for us to deliver our inflation aim.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: This is particularly relevant in the current euro area context, with an already long period of below-target inflation before the pandemic.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: Instead, a less costly and more prudent approach is to add sufficient extra monetary policy accommodation to boost inflation momentum towards the upper region of the “BCDE” zone, in order to reconnect to the pre-pandemic inflation path.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: The central element in this first stage has been the introduction of the PEPP and the subsequent recalibration of its size and duration, in order to provide an intense phase of extra net asset purchases.

titolo: The ECB’s monetary policy in the pandemic: meeting the challenge
frase: However, the challenge that already existed before the pandemic will also remain even after the negative pandemic shock to the inflation path is offset: the timely convergence of inflation to our aim.

frase: Instead, what I would like to offer today is a way of thinking about how the pandemic is likely to reinforce three key challenges facing central banks: how we should think about price stability when inflation is low, how monetary policy affects output and prices in the vicinity of the effective lower bound, and how we design and calibrate our instruments.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: COVID-19 and risks to price stability Let me explain each of these challenges in turn, starting with the meaning of price stability in times of low inflation.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: In 2003, when the Governing Council conducted the last review of its monetary policy strategy, it defined price stability as being consistent with consumer price inflation of “below, but close to, 2% over the medium term”.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: It agreed on this definition after a long period in which too high rather than too low inflation was the main predicament central banks were facing.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: Over the past few years, however, inflation has fallen short of our aim.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: Inflation has fallen short of target in other advanced economies too.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: Low inflation can be the outcome of favourable economic developments.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: An economy paralysed by the pandemic has pushed underlying inflation – the rate of price change of less volatile goods and services – to a new historical low of 0.2% in October (see slide 2).

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: But the pandemic is only the latest in a series of adverse disinflationary shocks that have hit advanced economies in recent years.

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: Empirical evidence, for example, points to the ongoing demographic change having a persistent disinflationary impact in the euro area and other advanced economies (see left chart slide 3).

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges
frase: The same forces that are weighing on inflation have also contributed to the decline in the real natural rate of interest – the rate that balances savings and investment without exerting pressure on prices (see right chart slide 3).

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges

titolo: COVID-19 and monetary policy: Reinforcing prevailing challenges

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: Introduction My aim in this speech today is to explain the role of monetary policy in the pandemic, with a natural focus on the ECB and the euro area., I will first review the monetary policy measures that we have taken in response to the pandemic before highlighting some of the current economic and financial challenges that confront the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: I will then explain why the current priority for monetary policy is to ensure favourable financing conditions to support the economic recovery and counteract the negative impact of the pandemic on the projected inflation path.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy measures in 2020: a recap The scale and nature of the pandemic shock called for an extraordinary policy response.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The three main tasks for the ECB since the onset of the pandemic have been: first, to stabilise markets; second, to protect credit supply; and third, to neutralise the pandemic-related downside risks to the inflation path.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: Addressing the first two challenges are high priorities, given that market instability and/or a credit crunch would undermine the running of an effective monetary policy; meeting the third challenge is central to delivering our price stability mandate.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: In terms of our monetary policy measures, the combination of the already-low levels of our main policy rates and our previously-installed forward guidance on the future path of interest rates (which links the path of our policy rates to the robust convergence of inflation to our aim) has acted as an automatic stabiliser through the adjustment of policy rate expectations – and hence the entire spectrum of monetary conditions – to pandemic-related changes in the inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: Since additional monetary policy measures were clearly necessary to meet the scale and special nature of the pandemic shock, we introduced a comprehensive package of complementary measures that acted along two main dimensions: (i) asset purchases; and (ii) liquidity operations.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: For asset purchases, an extra €120 billion was added to the ongoing asset purchase programme (APP) on 12 March and the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) was launched on 18 March; for liquidity operations, the main element was the revision of the structure and pricing of the targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III) programme.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: These flagship initiatives were accompanied by a suite of supporting measures, including the easing of the collateral framework along various dimensions., In parallel to the monetary policy measures, the European banking supervision (Single Supervisory Mechanism) and national macroprudential authorities also quickly implemented a host of countercyclical measures.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The PEPP and the easing of conditions under the TLTRO programme have been the two cornerstones of our monetary policy response: their design and calibration are directly linked to the evolution of the pandemic and its impact on the monetary transmission mechanism and the economic outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The PEPP plays a dual role of stabilising financial markets and contributing to easing the overall monetary policy stance.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The stabilisation function, which is facilitated by the ability to purchase volumes in a flexible manner over time, across asset classes and countries has been successful in addressing fragmentation risks, has provided a stabilising force for markets and has helped to reverse the tightening in financial conditions that was observed earlier in the year, as illustrated by the convergence of the euro area GDP-weighted sovereign yield curve to the overnight indexed swap (OIS) curve, which is an important indicator of the euro area risk-free term structure (Chart 1).

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: Moreover, the PEPP eases the monetary policy stance by extracting duration risk held by investors.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: By pushing down the medium-to-long end of the yield curve, the PEPP also reinforces the impact of negative interest rates and forward guidance on the path of policy rates.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: In addition, the easing of the conditions governing the TLTROs has been crucial in warding off the risks of a credit crunch.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The TLTROs incentivise banks to lend to the real economy.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: The cost of monetary policy inaction In assessing the contribution of monetary policy to countering the pandemic shock, a natural benchmark is to calculate the adverse impact that would have materialised had monetary policy not been responsive.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions
frase: To calculate the alternative path the economy would have taken in the absence of our monetary policy measures, we can construct constellations of financial conditions that would have materialised in the absence of our monetary policy actions, and then feed these counterfactual financial conditions into macroeconomic models.

titolo: Monetary policy in a pandemic: ensuring favourable financing conditions

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Favourable financing conditions as the compass The phrase “favourable financing conditions” intentionally puts the spotlight on a pivotal section of the transmission mechanism that links the basic monetary policy instruments controlled by central banks (policy rates, asset purchases and refinancing operations) to the ultimate objective of delivering the medium-term inflation aim.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Under pandemic conditions, two threats to the efficiency of monetary policy can be clearly identified.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: First, frictions in financial intermediation may disrupt the transmission of monetary policy impulses to the financing conditions for key economic actors (households, firms and governments).

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Second, in the absence of clear forward guidance from central banks in relation to future monetary policy decisions, high uncertainty about the path of the virus and the robustness of the post-pandemic recovery may make these economic actors reluctant to commit to significant spending decisions.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: In this context, a focus on preserving favourable financing conditions as the compass guiding monetary policy addresses both concerns.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: First, it emphasises that the central bank is committed to recalibrating its underlying policy instruments if it detects any threat to the favourability of financing conditions.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Second, clear communication that the financing conditions directly relevant to households, firms and governments will remain favourable during the pandemic period reduces uncertainty and bolsters confidence, thereby encouraging spending and investment, and ultimately underpinning the economic recovery and inflation.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: In terms of the price stability mandate, the pandemic shock poses ongoing risks to the projected path of inflation.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: The preservation of favourable financing conditions for an extended period of time helps to support inflation developments through multiple channels.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: First, the commitment to preserving favourable financing conditions reduces financing uncertainty for banks, corporates, households and governments alike.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Second, the assurance to maintain favourable financing conditions will help to prevent an undue tightening of financing conditions in a situation of an improving macroeconomic landscape, as markets factor in the reaction of the ECB.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Keeping favourable financing conditions in this environment could even accelerate the dynamics of the recovery, since better economic prospects combined with attractive financing conditions can fast-track consumption and investment.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Finally, an extended period of favourable financing conditions will underpin confidence in the recovery and in the eventual pick-up in inflation, which will support inflation expectations and thereby provide additional monetary stimulus through lower real rates.

titolo: The compass of monetary policy: favourable financing conditions
frase: Overall, preserving favourable financing conditions can help to counter the negative pandemic shock to the inflation path and thereby support the achievement of the price stability objective via a reduction in uncertainty and through stronger forward guidance about how the central bank might respond to a future tightening in financing conditions that is inconsistent with countering the negative pandemic shock to the projected inflation path.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament

frase: Purchases will be implemented flexibly according to market conditions and always with a view to preventing a tightening of financing conditions that is inconsistent with countering the downward impact of the pandemic on the projected path of inflation.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In addition, the flexibility of purchases over time, across asset classes and among jurisdictions will continue to support the smooth transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The TLTROs’ built-in incentive structure ensures that banks have access to ample funding at very favourable conditions if they maintain their lending to the real economy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This supports bank-based financing conditions for firms and households.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Likewise, the remaining monetary policy instruments in place – ranging from our key ECB interest rates to the Governing Council’s forward guidance and the Asset Purchase Programme – make a crucial contribution to the ample degree of monetary accommodation that is necessary to support economic activity and the robust convergence of inflation to our definition of price stability.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We will also continue to monitor developments in the exchange rate regarding their possible implications for the medium-term inflation outlook.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We stand ready to adjust all of our instruments, as appropriate, to ensure that inflation moves towards our aim in a sustained manner, in line with our commitment to symmetry.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Looking ahead, decisive action in other policy areas to support the recovery remains essential and should build on the favourable financing conditions prevailing in the euro area.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: By brightening economic prospects for firms and households, fiscal policy would also strengthen the transmission of our monetary policy measures.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament

titolo: Banking union: achievements and challenges

titolo: Banking union: achievements and challenges

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The pandemic has posed enormous challenges to monetary policy, which have varied over time.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In the euro area, we established the pandemic emergency purchase programme, the PEPP, under which we bought assets worth more than €200 billion over a period of just two months.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Concerns about the impact of the pandemic on public finances caused a wide divergence in the borrowing conditions for euro area sovereigns, impairing the transmission of our monetary policy.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The PEPP immediately instilled confidence in financial markets and succeeded in reducing fragmentation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: However, restoring financial market stability did not remove the risks to our primary mandate of price stability.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: As the rise in infection numbers in Europe began to accelerate again after the summer and the risks of a second wave materialised, the economic and inflation outlook in the euro area deteriorated notably.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Consumer price inflation was projected to reach no more than 1.4% in 2023, well short of our medium-term aim of below, but close to, 2%.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Beyond the near-term damage that the pandemic was inflicting on the economy, economic slack was expected to weigh on price pressures for a considerable period of time.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Further decisive monetary policy support was needed to offset the effect of the pandemic on the projected path of inflation, in line with our mandate.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: One was that the unprecedented fiscal and monetary policy support had succeeded in delivering highly favourable financing conditions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Real long-term expected risk-free interest rates stood at around -1.5%, close to the lowest level ever recorded in the euro area (right chart, slide 2).

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The other factor was that large uncertainty, risk aversion and wide-ranging mobility restrictions meant that a significant part of the economy was unlikely to be able, or willing, to take advantage of these financing conditions in the near term, delaying the effect of monetary accommodation on aggregate demand.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In other words, there was a substantial degree of monetary accommodation that, if preserved, could be expected to provide a measurable boost to aggregate demand and underlying price pressures.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The Governing Council responded to these conditions with a powerful commitment to preserve favourable financing conditions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: What distinguishes a policy of preserving favourable financing conditions?

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Two main characteristics distinguish this policy from the way asset purchases had been conducted before.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The first is a departure from a policy that attempts to push interest rates even lower.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The effectiveness of monetary policy is highly state-contingent.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The benefits from reducing interest rates further from very low levels may still outweigh the costs in certain circumstances.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: But when uncertainty is large and private demand constrained, monetary policy is like “pushing on a string”.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The central idea behind lowering interest rates is to provide incentives to bring forward consumption and investment.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: But when rates have been low for a long time, fewer and fewer firms and households are left to respond to an additional monetary policy impulse, in particular when investment and durable goods demand are both “lumpy” and infrequent, as a large body of evidence suggests.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: These effects may be amplified if the pass-through of market and policy rates to bank lending and deposit rates weakens or slows in the vicinity of the effective lower bound (right chart, slide 4), or if a flatter yield curve reduces banks’ incentives to undertake maturity transformation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Lowering interest rates further from very low levels may not only result in diminishing returns, it may also come with increasing costs.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Years of monetary stimulus have made asset price valuations highly sensitive to changes in interest rates.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Hence, the harder we push today, the larger the potential risks may be for price stability tomorrow.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In such circumstances, monetary policy can best support the economy by ensuring that favourable financing conditions prevail for as long as needed.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The second characteristic is the way we deliver on our commitment to preserve favourable financing conditions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: We buy more when financing conditions are becoming less favourable, and we buy less when they are stable or improving.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In other words, our pledge to preserve favourable financing conditions shifts the focus from quantities – the amount of assets we purchase – towards prices – the conditions at which sovereigns, firms and households can access credit.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: They were necessary to restore market functioning and bring about appropriately accommodative financing conditions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Today, they are a means to an end: they are used to the extent necessary to deliver on our commitment to preserve favourable financing conditions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Preserving favourable financing conditions: a reaction function How, then, can this policy be implemented in practice?

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Let me start by recalling two fundamental principles of monetary policy.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: One is that real interest rates affect consumption and investment decisions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In themselves, nominal interest rates typically have little bearing on the behaviour of firms and households.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: And since higher nominal rates can go hand-in-hand with higher growth and higher actual inflation in the future, they are not a good indicator of the degree of monetary policy accommodation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The other principle is that the favourability of financing conditions is a relative concept.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Historically low real interest rates do not necessarily imply that the degree of stimulus is historical too.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The latter crucially depends on how real interest rates compare to real equilibrium rates – that is, those rates that are consistent with a stable rate of inflation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Monetary policy is only accommodative if actual real rates fall below these equilibrium rates.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Conversely, an increase in real interest rates is not necessarily a sign that financing conditions are becoming less favourable.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Monetary policy will not tighten in this case.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: These considerations are what distinguishes a policy of preserving favourable financing conditions from yield curve control.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The latter targets a fixed level of nominal yields with a view to increasing, rather than preserving, the degree of monetary accommodation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: This would not be consistent with the considerations I outlined above: it would mean that real rates were not sufficiently accommodative to begin with, and that lower real rates come at no cost.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: To see this more clearly, it is useful to look at current estimates of the real interest rate gap.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Until a few years ago, policymakers mostly focused on the real short-term interest rate gap.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: But this exclusive focus is no longer appropriate in a world where central banks increasingly try to influence long-term interest rates through forward guidance and asset purchases.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The real long-term interest rate gap has become equally important over time.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Monetary policy has thus managed to remain highly accommodative despite the steady decline in equilibrium rates over time (right chart, slide 6).

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: A policy that commits to preserving such a degree of accommodation provides measurable support to aggregate demand and hence underlying price pressure.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: There are, however, instances where rising rates would unduly tighten our policy stance.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: For example, a rise in the real term premium – that is, the compensation that investors demand for risks related to the future path of real short-term interest rates – could signal growing uncertainty around the monetary policy outlook or indigestion of duration supply.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: These types of movement, if sizeable and persistent, make financing conditions less favourable as they are not accompanied by a corresponding increase in real equilibrium rates.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: This channel seems to have played less of a role in recent weeks (right panel, slide 7) but we are conscious of the fact that it may well affect financing conditions in the current environment.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: This could put unwarranted upward pressure on the real term premium over the period of net asset purchases (right chart, slide 8).

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: A firm commitment to favourable financing conditions therefore requires a certain minimum purchase volume to offset this effect on real interest rates.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Preserving favourable financing conditions therefore puts the drivers of changes in financing conditions, and their speed of adjustment, into the focus of our assessment.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In this assessment, cross-asset price correlations can help identify and interpret potential changes in real interest rates.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: For example, if stock markets increase and credit spreads tighten in response to a rise in real interest rates, markets are likely to price in a stronger growth outlook that could leave financing conditions favourable.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In addition, changes in market-based financing conditions have to be assessed jointly with the likely future trajectory of the economy, in particular the inflation outlook.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Assessing recent market developments Between the December decision and our most recent Governing Council monetary policy meeting on 11 March, we saw a rapid increase in global and euro area nominal interest rates.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: How should these changes in financing conditions be assessed?

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The factors that have caused a rise in risk-free interest rates have been largely benign in the euro area.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: At the time of our meeting, nominal ten-year overnight index swap (OIS) rates were up by about 30 basis points, entirely reflecting a rise in the inflation component (left chart, slide 9).

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: These movements should not be seen as reflecting a genuine reappraisal of the expected future path of inflation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Term structure models suggest that much of the recent rise in nominal ten-year OIS rates reflects an increase in term premia which, in turn, likely reflects a rise in the inflation risk premium (right chart, slide 9).

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: In other words, markets have started to revise the balance of risks around the medium-term inflation outlook.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: After a long period in which inflation persistently and repeatedly surprised to the downside, markets no longer exclude the risk that inflation may rise more strongly than previously expected.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Before the pandemic, profit margins were a key contributor to weak inflation by absorbing cost-push pressures.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: The stability of real interest rates is likely to have reflected a combination of two factors.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: First, the PEPP’s calendar-based forward guidance, promising net asset purchases until at least March 2022, has allayed fears of early tapering in the euro area, keeping the real term premium anchored at very low levels, supported by our continued net asset purchases.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: This interpretation is consistent with the picture painted by the latest ECB staff macroeconomic projections, which foresee an economic and inflation outlook that is largely unchanged from the December 2020 projections.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Against this backdrop, the Governing Council announced that we would significantly step up purchases under the PEPP in the second quarter, in line with market conditions.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Preserving favourable financing conditions is a powerful policy response to the challenges we are currently facing.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: It is a strong commitment to protect an exceptional degree of policy accommodation for as long as needed.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: It signals our unwavering determination to offset the impact of the pandemic on the projected inflation path.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: We will continue to deploy this envelope resolutely and efficiently, guided by our commitment to price stability.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: If favourable financing conditions can be maintained with asset purchase flows that do not exhaust the envelope over the net purchase horizon of the PEPP, the envelope need not be used in full.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: Equally, the envelope can be recalibrated if required to maintain favourable financing conditions to help counter the negative pandemic shock to the path of inflation.

titolo: Paving the path to recovery by preserving favourable financing conditions
frase: We will flexibly adjust our purchases over time and across asset classes and jurisdictions in a way that ensures favourable financing conditions for the entire economy and paves the path to recovery.

titolo: Stabilising the economic outlook
frase: To counter these risk factors, it is essential that the ECB acts as a stabilising force and boost confidence by committing to the preservation of favourable financing conditions.

titolo: Stabilising the economic outlook
frase: In addition, these monetary policy measures have been reinforced by the countercyclical measures taken by the supervisory arm of the ECB.

titolo: Stabilising the economic outlook
frase: Complementing our accommodative monetary policy, it is essential that fiscal policy counters the pandemic shock to incomes and the productive capacity of firms, ensures that overall demand conditions promote a timely recovery and underpins medium-term growth prospects through growth-enhancing public investment.

titolo: Stabilising the economic outlook
frase: The macroeconomic role for fiscal policy is especially predominant under current conditions: fiscal multipliers are higher in a low interest rate environment, while the asymmetric sectoral impact of social restriction measures can only be addressed through fiscal measures.
