titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Last week the Governing Council of the European Central Bank (ECB) published its new monetary policy strategy.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: These changes reflect three broad macroeconomic trends – digitalisation, globalisation and demographic change – that have had, and continue to have, profound consequences for the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Amplified by the two deepest economic contractions since World War II – the global financial crisis and the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic – they shifted the challenge for monetary policy from fighting too high inflation towards preventing too low inflation, or even deflation, a phenomenon our previous strategy had not envisaged.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In many advanced economies, this challenge was aggravated by central banks approaching the lower bound of policy rates, which severely constrained the space of “conventional” monetary policy to protect price stability.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In the euro area, the ECB’s deposit facility rate reached 0% in July 2012 and has been negative since June 2014.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In my remarks today, I would like to set out our motivation for the most important changes to our strategy, and explain how they will guide the ECB’s monetary policy decisions in the years to come.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Understanding low inflation The ECB’s monetary policy strategy of 2003 was challenged by severe economic and financial crises, as well as deep structural changes in the economy, in particular during the most recent decade.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: One was a gradual and persistent decline in the “real equilibrium” interest rate that balances savings and investments (slide 2).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Slow-moving structural factors, such as an ageing society and lower trend productivity growth, have led to an abundant supply of savings facing a muted investment demand, putting downward pressure on interest rates, not only in the euro area but across many advanced economies.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Available estimates of this “equilibrium” rate of interest suggest that, for the euro area, stable inflation is nowadays likely to require a negative real short-term interest rate.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The second, and equally widespread, development was a protracted period of disinflation.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Despite years of unprecedented monetary policy accommodation, inflation in the euro area, as measured by the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP), has averaged just 1.2% since the global financial crisis (slide 3), well below the aim adopted by the Governing Council in 2003, namely an inflation rate of below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In combination, these two developments posed severe challenges for monetary policy, because the zero lower bound on interest rates constrained the available policy space to respond to persistent disinflationary shocks.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: As a result, central banks worldwide have been forced to find additional instruments that could provide policy accommodation when their main policy rates were approaching zero.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The ECB, for its part, has introduced a wide range of such novel monetary policy tools in recent years, including negative interest rates, forward guidance, longer-term refinancing operations and asset purchases.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Nevertheless, the euro area economy remained caught in the low interest rate, low inflation environment.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In our strategy review, we identified the elements that could break the vicious circle of low inflation and low interest rates by shedding light on the factors explaining why inflation has not accelerated more forcefully in response to the far-reaching measures we took over the years.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Our findings can be summarised in three blocks that have motivated the main adjustments to our strategic framework: first, the definition of price stability, including the scope of the relevant price index; second, the conduct of monetary policy in the vicinity of the effective lower bound, including the toolkit, our reaction function and the broader macroeconomic policy mix; and, third, a more active incorporation of major preconditions for price stability, namely financial stability and the transition to a low-carbon economy.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Defining price stability According to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU), the ECB’s primary objective is to maintain price stability.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Including owner-occupied housing in the HICP The ECB has confirmed the use of the HICP as a timely, reliable, comparable (over time and across countries) and credible inflation measure.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: A key requirement for monetary policy is that the underlying consumption basket be representative of people’s actual consumption behaviour.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Although HICP inflation has been subdued in recent years, the costs of housing, which are not fully reflected in the HICP, have increased more forcefully.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In our review, the Governing Council, while praising the quality improvements to the HICP seen over time, recognised shortcomings in the current way of measuring consumer price inflation and decided to recommend a roadmap to include owner-occupied housing in the HICP.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The augmented HICP will not only better represent actual consumption expenditures by households, it will also better reflect the transmission of our monetary policy.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In particular, while changes in house prices often reflect a wide range of factors, including supply and demand imbalances, monetary policy, through its impact on mortgage rates and risk taking, can also be expected to affect the costs related to residential investment.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Substantial additional work by the European Statistical System, which will stretch over several years, is required before the HICP including owner-occupied housing can become the main index for monetary policy purposes at a monthly frequency.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Until then, we will use gradually improving quarterly owner-occupied housing indices to assess the impact of housing costs on inflation and thus inform our monetary policy deliberations.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: A symmetric 2% inflation target The previous quantitative definition of our inflation aim of “below, but close to, 2%” was subject to ambiguity as some observers considered it to be asymmetric, potentially implying that 2% was a ceiling rather than a target.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Staff analysis suggests that such perceptions could, over time, give rise to meaningfully lower inflation and growth outcomes (left chart, slide 5).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: While our analysis suggests that low inflation has, to a large extent, resulted from an unfavourable, one-sided distribution of shocks (as explained below), we judged that there was a risk that our previous inflation aim might further entrench expectations of low inflation (right chart, slide 5).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: We have therefore replaced our previous aim with a clear 2% inflation target over the medium term, with deviations to the downside and to the upside being considered equally undesirable.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The simplification and clarification of the target, as well as our stronger commitment to symmetry, are crucial to remove any ambiguities and firmly anchor long-term inflation expectations at 2%.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Medium-term orientation and proportionality The Governing Council confirmed the medium-term orientation of its monetary policy, recognising the difficulty to control inflation in the short run, given the variable and uncertain transmission lags of our measures to the real economy and inflation.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The medium-term orientation also allows the ECB to take account of financial stability considerations in view of the interdependence of price stability and financial stability.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: This assessment comprises a systematic analysis of the evolving balance of the benefits and costs of our actions, taking account of their effectiveness and side effects, as well as risks of a destabilisation of inflation expectations.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: ECB staff analysis suggests that, at the lower bound, there is a risk that the marginal benefit of an additional unit of policy accommodation may diminish, not only in the euro area but across advanced economies (left chart, slide 6).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The impact of monetary policy is also likely to be state contingent, with policy most effective in deep recessions (right chart, slide 6).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: For example, the exclusion of household mortgages from the loans eligible under the targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO) aims to avoid fuelling house prices.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Similarly, the two-tier system of reserves helps to protect the bank lending channel by mitigating the impact of negative interest rates on banks’ profitability.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Monetary policy at the effective lower bound The second block of our strategy offers solutions to overcome the challenges of protecting price stability in the vicinity of the lower bound.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Our review revealed that the presence of the effective lower bound gives rise to three broad requirements for effective macroeconomic stabilisation: an expanded monetary policy toolkit, a changed reaction function and a different macroeconomic policy mix.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Our review suggests that these additional measures have been effective in stimulating growth and inflation despite a persistent lack of underlying price pressure.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: There is compelling empirical evidence that negative interest rates, forward guidance, longer-term refinancing operations and asset purchases have contributed, individually and collectively, to easing the relevant financing conditions for firms and households loosening the constraints on monetary policy imposed by the lower bound on conventional interest rate policies.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: For example, since the ECB brought its deposit facility rate into negative territory in 2014, the euro area GDP-weighted sovereign yield curve, which is a good summary indicator of the stance, has shifted measurably lower, and has flattened considerably (left chart, slide 7).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Our review has also shown that there is no compelling evidence suggesting that inflation has systematically become less responsive to economic activity.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: While the euro area Phillips curve is relatively flat, staff analysis shows that its slope has not – in a statistically relevant way – become flatter over time and that economic slack and inflation co-move as expected by economic theory (left chart, slide 8).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Instead, Phillips curve models point to other factors – likely related to structural trends like digitalisation, globalisation and demographic change – putting persistent downward pressure on underlying inflation in recent years, even as slack receded (right chart, slide 8).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Because central banks have a limited ability to lower rates deep into negative territory, disinflationary shocks close to the lower bound risk not being fully offset, thereby potentially becoming a more persistent drag on growth, prices and wages over time.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In view of these risks, the Governing Council clarified in its strategy statement that when the economy is close to the lower bound, monetary policy needs to respond especially forcefully or persistently to avoid negative deviations from the inflation target becoming entrenched in expectations.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: We also clarified that this may imply a transitory period in which inflation is moderately above 2%.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In practice, inflation overshoots may be the result of the Governing Council exercising patience in adjusting its policy stance when faced with an improving outlook.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: A long period of low price pressures, and years of repeated overprediction of the future path of inflation, require that higher inflation prospects need to be visibly reflected in actual underlying inflation dynamics before they warrant a more fundamental reassessment of the medium-term inflation outlook.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: An appropriate policy mix at the lower bound The third implication of the lower bound is that – in a world where the observed decline in real interest rates limits the extent to which central banks can stabilise the economy in the wake of demand-side shocks – fiscal and monetary policy need to complement each other.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The past decade suggests that the failure of inflation to accelerate more forcefully in the euro area is also the result of inadequate support from fiscal policy.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: A public sector that is largely insensitive to interest rate changes significantly reduces the effectiveness of monetary policy, in particular in the euro area where governments account for nearly half of total spending.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The policy response to the pandemic is a remarkable showcase for the power of monetary and fiscal policy interaction to boost confidence, stabilise aggregate demand and avoid a persistent destabilisation of medium to long-term inflation expectations.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Preconditions for price stability The third building block of our new strategy recognises that some areas merit particular attention in the pursuit of price stability over the medium term.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: One is financial stability, which can pose severe risks to price stability, as shown vividly by the global financial crisis.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Another is climate change, which is increasingly threatening price stability through both physical and transition risks.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Specifically, in addition to our economic analysis, our price stability assessment and proportionality analysis will now be based on a revised monetary and financial analysis that recognises that financial stability is a precondition for price stability (slide 10), and that macroprudential policies do not yet offer effective protection.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: The focus of this analysis will be on the monetary policy transmission mechanism, in particular via the bank lending, risk-taking and asset pricing channels, and will systematically evaluate the longer-term build-up of financial vulnerabilities and imbalances and their possible implications for future tail risks to output and inflation.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Assigning a more prominent role to financial stability does not mean that the Governing Council will conduct policies of “leaning against the wind”, whereby monetary policy is systematically tightened when systemic risk builds up, or of “cleaning”, whereby monetary policy is systematically loosened when systemic risk materialises.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Climate change and price stability While the revised monetary and financial analysis will give more room for financial stability considerations, the enhanced economic analysis will give greater prominence to structural trends and their implications for inflation, potential output and the equilibrium real rate of interest (slide 10).

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In our strategy review, we analysed in depth the profound implications of physical and transition risks from climate change for both price and financial stability, as well as for the transmission of monetary policy and the value and the risk profile of the assets held on the Eurosystem’s balance sheet.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: We have therefore committed to an ambitious climate-related action plan that will be consistent with our price stability objective and guided by market efficiency considerations.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Second, we will adapt the design of our monetary policy operational framework.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: For example, we will introduce disclosure requirements for private sector assets as a new eligibility criterion, or as a basis for a differentiated treatment, for collateral and asset purchases.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: We have taken stock of how the ongoing secular changes in our economies and societies affect the conduct of monetary policy and our ability to protect price stability in the euro area in such circumstances.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Many elements of our monetary policy strategy have been vindicated by the events of the past two decades.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Our shock-based medium-term orientation, for example, has avoided unnecessary volatility in economic activity at times of rising inflation and supported incomes and wages in the face of disinflationary shocks.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: To avoid that low inflation becomes entrenched in expectations and activity, we have changed our definition of price stability to a clear and symmetric 2% target in the medium term.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: We have also clarified that, when our policy rates are close to the lower bound, we intend to react especially forcefully or persistently to disinflationary shocks.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: This may also imply a transitory period in which inflation is moderately above target.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Our revised framework explicitly takes into account the potential risks that a prolonged period at, or close to, the lower bound may entail for financial stability and other considerations relevant for medium-term price stability.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Finally, in recognition of the exceptional risks that climate change poses to welfare, growth and price stability, and with a view to accelerating the transition to a more sustainable economy, we have committed to a comprehensive climate-related action plan that will culminate in broad changes to our monetary policy implementation framework.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: In a rapidly changing world, and given the potentially significant structural changes that the end of the pandemic may unleash, we intend to assess periodically the appropriateness of our monetary policy strategy, with the next assessment expected in 2025.

titolo: A new strategy for a changing world
frase: Since the owner-occupied housing price index measured with the net acquisition approach includes an element of investment, the ECB supports further research projects on optimal measurement methods, aiming at better isolating the consumption component from the investment component, with the former being the relevant one for monetary policy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Introduction The financial system plays a central role in transmitting monetary policy to the real economy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Whenever a central bank adjusts its policy instruments, it relies on private financial intermediaries to translate the monetary impulse into the financing conditions for firms and households.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: For central banks, it is therefore crucial to understand whether and how these developments matter for the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: I will argue that the rise in non-bank finance is likely to have broadened monetary policy transmission, while it has also created new risks for the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Specifically, for the euro area as a whole, the increase in non-bank finance seems to have strengthened the impulse of policy measures that work primarily via longer-term interest rates, in particular central bank asset purchases.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Therefore, with the overwhelming majority of euro area firms still relying on bank loans as their prime source of credit, the key ECB interest rates remain the main tool to steer economic conditions in the euro area as the bank lending channel continues to act as the central element of the monetary policy transmission process.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: At the same time, the increase in non-bank finance has created new hazards for monetary policy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Increased risk-taking, in turn, can give rise to liquidity mismatches and affect the capacity of non-bank financial entities to absorb losses in a downturn, thus potentially creating systemic risk and impairing the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: To preserve financial stability and protect policy transmission, the current regulatory landscape needs to better reflect the fact that credit intermediation increasingly takes place outside the banking sector.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Broadening monetary policy transmission through non-banks From the ECB’s perspective, it is crucial to understand the impact of the rise and heterogeneity of non-bank finance on the implementation and effectiveness of our single monetary policy, and hence on the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: These differences in balance sheet composition, in turn, may translate into heterogeneous responses to different types of monetary policy measures.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: For instance, asset purchases tend to exert stronger effects on duration and credit risk premia, whereas policy rate changes have a more direct impact on shorter-term loan market conditions, although they also affect longer-term rates through adjustments in the expected future path of short-term interest rates.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: The analysis is based on a standard empirical framework used to study the transmission of monetary policy, augmented by data on the balance sheet size of banks and investment funds.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: The analysis distinguishes between two types of monetary policy shocks.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: The first is a short-term interest rate shock, which would arise primarily in the context of the ECB adjusting its main policy rates.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: The second is a longer-term interest rate shock, which would occur in response to the use of other monetary policy measures, such as central bank asset purchases.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: The exercise highlights differential impacts of policy easing shocks across different types of financial intermediaries, as measured by changes in the size of balance sheets (see Chart 2, right-hand panel).

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: The assets of both banks and investment funds expand in response to an accommodative short-rate shock.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: These findings confirm that the key ECB interest rates remain a powerful policy instrument also in a world in which market-based finance has expanded measurably.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: For example, earlier findings in the literature suggest that asset purchases incentivise banks to extend credit to the real economy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: By reducing the return of risk-free assets, asset purchases may make lending to firms more attractive for banks.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: At any rate, these results provide a tentative indication that the rise in non-bank finance has effectively broadened the transmission of monetary policy in the euro area by reinforcing the impulse coming from measures that act directly on the long-term interest rate.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: This is encouraging news in an environment in which the risk of hitting the zero lower bound, and hence the need to activate asset purchases, has increased.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: What matters most for monetary policy is the impact on the later stages of the transmission process, namely on the economic behaviour of the private sector.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: A first important aspect to consider is whether monetary policy triggers different adjustments in the credit conditions prevailing in corporate bond and loan markets.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: In particular, standard monetary policy shocks running through changes in short-term rates have a stronger impact on the rates charged for bank loans than for corporate bonds.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: This has important implications for the link between monetary policy and the financing structure of an economy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: It follows, then, that the overall cost of credit is more responsive to conventional monetary policy measures in these economies than in economies with a higher share of bond finance.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: Conversely, when considering shocks to longer-term interest rates, the pattern reverses.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: For the euro area, these findings reinforce the evidence found for the earlier stages of transmission, namely that the key ECB interest rates remain the most important instrument not only for the balance sheet response of financial intermediaries but also for steering the overall path of our economy.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission
frase: At the same time, it is likely that recent changes in the euro area’s financing structure have strengthened the impact of our asset purchases on real economic activity.

titolo: The rise of non-bank finance and its implications for monetary policy transmission

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Asset purchases have become an important tool for central banks worldwide to secure price stability in the vicinity of the zero lower bound.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The experience over the past decade has yielded many insights into how precisely asset purchases affect financial and economic conditions, the latest example being the response to the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: There is by now broad consensus that asset purchases can support economic growth and inflation in three main ways: first, through the market stabilisation channel, by which asset purchases provide liquidity when there are deep dislocations in financial markets; second, through the portfolio rebalancing channel, by which asset purchases reduce the aggregate amount of duration risk to be held by price-sensitive investors, inducing a shift into other, riskier assets in the economy and thereby supporting their value; and, third, through the signalling channel, by which asset purchases signal the intention of central banks to keep policy rates lower for longer.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: I will argue that the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) prevented the collapse of the financial system when the pandemic shock hit our economies and the outlook was at its darkest.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: I will then show that, once market functioning had recovered and the repercussions of the pandemic for the medium-term inflation outlook became clearer, the portfolio rebalancing channel became the PEPP’s main transmission channel.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Sizeable duration extraction has been the main factor supporting the economy and the inflation outlook during this phase.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: And, finally, I will explain how the signalling channel is becoming more important as our measures succeed in dispelling tail risks and lifting the expected future path of inflation.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: It reinforces our new forward guidance and reduces uncertainty about the future path of short-term interest rates.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Stabilising markets through asset purchases Just before the Governing Council launched the PEPP in March 2020, financial markets had frozen under the weight of rising uncertainty (Slide 2).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In such periods of acute financial market stress, asset purchases are a powerful instrument to protect monetary policy transmission.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Asset purchases can fill the void and allow the market to return to the good equilibrium.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The signal that asset purchases may send about the future path of policy rates is largely irrelevant when markets are not functioning well.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In the first two weeks of the PEPP, the Eurosystem purchased assets worth more than €50 billion.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: By the end of June 2020, the asset purchases amounted to more than €350 billion – representing an enormous pace of absorption.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: ECB staff analysis confirms that asset purchases are particularly effective in periods of market stress.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The evidence around the PEPP announcement suggests that the normalised impact of a €500 billion purchase envelope is likely to be noticeably higher than under our regular asset purchase programme (APP) (Slide 3, left-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Market segmentation in periods of stress implies that asset purchases mostly operate locally, with limited spillovers to non-targeted segments.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The PEPP’s flexibility over time, across asset classes and among jurisdictions explicitly catered for the possibility of such targeted purchases.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: At the height of the market turmoil when fragmentation risks threatened to impair monetary policy transmission, there were substantial deviations from the ECB’s capital key, which guides the allocation of our public sector purchases across euro area countries (Slide 4, right-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Over most of the PEPP’s lifetime, purchases have been conducted according to the capital key.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Indicators of financial stress dropped quickly as the PEPP instilled confidence, restored orderly liquidity conditions, and stopped and then reverted destabilising price spirals and fire sales.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In short, the launch of the PEPP prevented the collapse of the financial system.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Protecting the monetary policy stance through duration extraction As the dust of the initial shock settled, the purpose of the PEPP shifted from market stabilisation to ensuring an appropriate monetary policy stance.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In June 2020, our staff projections suggested that inflation would be well below our target in the medium term, and noticeably below the pre-pandemic level.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: At that point, portfolio rebalancing became the main transmission channel of our asset purchases.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Although we could afford to reduce our monthly emergency interventions over the second half of 2020 by 45% compared with their peak in light of calmer financial markets, exceptionally large public and private duration supply in response to the pandemic was a recurring source of upward pressure on bond yields that would not have been consistent with our commitment to counter the effect of the pandemic on the inflation trajectory.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Duration extraction offset this effect, and engineered a decline in the so-called “bond free float” – the share of bonds held by price-sensitive investors –, thereby keeping yields at levels consistent with countering the downward impact of the pandemic on the projected path of inflation (Slide 5, right-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In these circumstances, the signalling effects of asset purchases continue to be relatively small because the market expects inflation to remain below target for a considerable period of time anyway.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In the euro area, these rebalancing effects are amplified by the interactions of asset purchases with other policy instruments.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Negative interest rates, for example, further incentivise investors to purchase longer-term assets in a bid to avoid being “taxed” by the negative rate.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Empirical evidence shows that this “hot potato effect” also extends to bank loans, thereby reinforcing the effects of our targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In other words, it de facto counteracts the efforts by governments to lock in current low interest rates with a view to reducing their exposures to potentially higher interest rates in the future.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: So far during the pandemic, the Eurosystem has bought assets worth more than €1.3 trillion, or nearly 12% of last year’s euro area GDP, under the PEPP alone.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Together with the purchases under the APP, we currently hold around €4.4 trillion worth of securities on our balance sheet (Slide 6, left-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Even in three to five years’ time, our joint PSPP and PEPP holdings can be expected to put sizeable downward pressure on interest rates across the maturity spectrum (Slide 6, right-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: These effects do not imply, however, that asset purchases no longer play a role once economic conditions and the inflation outlook improve and the need for portfolio rebalancing diminishes.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In fact, in these circumstances the signalling channel of asset purchases often gains importance.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Asset purchases as a commitment device Let me explain why.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Past experience suggests that when projected inflation gradually approaches the target, uncertainty about the future path of interest rates increases.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Forward guidance on interest rates can substantially reduce this uncertainty.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: It can stabilise long-term interest rates by enhancing clarity on the conditions that must be met for policy rates to increase.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: First, inflation needs to reach 2% well ahead of the end of our projection horizon.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Second, inflation needs to stay there durably for the rest of the projection horizon.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: And third, realised progress in underlying inflation needs to be sufficiently advanced to be consistent with inflation stabilising at 2% over the medium term.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The relationship between expected inflation and expected future interest rates has changed in the pandemic: today, markets expect less monetary policy tightening for each incremental improvement in the medium-term inflation outlook.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The sensitivity of rate expectations to changes in the inflation outlook has remained the same even as the balance of risks around the inflation outlook priced in by investors has noticeably shifted to the upside.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Option prices, for example, currently suggest that the market attaches a probability of nearly 40% to inflation exceeding, on average, our 2% target over the next five years (Slide 8, left-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Such market behaviour is consistent with our pledge to act more patiently – that we want to see clearer signs that inflation is reliably moving towards our 2% target.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Our September staff projections suggest that, while the outlook is gradually improving, inflation is still expected to be below our 2% target in the medium term (Slide 8, right-hand chart).

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: As such, our new forward guidance has significantly enhanced clarity around our reaction function and has thereby helped anchor long-term rates at current low levels by reducing the uncertainty around the future course of monetary policy.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In the early stages of a recovery, however, forward guidance cannot fully substitute for asset purchases.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Therefore, forward guidance and asset purchases should be thought of as both substitutes and complements.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: They are substitutes in the sense that the main instrument to stabilise long-term yields at levels consistent with the inflation outlook gradually shifts from asset purchases to forward guidance, or from a compression of the term premium to managing the expected future path of short-term interest rates.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: They are complements in the sense that asset purchases can reinforce forward guidance.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: They can serve as a powerful commitment device to lend additional credibility to a central bank’s forward guidance by signalling that, in all likelihood, the conditions for raising policy rates are not expected to materialise any time soon.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: One reason is that investors typically do not expect a central bank to raise policy rates abruptly when it is still conducting net asset purchases.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Thereby, asset purchases raise the bar for lifting policy rates, helping to raise inflation expectations at the zero lower bound.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In doing so, they support the central bank’s pledge not to raise rates and therefore strengthen their commitment through forward guidance, which hence becomes more “Odyssean” – like Odysseus who tied himself to the mast of his ship.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: This means that, as the inflation outlook brightens, it becomes less important how much a central bank buys or when a reduction in the pace of net asset purchases starts, but rather when such purchases end.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: It is the end date which signals that the conditions for an increase in policy rates are getting closer.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: In my remarks today I have taken stock of the changing role of asset purchases as we gradually transition from a period of crisis into the recovery phase.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: The pandemic has shown that asset purchases are an indispensable monetary policy instrument during times of market stress and economic downturns, when the room for interest rate cuts has largely been exhausted.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: After having calmed financial markets, our asset purchases have helped to bolster confidence and shore up the economy and the inflation outlook.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: As economic conditions begin to normalise and the inflation outlook improves, there is a gradual shift in the way asset purchases benefit the economy as the portfolio rebalancing channel makes way for the signalling channel.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Asset purchases can increasingly serve as a powerful commitment device, reinforcing forward guidance and reducing uncertainty around the future course of monetary policy.

titolo: Asset purchases: from crisis to recovery
frase: Given the remaining uncertainty regarding the pandemic and the economic and inflation outlook, our asset purchases – both under the PEPP and the APP – will remain crucial in the time to come, paving the way out of the pandemic and towards reaching our inflation target.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: The ECB had just been founded, and the Governing Council had adopted the institution’s first monetary policy strategy.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: Or ‒ to be more specific ‒ in monetary policy, banking supervision, our non-monetary policy-related balance sheet management and in all our operational duties.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: Acknowledging the climate-related and environmental risks for our own balance sheet, in February 2021 the Eurosystem – encompassing the ECB and all the national central banks of the euro area – announced a common stance for applying climate change-related sustainable and responsible investment principles in their asset portfolios not related to monetary policy.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: Finally, in July 2021 the Governing Council of the ECB concluded the 18-month process – delayed by around six months because of the pandemic – in which it reviewed its monetary policy strategy.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: The outcome of the strategy review included an action plan to incorporate systematically environmental sustainability considerations in the ECB’s monetary policy.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: The Governing Council acknowledged that climate change has profound implications for its mandate to maintain price stability in the euro area through its impact on the economy and the financial system.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: In addition to the comprehensive incorporation of climate factors in its monetary policy assessments, the ECB will adapt the design of its monetary policy operational framework in relation to disclosures, risk assessment, corporate sector asset purchases and the collateral framework.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: As a concrete follow-up, the ECB will accelerate its work on new models that enable us to analyse and monitor the implications of climate change and transition policies on the economy, the financial system and the transmission of our monetary policy to households and firms.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: With regard to our monetary policy instruments, we will introduce disclosure requirements as an eligibility criterion or as a basis for differentiated treatment for collateral and asset purchases.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: Ultimately, where two different monetary policy instruments are equally conducive to maintaining price stability, the ECB will set out to choose the option that best supports addressing climate change.

titolo: Integrating the climate and environmental challenge into the missions of central banks and supervisors
frase: Connected dots enabling connected action The conclusion of the strategy review marks the ECB connecting the final, crucial dots to confirm its commitment to incorporating systematically and consistently the climate and environmental crisis in carrying out its tasks and fulfilling its responsibilities: monetary policy, banking supervision, our non-monetary policy-related balance sheet management and in all our operational duties.

titolo: Structural change and central banking: some research priorities
frase: For central banks, it is essential to monitor these underlying structural changes and assess the implications for economic growth and inflation dynamics along both cyclical and trend dimensions.

titolo: Structural change and central banking: some research priorities
frase: The direct and indirect effects of digitalisation and the carbon transition on the financial system and the drivers of the equilibrium real interest rate also warrant intensive study, especially in view of the possible implications for the monetary transmission mechanism.

titolo: Structural change and central banking: some research priorities
frase: From a central banking perspective, the uncertainties associated with structural change reinforce the value of a stability-oriented approach to the conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Structural change and central banking: some research priorities
frase: In particular, a clear anchor for monetary policy allows households, firms and governments to concentrate on the many challenges associated with digitalisation and the carbon transition, secure in the knowledge that monetary policy will be guided by a clear and predictable framework that, in the case of the ECB, is oriented towards stabilising inflation at two percent over the medium term.

titolo: Structural change and central banking: some research priorities
frase: Although the precise design and calibration of our policy instruments will surely be influenced by these structural forces in the coming years, the policy goal will remain the same: protecting price stability by focusing on the symmetric two percent inflation target.

titolo: Structural change and central banking: some research priorities
frase: In turn, our recent comprehensive strategy review has given us very strong foundations for ensuring that the conduct of monetary policy will take into account the economic, monetary and financial implications of digitalisation and the carbon transition.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In my confirmatory hearing before this Committee back in September 2019, I set out a goal: to ensure that the ECB engaged in a reflection on whether its monetary policy framework was sufficiently robust to meet future challenges.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The review took the ECB’s mandate and primary objective of price stability, which is conferred by the Treaty, as a given.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We have recommended a roadmap to include the costs of owner-occupied housing in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices to better represent the inflation rate that is relevant for households.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We have also developed a climate-related action plan to address the profound implications of climate change for price stability.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In my remarks today, I will outline some of the key elements of our new strategy and provide an update on the outlook for the economy and for inflation, together with some reflections on our current monetary policy stance.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The ECB’s new monetary policy strategy in practice Starting with our price stability objective, the new strategy incorporates two key innovations.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: First, we have adopted what I would call a simple and clear symmetric inflation target of two per cent over the medium term.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: It is simple, easy to communicate and clear because it gives a well-defined yardstick to help us steer our monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: And it is symmetric because both negative and positive deviations of inflation from the target are equally undesirable.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We are convinced that this new formulation will avoid misperceptions about our reaction function when medium-term inflation is above or below the target and that it will better anchor inflation expectations.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The second important change is the recognition that, to maintain symmetry, the Governing Council needs to take into account the implications of the effective lower bound on nominal interest rates.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In proximity to the lower bound, an especially forceful or persistent monetary policy response will be required.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In July we also revised our forward guidance on interest rates to bring it into line with the new strategic framework.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The new formulation stipulates that the Governing Council will not consider raising rates unless three conditions have been met: first, we need to see inflation reaching two per cent well ahead of the end of the projection horizon; second, after convergence, inflation should be seen to be stabilising durably at the target through the end of the projection horizon; and third, realised progress in underlying inflation should, in our judgement, be sufficiently advanced to be consistent with inflation stabilising at two per cent over the medium term.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Achieving these conditions may imply a transitory period in which inflation is moderately above our target.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Turning to inflation developments, which you have selected as a topic for this hearing, euro area inflation rose to 3.0 per cent in August and we expect it to rise further this autumn.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: A range of factors are currently pushing up inflation.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Although underlying price pressures have edged up over the summer, this is consistent with the opening up of the economy, which remains some distance away from operating at full capacity.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: As a result, the September ECB staff projections foresee annual inflation at 2.2 per cent in 2021 then moderating to 1.7 per cent in 2022 and 1.5 per cent in 2023.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: While inflation could prove weaker than foreseen if economic activity were to be affected by a renewed tightening of restrictions, there are some factors that could lead to stronger price pressures than are currently expected.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Persistently high inflation could also result in higher than anticipated wage demands.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: But we are seeing limited signs of this risk so far, which means that our baseline scenario continues to foresee inflation remaining below our target over the medium term.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Favourable financing conditions are essential for the economy to continue its recovery and for inflation to converge durably to our target.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We saw market interest rates ease over the summer but recently they have reversed this decline somewhat.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: However, bank lending conditions have remained very accommodative.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Overall, this has left financing conditions for the economy remaining very favourable.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Thus, following a joint assessment of the inflation outlook and financing conditions, the Governing Council decided earlier this month to set a moderately slower pace of net asset purchases under the pandemic emergency purchase programme.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We remain entirely committed to preserving these favourable financing conditions, which are necessary for a robust recovery that will restore inflation to its pre-pandemic level.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Financial stability considerations in our new monetary policy strategy I will now turn to the second topic which you have selected for this hearing, namely the risk of financial dominance.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Financial dominance occurs when central banks delay the removal of monetary policy accommodation for longer than appropriate, in order to avoid market turmoil.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The ECB has a very clear primary mandate which is stipulated in the Treaty: price stability.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Regarding the stability of the financial sector, our new strategy explicitly considers the interactions of price stability and financial stability, reflecting our belief that each is a precondition for the other.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Indeed, effective macroprudential policy can address such risks more directly in a targeted fashion, and thereby reduce the burden that would be placed on monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Nonetheless, given that the macroprudential framework in the euro area is incomplete, and given the interaction between macroprudential and monetary policy, the Governing Council monitors and analyses financial stability risks and their potential to jeopardise price stability over the long haul.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Indeed, a careful analysis of the potential side effects of our monetary policy for the health and stability of financial intermediaries is an integral part of the proportionality assessment that we regularly conduct to test whether the policy measures in place remain appropriate.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Let me give you a concrete example of how we consider the linkages between financial stability and price stability.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: These operations allow us to support bank lending – a key condition in the current circumstances for a durable return of inflation to the target – while containing the risk that credit extension might fuel unsustainable house price increases.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: At the same time, a coordinated macroprudential policy response across the euro area remains vital to strengthen the impact of policy actions and to support monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Our new strategy addresses the challenges that have emerged since the ECB announced the outcome of its previous strategy review in 2003, including the decline in the equilibrium real interest rate, the expectation that this rate will remain low and the deflationary bias induced by the effective lower bound.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The Governing Council agreed on the need to take climate change risks into account when designing and implementing our monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The detailed action plan sets out an ambitious timeline and outlines a wide range of actions, encompassing many areas of the ECB’s activity, and ultimately aims to consistently integrate climate change considerations in all aspects of the ECB’s monetary policy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We therefore intend to assess the appropriateness of our monetary policy strategy periodically, with the next assessment expected in 2025.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: The inflation process before the pandemic In the decade before the pandemic, inflation across advanced economies consistently surprised on the downside.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery

frase: In fact, the low inflation rate last year and the high inflation rate this year equal, on average, the inflation rate observed in 2019 before the pandemic.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: So the price level now is roughly the same as if inflation had remained stable at its pre-pandemic level.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Goods inflation rose to 2.6% in August, well above its historical average of 0.6% as – in addition to base effects – global supply chain disruptions met a sharp recovery in demand for durable goods.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Services inflation has also been rising – to 1.1% in August – and it would have reached 2% using the consumption weights of last year, slightly above its historical average.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Inflation in high‐contact services accounts for virtually all of the rise we are seeing in services.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Once these pandemic-driven effects pass, we expect inflation to decline.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: It is harder to predict how long supply chain disruptions will last, but their ultimate impact on inflation will depend on how persistent they are and whether they feed through into higher than anticipated wage rises.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Monetary policy should normally “look through” temporary supply-driven inflation, so long as inflation expectations remain anchored.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Indeed, we are monitoring developments carefully but, for now, we see no signs that this increase in inflation is becoming broad-based across the economy.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: A “trimmed mean” of inflation – which removes the items with the highest and lowest inflation rates – stood at 2.1% in August.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Inflation expectations also do not point to risks of a prolonged overshooting.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Inflation dynamics beyond the pandemic In fact, looking beyond the pandemic, we expect inflation to only slowly converge towards 2%.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: This is visible in the outlook for underlying inflation, which is a good indicator of where inflation will settle over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: We currently project core inflation – which is one measure of underlying inflation – at 1.5% in 2023.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Our survey of monetary analysts also points to a gradual convergence of inflation, which is expected to climb to 2% and stabilise at that level only five years from now.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: This partly reflects the continuing pull of the structural factors that depressed inflation before the pandemic.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: But the pandemic has also created some new trends, which may have implications for the inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Historically, core inflation in the euro area has mostly been driven by services inflation, which has contributed 1.1 percentage points to the long-term average of 1.3 percentage points.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: This is both because services have a higher weight in consumption, and because goods inflation has been held down by global forces of automation and competition.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Services inflation is closely linked to the strength of the domestic economy.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: It depends heavily on wage growth, as wages make up around 40% of the inputs for consumer services – double the share for goods.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: So the key question today is whether the transition out of the pandemic could lift the outlook for domestic demand and thereby contribute to more dynamic services inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: At the same time, there are forces that point to a slower pick-up in services inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: In the long run, some of these changes might dampen inflationary pressures.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: It might lead to higher trend productivity, which could temper unit labour cost growth even as wage growth becomes stronger.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: It could lead to an accelerated increase in auction prices in the EU Emissions Trading System, the introduction of carbon prices covering a wider range of economic activities, and the adoption of a Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism – all of which could have a direct inflationary impact.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: The Network for Greening the Financial System estimates that implementing ambitious transition policies in Europe could gradually increase inflation relative to its previous trend by up to one percentage point over the transition period, before returning to that trend.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: The impact of the green transition on inflation will ultimately hinge on the development of energy supply and the net effects of fiscal measures.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: If it is not, there is a risk that higher carbon pricing might reduce purchasing power and lead to relative price changes that push down underlying inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Research finds that introducing carbon taxes in euro area countries tends to raise headline inflation but lower core inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Policy implications So how should monetary policy behave in this environment?

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: The key challenge is to ensure that we do not overreact to transitory supply shocks that have no bearing on the medium term, while also nurturing the positive demand forces that could durably lift inflation towards our 2% inflation target.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Our new forward guidance on interest rates is well-suited to manage supply-side risks.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: This guidance ensures that we will only react to improvements in headline inflation that we are confident are durable and reflected in underlying inflation dynamics.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: And the fact that inflation can move moderately above target for a transitory period allows us to be patient about tightening policy until we are certain that such improvement is sustained.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: In terms of supporting demand, our monetary policy will continue to provide the conditions necessary to fuel the recovery.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Indeed, our forward guidance has already led to a better alignment of rate expectations with our new inflation target, while helping to strengthen inflation expectations, which lowers real interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: We expect to see further progress toward an even tighter alignment between the expected time of lift-off for our policy rates and the most likely inflation outlook as markets continue to absorb the rationale and key purpose of our forward guidance.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: For our part, monetary policy is committed to preserving favourable financing conditions for all sectors of the economy over the pandemic period.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: And once the pandemic emergency comes to an end – which is drawing closer – our forward guidance on rates as well as purchases under the asset purchase programme will ensure that monetary policy remains supportive of the timely attainment of our medium-term 2% target.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: The inflation response reflects the exceptional circumstances we are in.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: But the pandemic has also introduced new trends that could affect inflation dynamics in the years to come.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: Those trends could produce both upward and downward price pressures.

titolo: Monetary policy during an atypical recovery
frase: So, monetary policy must remain focused on steering the economy safely out of the pandemic emergency and lifting inflation sustainably towards our 2% target.
