titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Subsequently, I will explain how the ECB tailored its monetary policy response to this extraordinarily deep crisis by adapting its toolkit in an innovative way, and how monetary and fiscal policies complemented each other, unlike during previous crises.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Finally, I will draw some tentative lessons from the crisis by highlighting three features that were crucial for the success of our response: first, our ability to design and implement forceful measures with the appropriate degree of flexibility based on the pre-existing blueprints of our extensive monetary policy toolkit; second, the complementarity and mutually reinforcing effects of our monetary policy instruments; and finally, the important role of fiscal policy in complementing monetary policy in counteracting the unprecedented economic fallout from the pandemic.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Prior to the outbreak of the pandemic, growth in the euro area had been relatively sluggish and inflation had been stubbornly low for many years.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Staff projections suggested that inflation would continue to fall short of our medium-term inflation aim over the projection horizon (Chart 1, left-hand panel).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: This macroeconomic environment implied that the ECB’s monetary policy stance was already highly accommodative even before the pandemic struck.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The ECB’s deposit facility rate (DFR) – the key anchor for money market rates in the euro area in the present environment of excess liquidity – had been at an all-time low of -0.5 percent since September 2019 (Chart 1, right-hand panel).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Hence, the conventional monetary policy space had already been exhausted to a large extent, implying that there was less scope to cut key policy rates than in other advanced economies like the United Kingdom or the United States.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Subdued inflation outlook in the euro area implied highly accommodative monetary policy already before the pandemic

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Against this background, the ECB was already running a massive asset purchase programme of both public and private sector securities in order to bring inflation back to its medium-term aim (Chart 2).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Only shortly before the pandemic, in September 2019, the ECB decided to restart net asset purchases at a volume of €20 billion per month.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: At the same time, the ECB also announced more favourable conditions on its targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: It excludes non-monetary policy assets such as gold and gold receivables, claims on non-euro area residents and non-monetary policy securities held under the “Agreement on Net financial Assets” (ANFA).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: This implies that banks play a much larger role in monetary policy transmission in the euro area, which had to be reflected in our policy response.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: A third feature of the euro area is the specific institutional set-up of the currency union: there is a single monetary policy but mainly national fiscal policies.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In the same vein, the ECB calibrated its monetary policy to avoid market fragmentation and ensure the effective transmission of our single monetary policy to the entire euro area.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: I would like to focus on three aspects that made our policy response unusual: the introduction of dual rates in our TLTROs; the size and flexibility of the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP); and the first broad fiscal response at European level, complementing our monetary policy response.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Dual rates in the TLTROs Our TLTROs, which were first launched in June 2014, support bank-based transmission and ensure continued credit intermediation through the banking system by offering particularly favourable lending conditions to banks meeting a pre-defined lending threshold.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The third series of TLTROs started in September 2019.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The ECB therefore embarked on a major innovation in the design of our lending operations: we decided to offer longer-term funding under the TLTROs during the pandemic period at interest rates below the DFR, the rate at which banks can deposit liquidity overnight with the Eurosystem, conditional on participating banks meeting pre-defined lending thresholds.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: By disconnecting the lending rate from the DFR we were able to effectively reduce the funding costs of those banks that continued to support the real economy, without having to adjust our interest rate corridor, thereby preserving banks’ lending margins and avoiding potential negative side effects from a further rate cut.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Banks’ participation in these liquidity-providing operations has been substantial (Chart 4, left-hand panel): the overall TLTRO III take-up currently represents around one third of our total monetary policy assets.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In comparison, the Federal Reserve’s remaining outstanding loans and net portfolio holdings under the emergency facilities constitute less than two percent of total monetary policy assets.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: While the emergency lending facilities in the United States served mainly as a backstop to the market, the TLTROs became an essential source of funding for the European banking system.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The sharp increase in lending to corporates at the beginning of the pandemic is testament to the success of the TLTRO in averting a credit crunch and safeguarding the monetary policy transmission mechanism (Chart 4, right-hand panel).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: ECB staff analysis confirms that outstanding eligible loans were growing significantly more for banks participating in the TLTROs than for non-participating banks (Chart 5, left-hand panel).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: And the ECB’s bank lending survey confirms that a substantial part of the TLTRO III funds was expected to be used for lending to the non-financial private sector (Chart 5, right-hand panel).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: But the TLTROs were just one element of the monetary policy measures that ensured continued credit intermediation to the real economy.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The easing of collateral requirements in lending operations facilitated banks’ strong participation in the TLTROs and supported the provision of bank credit to very small firms that are particularly reliant on bank financing.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Moreover, the pandemic emergency longer-term refinancing operations (PELTROs) complemented the TLTRO operations by providing a liquidity backstop at somewhat less favourable conditions but without conditionality with respect to the lending performance.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The PEPP: large and flexible The second main policy response was the announcement of additional private and public sector asset purchases.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: While the first response to the pandemic on 12 March 2020 included the announcement of an additional envelope of €120 billion under our regular asset purchase programme (APP), it quickly became clear that the APP was not an adequate tool to deal with the sudden and severe dislocations in euro area bond markets when the crisis hit with full force.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Therefore, on 18 March 2020 the ECB’s Governing Council announced a new asset purchase programme of unprecedented size, with an eventual overall envelope of €1,850 billion after two further expansions in June and December of the same year.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In particular, the sudden divergence in sovereign borrowing rates – which form the basis for financing conditions across the euro area economy more broadly – implied serious risks of fragmentation, which threatened to impair the smooth transmission of our monetary policy stance to the entire euro area.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: This is why we equipped the PEPP with the flexibility to adjust the volume of purchases over time, across asset classes and among jurisdictions.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In retrospect, it turned out that, after we proved our determination to stabilise financial markets and stave off fragmentation risks at the beginning of the crisis, having the option of flexibility – with the clear commitment to use it as necessary – was largely sufficient to preserve the integrity of the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Under the PEPP, we reduced the minimum maturity of eligible assets and expanded our support to the commercial paper market.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: However, the bulk of interventions in this market segment were concentrated in the first two months of the PEPP (Chart 6, left-hand panel).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Thereafter, the backstop provided by the PEPP’s optionality was sufficient to support the continuous normalisation of market conditions, even in the context of renewed and stringent economic lockdowns.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: While the stock of cumulative net purchases of public sector bonds is guided by the Eurosystem capital key, just as under the public sector purchase programme (PSPP), the PEPP provides more flexibility to deviate from the capital key temporarily.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In response to the tangible risk of fragmentation in financing conditions, we allowed cumulative net asset purchases under the PEPP to deviate from the capital key-implied distribution at the beginning of the pandemic.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The PEPP’s flexibility probably contributed to lowering the spread of the euro area GDP-weighted yield over risk-free rates quickly after the announcement of the PEPP (Chart 7).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Spread of euro area GDP-weighted sovereign yields over risk-free rates declined after announcement of PEPP and EU recovery fund

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: As financial market turbulence receded gradually over the course of 2020, the PEPP’s market stabilisation function became less relevant.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In turn, the PEPP’s contribution to an appropriately calibrated monetary policy stance became more important with a view to countering the downward impact of the pandemic shock on the path of inflation.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: This shift made the PEPP more similar to our regular asset purchase programme, the APP, under which net asset purchases are likely to continue for some time once net purchases under the PEPP have come to an end.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The different ways of how asset purchases work under varying market conditions are also reflected in the relative importance of “flow” and “stock” effects.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In contrast, the expected stock of cumulative purchases – the key transmission channel in many theoretical models of central bank asset purchases – is dominant in non-stressed market conditions.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: “Stock” is defined as the ratio of survey-implied total expected public sector purchases by the expected end of net asset purchases to total expected outstanding public sector debt.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Beyond the direct effects, our various crisis measures proved to mutually reinforce each other, thereby also amplifying the overall accommodative impact of our policy response.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: For example, negative rates strengthen the portfolio rebalancing effect from asset purchases as investors aim to avoid negative interest rates.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Asset purchases, in turn, signal the policymaker’s intention to keep short rates low for an extended period of time, strengthening our forward guidance.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Moreover, by increasing the relative returns of bank loans, asset purchases also indirectly support the bank loan creation that is further buttressed by the conditionality attached to our TLTROs.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Our forceful monetary policy response announced in March 2020 was immediately followed by broad fiscal measures at national level, including, in particular, loan guarantee schemes for corporates and job retention schemes for workers.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: First, the ability to successfully counter a rapidly evolving crisis depends on the scope for innovation and flexibility in the monetary policy toolkit.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The substantial monetary easing that we delivered over the course of the crisis has put such concerns to rest.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In particular, there are important complementarities between negative interest rates, targeted lending operations and asset purchases.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Moreover, our recently revised forward guidance allows us to steer interest rate expectations even more effectively, thus reinforcing the impact of our other measures.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: In line with our policy of continuously conducting thorough proportionality assessments, this also mitigates undesirable side effects associated with individual monetary policy instruments.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The final lesson from our policy interventions is that supportive fiscal policy, in particular at the European level, has played an important role in alleviating the pressure on monetary policy to be “the only game in town”.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: While the announcement of the PEPP was crucial in averting self-reinforcing price spirals in government bond markets and thus a deterioration of financing conditions at the beginning of the crisis, the political agreement relating to a joint recovery fund and the NGEU initiative was instrumental in sustainably calming financial markets (Chart 7).

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: The subsequent easing of financing conditions – and the investment that will be financed under NGEU – will continue to support economic activity in Europe, foster potential growth and ultimately help to bring inflation back towards our medium-term target.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Although it would be premature to claim that we have successfully overcome the crisis, the experience from the pandemic has illustrated the effectiveness of the ECB’s monetary policy toolkit in stabilising financial markets and countering the negative impact of the pandemic on the inflation outlook.

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis

titolo: Lessons from an unusual crisis
frase: Our revised forward guidance firmly anchors any policy tightening to inflation reaching two percent well ahead of the end of our projection horizon and durably for the rest of the projection horizon, and to realised progress in underlying inflation being sufficiently advanced to be consistent with inflation stabilising at two percent over the medium term.

titolo: Dynamic regions at the heart of a strong Europe
frase: First, thanks to the exceptional response of fiscal and monetary policy, we are seeing a very fast economic recovery rather than a slow and painful one.

titolo: Dynamic regions at the heart of a strong Europe
frase: We should not overreact to supply shortages or rising energy prices, as our monetary policy cannot directly affect those phenomena.

titolo: Dynamic regions at the heart of a strong Europe
frase: But we will pay close attention to wage developments and inflation expectations to ensure that inflation expectations are anchored at 2%.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Introduction Euro area headline inflation is expected to have reached 3.4% in September according to the most recent flash estimate, its highest annual rate in more than a decade and notably above the ECB’s new symmetric target of 2% to be attained over the medium term.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The recent rise in inflation, which was at least partly expected, has intensified the debate about the most likely future evolution of price pressures – in the euro area and elsewhere.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: It stands in sharp contrast to the developments observed over the past decade when structural headwinds prevented inflation from converging towards our target.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The timing of this conference on inflation drivers and dynamics could therefore hardly be more fitting.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: I will begin my remarks by briefly discussing how the current spike in inflation can in large part be attributed to temporary pandemic-related factors that are likely to dissipate in the medium term.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Then I will turn to a more thorough discussion of the headwinds and tailwinds that may contribute to the evolution of inflation over the medium term, linking them to research that will be presented at this conference.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: My main focus will be on two important topics: inflation expectations and behavioural changes, for example regarding firms’ price setting behaviour.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: We devoted a substantial part of our recently concluded strategy review to understanding how these factors affect inflation dynamics, and continue to pursue an ambitious research agenda in these areas.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The papers that will be presented at this conference address many questions that are highly relevant in the current debate on inflation and therefore have important ramifications for the future conduct of monetary policy.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Near-term prospects: an inflation sneeze Let me begin by recalling the evolution of price dynamics in the euro area over the ten years that have passed since inflation last reached levels around 3%.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Over most of the past decade, inflation has persistently fallen short of the ECB’s previous inflation aim of below, but close to, 2 percent.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Both headline and core inflation averaged around 1% between January 2013 and December 2019 (Chart 1).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Moreover, inflation repeatedly surprised on the downside relative to our in-house staff projections before the pandemic (Chart 2).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Other international institutions and financial market participants also continuously overpredicted future inflation developments.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Subdued inflation dynamics were driven by both cyclical and structural factors, which, in combination, created sustained headwinds for underlying price pressures.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: A high level of slack after the double-dip recession, diminishing conventional monetary policy space in the vicinity of the effective lower bound as well as structural factors, such as globalisation, digitalisation and demographic change, have all contributed to persistently low inflation rates.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: During our monetary policy strategy review, we conducted detailed analysis to examine the relative importance of these drivers.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Initially, the pandemic had put further downward pressure on inflation in the euro area.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Inflation declined substantially in 2020, with rates temporarily entering negative territory in the second half of the year.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: With the onset of the recovery, inflation picked up rapidly.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: In fact, the current spike in inflation owes much to the continued impact of those same factors that pushed down inflation earlier in the annual comparison.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Consequently, their impact on inflation rates will be transitory.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Indeed, more than half of measured headline inflation in the euro area, based on the harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP), is currently due to rising energy prices and the reversal of the German VAT cut (Chart 3).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Inflation has also been affected by changes in the weights in the consumption basket.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Consumption patterns changed markedly last year owing to the impact of lockdowns, leading to a shift in consumption weights that are used to calculate Eurostat’s inflation index.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: These changing weights can have a notable impact on the measurement of inflation: HICP inflation would have been even higher in recent months using last year’s weights (Chart 3).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: For example, assuming constant consumption weights, euro area services inflation would have amounted to 2.1% in September instead of 1.7% indicated by the flash estimate.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Due to the construction method of the HICP, the pandemic-induced expenditure shifts will continue to affect the index calculation until at least 2022.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Two further pandemic-related factors are also having a temporary – if somewhat more durable – impact on inflation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: First, continued supply chain disruptions, augmented by the global economic recovery, are pushing up producer prices due to supply and demand imbalances, thus feeding into non-energy industrial goods inflation, which has been exceptionally strong recently (Chart 4, left panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Second, the re-opening of the economy has pushed up services inflation to 1.1% in August and 1.7% in September according to the flash estimate.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: This recent surge in services inflation is predominantly due to rising price pressures in high-contact services (Chart 4, right panel).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Speaking metaphorically, the current inflationary spike can be compared to a sneeze: the economy’s reaction to dust being kicked up in the wake of the pandemic and the ensuing recovery.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: And even though these pandemic-related developments are currently dominating media headlines, chances are high that the current episode of above-target inflationary pressures will subside over time.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The latest data and survey results, including findings on potential second-round effects in wage bargaining, do not suggest that price pressures will persist.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: At present, headline inflation is forecast to fall back below our medium-term inflation target of 2% in the medium term (Chart 5).

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Similarly, core inflation is projected to rise only gradually.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The persistence of inflationary pressures ultimately depends on whether the dust kicked up by the pandemic continues to settle as the economic recovery takes hold.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: There are several sources of uncertainty that might entail more persistent inflationary pressures.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: As we form our assessment of the medium-term inflation outlook, we keep our finger in the wind to determine whether the breeze will turn out to be more long-lived than just a transitory gust.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: It is also possible that the pandemic has altered or reinforced structural trends, thus affecting inflation dynamics in the years to come.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: Against the background of research contributions presented at this conference, I would like to highlight two additional, and possibly related, types of uncertainty that will determine whether current inflationary trends will turn out to be more persistent.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: First, the current uptick in inflation might result in a more enduring upward revision of expectations about nominal costs and inflation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The role of inflation expectations Let me begin with inflation expectations.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The standard prescription for monetary policy is to “look through” temporary supply-side shocks and to only take policy action if inflation expectations and wage bargaining give rise to second-round effects posing a threat to price stability.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: The difficulty with this prescription is that aggregate inflation expectations are unobservable, requiring policymakers to employ various proxy measures.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes
frase: One method is to use market-based measures of inflation compensation.

titolo: Prospects for inflation: sneezes and breezes

frase: Taken together, these three forces explain why inflation is temporarily high and provide solid reasons to expect inflation to decline through the course of next year.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In relation to the connection between our inflation analysis and our interest rate policy, it is always necessary to keep in mind that monetary policy affects the inflation rate only with a considerable lag.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In particular, an abrupt tightening of monetary policy today would not lower the currently-high inflation rates but would serve to slow down the economy and reduce employment over the next couple of years and thereby reduce medium-term inflation pressure.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: Given our assessment that the medium-term inflation trajectory remains below our two per cent target, it would be counter-productive to tighten monetary policy at the current juncture.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In particular, our new forward guidance specifies three conditions that need to be met before we would start raising our policy rates.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: The first condition is that the Governing Council “sees inflation reaching two per cent well ahead of the end of its projection horizon.” The second condition is that the two per cent target is reached “durably for the rest of the projection horizon”.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: The third condition is that the Governing Council “judges that realised progress in underlying inflation is sufficiently advanced to be consistent with inflation stabilising at two per cent over the medium term.”

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: With regard to temporarily-high inflation, the requirement that we need to see inflation reaching two per cent not only “well ahead of the end of our projection horizon” but also “durably for the rest of the projection horizon” ensures that interest rate policy will not react to inflation shocks that are expected to fade away before the end of our projection horizon (which will include 2024 in the December round).

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: Moreover, the condition that “realised progress in underlying inflation is sufficiently advanced to be consistent with inflation stabilising at two per cent over the medium term” serves an important purpose in our analysis of the incoming data: it sharply differentiates between the volatile components of headline inflation and the dynamics of underlying inflation, which is the persistent component that is the best guide to medium-term inflation dynamics.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In assessing underlying inflation, it is critically important to filter out the temporary impact of base effects and bottlenecks on goods inflation and services inflation.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: The persistent component in wage dynamics will be central in the assessment of underlying inflation, especially in view of the high share of services in the overall price level and the high share of labour in services value added.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: Accordingly, tracking wage outcomes – adjusted for productivity – and differentiating between transitory and persistent components in wage settlements will be pivotal in assessing progress in the realised path of underlying inflation.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In particular, a one-off shift in the level of wages as part of the adjustment to a transitory unexpected increase in the price level does not imply a trend shift in the path of underlying inflation.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In addition to rate forward guidance, the calibration of asset purchases also plays a major role in ensuring that the monetary stance is sufficiently accommodative to deliver the timely attainment of our medium-term two per cent target.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In particular, the compression of term premia through the duration extraction channel is quantitatively-significant in determining longer-term yields and ensuring that financing conditions are sufficiently supportive to be consistent with the delivery of our medium-term inflation objective.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In our latest monetary policy meeting, we assessed that, in the near term, supply bottlenecks and rising energy prices are the main risks to the pace of recovery and the outlook for inflation.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: At the same time, if persistent bottlenecks feed through into higher than anticipated wage rises or the economy returns more quickly to full capacity, price pressures could become stronger.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: Our two percent target is expressed in relation to the HICP.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: While our strategy recognises that the inclusion of the costs related to owner-occupied housing in the HICP would better represent the inflation rate that is relevant for households, the full inclusion of owner-occupied housing in the HICP is a multi-year project.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: In the meantime, the Governing Council in its monetary policy assessments will take into account inflation measures that include initial estimates of the cost of owner-occupied housing in its wider set of supplementary inflation indicators.

titolo: Inflation in the short term and in the medium term
frase: However, in terms of the two percent inflation target, clarity requires that this is guided by the prevailing HICP measure, which is produced by Eurostat on a timely, comprehensive basis with the application of the highest statistical standards.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The use of asset purchases, in particular, has triggered concerns that monetary policy may raise economic inequality by favouring those who own financial assets.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: In my remarks today I would like to respond to these concerns by discussing the distributional effects of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: I will start by explaining that structural trends, far beyond the realm of monetary policy, have been the main drivers of rising economic inequality, and that it is the responsibility of elected governments to mitigate their effects.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: I will then show that, by pursuing our primary mandate, monetary policy tends to reduce labour income inequality, as the earnings of households in lower income quintiles are, on average, more sensitive to sharp downturns in economic activity.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Finally, I will argue that the effects of monetary policy on wealth inequality are less clear.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: A substantial part of the euro area population do not own bonds, shares or real estate, and – to the extent that some policy instruments, such as asset purchases, boost the prices of these assets – there is a risk that monetary policy may disproportionally benefit those in the higher ranks of the wealth distribution.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Central banks therefore have a duty to integrate such considerations into their decision-making process as part of their regular proportionality assessment, so as to choose a set of policy instruments that ensures their mandate is fulfilled while minimising the potential distributional effects of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: As a result, trade union membership rates have fallen measurably over the past few decades (Slide 4, right-hand chart), and productivity gains have not been matched by real wage growth, widening the gulf between workers and capital owners.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Distributional effects of monetary policy Inequality is thus, by and large, the result of long-term structural trends.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The question, then, is whether there is also a link between monetary policy and inequality, and whether and how central banks should take distributional effects into account when conducting policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The first is the impact of inequality on the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Today, heterogeneity in income and wealth is widely considered to be a prime channel of policy transmission.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Differences in how spending behaviour of individual households changes in response to income and wealth shocks – the marginal propensity to consume – are likely to significantly influence the effectiveness of monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Income inequality can also constrain how much space there is for monetary policy to respond to disinflationary shocks.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: In the United States, for example, new research suggests that the marked rise in the income share of high-income cohorts is likely to have been a prime driver behind the significant and persistent increase in the economy’s aggregate savings rate, putting downward pressure on real interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Lower real interest rates, in turn, have made it more difficult for monetary policy to stabilise or stimulate the economy through cuts in the main policy rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The second aspect is whether or not, and how, monetary policy itself may affect the distribution of income and wealth.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: A natural starting point to answering this question is the primary mandate of many central banks: protecting price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Inflation is often considered one of the most regressive taxes.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: By protecting the purchasing power of people, monetary policy has been an important source of improvement in livelihoods of households with low income.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: There is broad empirical evidence suggesting that income inequality tends to decline visibly when monetary policy succeeds in anchoring inflation at low and stable levels.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Monetary policy also has effects on the distribution of income and wealth in the way it transmits through the economy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Changes in interest rates, for example, always have distributional consequences, whether they reflect a change in the monetary policy stance or whether they are the result of other macroeconomic factors, such as changes in the demand for capital.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: As a rule, changes in interest rates redistribute income between debtors and creditors.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: While interest income of net savers declines in response to a cut in policy rates, labour income rises significantly for both net borrowers and net savers owing to the stimulating effects of monetary easing on aggregate demand and employment (Slide 7).

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: On net, a decline in interest rates is found to reduce income inequality, as households with lower incomes tend to have, on average, a higher risk of losing employment during a recession than workers further up the income ladder, so that the positive effect of an expansionary monetary policy, through its effect on GDP growth, mainly benefits the lowest income group (Slide 8, left-hand chart).

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: This was also the case during the pandemic, where monetary policy has played an important role in dampening cyclical increases in income inequality.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: There is broad consensus that our pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) has prevented a collapse of the financial system, which could have had dramatic consequences for society at large.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Asset prices, wealth and monetary policy New research, however, suggests that the effects of monetary policy on the broader income distribution are more nuanced when also considering realised capital gains, such as from sales of shares or real estate, which are typically not included in official measures of personal income.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Based on highly disaggregated data, economists at Sveriges Riksbank found that the effects of monetary policy on the income distribution are U-shaped once realised capital gains are included – that is, both low and high-income earners benefit disproportionally from lower interest rates, at the expense of the middle class.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Evidence from Denmark, also based on household-level data, even suggests that households with the highest incomes tend to benefit the most from lower interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Monetary policy then increases income inequality.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: But they do suggest that the distribution of net wealth, and the effects of monetary policy on the prices of real and financial assets, play an important role in the overall picture.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Faced with the constraints of the zero-lower bound and years of subdued price pressure, many central banks have increasingly resorted to asset purchases to stimulate or stabilise the economy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Such purchases are a necessary, suitable and proportionate instrument for central banks to fulfil their statutory mandates when policy rates are close to the effective lower bound.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: But since they directly affect the prices of longer-dated assets, their impact on relative incomes and wealth may be more pronounced than that of changes in short-term policy rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Direct distributional effects of asset purchases I would distinguish between two types of effect: direct and indirect.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: In addition, when considering the consolidated balance sheet of the public sector, which includes the central bank, there is a risk that very long periods of asset purchases may penalise the average taxpayer in a future crisis.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Low and negative interest rates have mitigated this trade-off.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: But to the extent that asset purchases contribute to making debt safer, they may, at some point, be protecting bondholders at the expense of the average taxpayer.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: None of these effects call into question the stabilising power of asset purchases that benefits society at large in a deep recession, or when financial markets are at risk of collapse.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: At the lower bound, asset purchases have become an indispensable tool for monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Rather, what these findings suggest is that, once the economy has stabilised, undesirable distributional effects from asset purchases may increase.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Indirect distributional effects of asset purchases This brings me to the indirect effects of our purchases on the distribution of wealth and income, namely the broader portfolio rebalancing triggered by the compression of risk-free interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: By searching for yield in a low interest rate environment, they may have played a non-negligible role in pushing up real estate prices in recent years, not only in the euro area but across advanced economies, especially in major cities.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Monetary policy and low interest rates are only one factor.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Yet, new ECB research corroborates the IMF’s findings, suggesting that unconventional monetary policy measures, such as asset purchases, are likely to have a significantly larger impact on house prices than changes in short-term policy rates (Slide 11, left-hand chart).

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: First, central banks must pay more attention to house prices, from both a price stability and a financial stability perspective.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: As part of our monetary policy strategy review, the Governing Council recommended a roadmap for the inclusion of owner-occupied housing in the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP).

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The augmented HICP will not only better represent actual consumption expenditures by households, but also better reflect the transmission of our monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Preliminary estimates show that the inclusion of owner-occupied housing costs would have increased the cyclicality of inflation in past years and led to persistently higher inflation since around 2014 (Slide 11, right-hand chart).

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: In the second quarter of this year, owner-occupied housing would have contributed between 0.4 and 0.5 percentage points to a new, augmented HICP.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Should we judge that differences of this magnitude are likely to persist over the medium term, they then become relevant for the appropriate calibration of our monetary policy stance.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Our revised framework also explicitly recognises that financial stability is a pre-condition for price stability.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Monetary policy cannot turn a blind eye on such developments in an institutional setting in which macroprudential policies are, in principle, the first line of defence but are not yet fully effective.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: At the current juncture, for example, it is likely that the large stock of acquired assets, in conjunction with our strong forward guidance on policy rates, will prevent an unwarranted tightening of long-term rates once net asset purchases have been terminated.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: From today’s perspective, this can be expected to happen in March 2022 in the case of net purchases under the PEPP, while the pace and duration of our net purchases under the asset purchase programme (APP) will critically depend on a thorough reassessment of the medium-term inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: By gradually shifting the policy mix away from net asset purchases, we will prevent the distributional footprint of our measures from increasing and mitigate financial stability risks while the economy recovers.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: One reason for ending net asset purchases before raising policy rates has to do with the potentially adverse distributional consequences of reversing the order of policy normalisation.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: In raising policy rates before ending net asset purchases, central banks would be willingly accepting losses on their balance sheets that would ultimately lead to losses for the average taxpayer, and the continuation of net asset purchases would benefit mostly wealthier households.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Our forward guidance, in turn, ensures that we will not respond hastily to rising inflation rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: We are taking the impact of current high inflation rates on the purchasing power of people very seriously.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: We recognise that current high energy inflation has a particularly concerning effect on the incomes of households at the lower end of the income distribution.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: However, monetary policy cannot mitigate short-term spikes in inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Because of the long lags in the transmission of monetary policy, our mandate is firmly framed in terms of the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Our efforts are therefore focused on assessing how persistent current price pressures will ultimately be.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: At our last Governing Council meeting, we concluded that there remains good reason to believe that euro area inflation will decline visibly over the course of next year and gradually fall back below our target of 2% in the medium term, meaning that the conditions for raising interest rates, as set out in our revised forward guidance, are very unlikely to be met next year.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Prematurely raising policy rates in response to a temporary inflation surge would hurt households with low incomes the most.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Nonetheless, significant uncertainty remains as to how persistent some of the current price pressures will prove to be.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The ECB therefore continues to carefully monitor inflationary developments in the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Demographic shifts are another prominent factor explaining the secular decline in real interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: A cut in policy rates also reduces the interest rate expenses of the government, thereby disburdening the average taxpayer.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: Total wealth inequality, however, which includes human wealth, is found to increase less when interest rates decline.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The reason is that human wealth inequality rises less when interest rates decline as younger people, who tend to have lower financial wealth, are partially hedged against a decline in rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and inequality
frase: The difference between the growth rates of the new, augmented HICP and the current HICP would currently amount to 0.2 to 0.3 percentage points.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: Supervisors removed prudential barriers preventing banks from maintaining the credit flow to the economy, allowing them to maximise the funding made available via the ECB’s targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III).

titolo: Welcome address
frase: And it helped ensure that the ECB’s monetary policy, which is largely transmitted through banks, could be delivered more evenly across all parts of the euro area.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: A comprehensive and robust macroprudential policy framework can also significantly reduce the burden on national fiscal policies and monetary policy in terms of macro-financial stabilisation.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: At a conceptual level, it is clear that both price stability and macroeconomic stability simultaneously require that fiscal positions are sustainable and that fiscal policy operates in a countercyclical manner.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In an environment in which central banks must turn to asset purchase programmes in order to ensure an appropriate monetary policy stance in the neighbourhood of the effective lower bound, such programmes can operate more smoothly if there is an effective and transparent fiscal framework to simultaneously underpin fiscal sustainability in each Member States and an appropriate euro area fiscal stance.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In relation to macroeconomic stabilisation, counter-cyclical fiscal policy is particularly important as a counter-cyclical stabilisation instrument if monetary policy is constrained by the effective lower bound on nominal interest rates.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: While a lower value of r* improves fiscal sustainability, thereby creating fiscal space, a low value of r* also implies that the effective lower bound will more frequently constrain the ability of monetary policy to respond to adverse shocks.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In one direction, a procyclical tightening of fiscal policy during a downturn would not be fully offset by an easing of monetary policy if the effective lower bound is binding.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In the other direction, the return to the two percent inflation target will be slower and will require a more persistent phase of monetary accommodation if fiscal policy is not countercyclically deployed in response to an adverse shock.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: Moreover, it should be appreciated that while fiscal expansion during a recession should have a significant multiplier effect (especially if the effective lower bound is a constraint), the multiplier impact of a fiscal expansion during a phase of strong economic performance is likely to be much more muted, with crowding-out effects amplified by the likely need to tighten monetary policy if pro-cyclical fiscal expansion posed a threat to the two percent inflation target.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In relation to fiscal sustainability, lower average interest rates have significantly reduced debt servicing costs, from almost 4 per cent of GDP at the start of Economic and Monetary Union to around 1.5 per cent of GDP in 2020 (Chart 6 and Chart 7).

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: While lower debt servicing costs surely create additional fiscal space to a significant degree, a full treatment of the implications for optimal fiscal policy should take into account the causal determinants of low equilibrium real interest rates.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In particular, the contributions of lower trend productivity growth and demographic trends to the decline in interest rates have different fiscal implications than other sources of low rates.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In addition, accounting for the ECB’s symmetric two per cent inflation target in the expenditure rule would improve the counter-cyclicality of the framework by automatically increasing fiscal space in times of inflation below the target, and vice versa.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In relation to the fiscal stance, this amounts to an intertemporal shift in the timing of fiscal adjustment: fiscal policy would be looser when inflation is running below the two percent target but tighter when inflation is running above target.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: By providing extra fiscal accommodation when inflation is running below target, this would also enable monetary policy to operate more effectively, especially in the shadow of the effective lower bound.

titolo: The future of the EU fiscal governance framework: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: More sophisticated variants could also be considered (albeit at the price of extra complexity) that duly differentiates between demand-driven and supply-driven inflation shocks.

frase: and the extensive accompanying note Overview of the ECB monetary policy strategy, which includes a discussion of monetary-fiscal interactions.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: My remarks today will focus on the outlook for the euro area and the relevance of the cost of housing for inflation – as requested by this Committee.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The economic outlook and monetary policy Economic activity continued to recover strongly in the third quarter: quarterly gross domestic product (GDP) growth stood at 2.2 per cent and GDP is still expected to exceed its pre-pandemic level around the end of the year.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This time, thanks to the strong and combined fiscal and monetary policy responses, we expect it to exceed its pre-pandemic level in less than two years.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Turning to inflation, the rate increased by more than we had anticipated in September, standing at 4.1 per cent in October.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The upswing in inflation is being driven by three primary forces.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: In October energy inflation accounted for just over half of overall headline inflation.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: And the third is that the reversal of the temporary cut in German VAT last year is mechanically driving up current headline inflation figures.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The latter factor will fall out of the inflation calculation from January 2022 but the other two may last longer.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: As the recovery continues and supply bottlenecks unwind, we can expect the price pressure on goods and services to normalise.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: As a result, we still see inflation moderating in the next year, but it will take longer to decline than originally expected.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: If energy prices keep rising or supply constraints persist, inflation may remain higher for longer than we currently anticipate.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We do see wage growth next year potentially rising somewhat more than this year, but the risk of second-round effects remains limited.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Overall, we continue to foresee inflation in the medium term remaining below our new symmetric two per cent target.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Growth and medium-term inflation dynamics still depend on favourable financing conditions for all sectors of the economy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: At our October meeting the Governing Council continued to judge that favourable financing conditions could be maintained with the stance endorsed in September.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Regarding policy interest rates, in our forward guidance we clearly articulated the three conditions that need to be satisfied before rates will start to rise.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Despite the current inflation surge, the outlook for inflation over the medium term remains subdued, and thus these three conditions are very unlikely to be satisfied next year.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Meanwhile our asset purchases under the pandemic emergency purchase programme continue to safeguard favourable financing conditions for all sectors of the economy.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: At a time when purchasing power is already being squeezed by higher energy and fuel bills, an undue tightening of financing conditions is not desirable, and would represent an unwarranted headwind for the recovery.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Even after the expected end of the pandemic emergency, it will still be important that monetary policy – including the appropriate calibration of asset purchases – supports the recovery throughout the euro area and the sustainable return of inflation to our target of two per cent.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: I will now turn to the treatment of owner-occupied housing for inflation measurement, as requested by this Committee.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The ECB considers that price stability is best maintained by aiming for two per cent inflation over the medium term, with the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) being the appropriate price measure.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: It is thus of primary importance to the ECB that the HICP appropriately represents the consumption patterns of euro area households.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: We have listened to you and to the public, and we are now proposing steps to better reflect housing costs in the measurement of inflation in the euro area.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Doing so we are mindful of the various technical challenges posed by incorporating housing costs in the HICP and the role that different EU institutions have in this process.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: To ensure that HICP maintains its focus on consumption expenses as required by the HICP regulation, only the consumption part of housing costs must be captured.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The second step, in line with the HICP regulation, is to derive a price index by looking only at transactions to, but not within, the household sector.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: However, the HICP is not compiled by the ECB but by Eurostat and the national statistical institutes.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This roadmap foresees four main stages for moving to an HICP including owner-occupied housing.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Second, we would like Eurostat to publish an experimental quarterly HICP including owner-occupied housing costs, possibly by 2023.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The aim – and final stage – would be to include owner-occupied housing at a monthly frequency and in a timely manner, hence fully usable for monetary policy purposes.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: The Governing Council also decided that, during the transition period, the main reference index for monetary policy will remain the current HICP.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Nevertheless, the quarterly standalone owner-occupied housing price index as well as the quarterly indices, combining HICP and owner-occupied housing, once available, will play an important supplementary role and inform our monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Adjusted inflation figures including the owner-occupied house price indices would currently be slightly higher than the annual HICP inflation rate.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: This reflects strong euro area house price dynamics in the recent period, which remained unabated during the COVID-19 crisis and continued to be supported by strong fundamentals and favourable financing conditions.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: At the same time, it is important to highlight that during periods when there is downward pressure on housing prices, such adjustments may also result in a lower HICP inflation rate.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Our new clear and symmetric two per cent inflation target makes it easier to hold us accountable.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament
frase: Moreover, we have taken concrete measures to enhance the clarity and accessibility of our communication to the public, such as the new monetary policy statement following our Governing Council meetings.

titolo: Hearing of the Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs of the European Parliament

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Turning now to the main focus of this lecture, this is a milestone week: the end of March marks the conclusion of ECB net asset purchases under the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: This is a good moment to review the conduct of monetary policy during the pandemic, with a primary focus on the PEPP.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In addition to this review, I will also discuss the current challenges for monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The monetary policy response to the pandemic From the outset, the pandemic posed three challenges for the ECB: first, stabilising financial markets; second, protecting credit supply; and third, countering the adverse impact of the pandemic on the projected inflation path.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Tackling the first pair of challenges was necessary to achieve the inflation target, since market instability or a credit crunch would have made it impossible to run an effective monetary policy.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In relation to the adverse impact on the projected inflation path, the June 2020 Eurosystem staff projections marked down the end-of-horizon annual inflation rate for 2022 from 1.6 per cent to 1.3 percent, while the end-of-horizon inflation rate was modelled to decline even further to 0.9 per cent in a severe pandemic scenario.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: These large-scale inflation downgrades reflected the projected increase in economic slack due to the substantial declines in GDP that were feared.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: From a stance perspective, an insufficient monetary policy response would have implied a longer period of low inflation, putting at risk the timely convergence of inflation to the target rate (now defined as two per cent).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Excessively-low inflation would have implied higher real interest rates, thereby weakening the recovery of investment and consumption.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Moreover, especially in the context of the effective lower bound on policy rates, a protracted period of low inflation might have fostered a downward drift in inflation expectations that could ultimately become entrenched, making it even more difficult for us to deliver our inflation aim.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: This concern was subsequently codified in the 2021 monetary policy strategy statement that concluded that the delivery of the symmetric two per cent inflation target requires – when the economy is in the proximity of the lower bound – especially forceful or persistent monetary policy measures to avoid negative deviations from the inflation target becoming entrenched.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Monetary policy was already accommodative before the pandemic shock.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The prospect of persistent below-target inflation had resulted in a further easing of the monetary stance in September 2019: the deposit facility rate had been lowered to minus 0.5 per cent and net asset purchases were resumed at a rate of €20 billion per month under the ECB’s baseline asset purchase programme (APP).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: These measures were reinforced by forward guidance that tied future monetary policy decisions to the inflation outlook and developments in underlying inflation dynamics.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In addition, credit supply was supported by the third series of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (the TLTRO III programme).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The central elements included: the escalation of asset purchases through the 12 March 2020 decision to add an extra € 120 billion to the already-running APP and the 18 March 2020 launch of the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP), a revision in the structure and pricing of the TLTRO programme, an easing of the collateral framework, and a set of supportive supervisory measures (taken by the supervisory wing of the ECB).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In addition to its market stabilisation role, the additional quantitative easing provided by the PEPP and the extra injection of liquidity through the expansion of the TLTRO programme also eased the overall monetary stance, helping to counter the negative impact of the pandemic on the projected inflation path.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The combination of asset purchases and the targeted lending programme led to a substantial expansion of the balance sheet of the Eurosystem, which was of comparable size to the balance sheet increases of the Federal Reserve and the Bank of England (Chart 1).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Credit operations include all TLTROs, PELTROs, MROs, and LTROs.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: For the Federal Reserve asset purchases include all Treasury bills, notes, and bonds as well as inflation-protected Treasuries and floating-rate Treasuries.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: For the Bank of England asset purchases include all Gilts and corporate assets held within the Asset Purchase Facility.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The pandemic measures should be viewed as acting to reinforce the impact of the already-low levels of the key policy rates.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Moreover, the ECB’s forward guidance about the future setting of its policy measures played a central role in determining the overall monetary stance.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In relation to the key policy rates, since September 2019 the forward guidance linked future rate setting to the inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The Governing Council framed its forward guidance on the path of policy rates in terms of a commitment to attaining the inflation target by clarifying that policy rates would be lifted only if the evidence was sufficiently robust to foster a high degree of confidence that the inflation rate would reach two per cent on a durable basis.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Such state-contingent forward guidance represents a strong commitment to keep financing conditions at sufficiently accommodative levels for as long as necessary to stabilise inflation at the medium-term inflation target in a sustainable fashion.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In line with the state-contingent forward guidance, market-based expectations of future policy rates adjusted in response to changes to the inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Over time, the market view of the lift-off date has been pulled forward, in response to the changing outlook for inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: While time-varying risk premia (possibly also reflecting some uncertainty about the central bank reaction function) means that the scale of movement in the lift off date might not always conform to the most likely path for future policy rates, the directional pattern of adjustments broadly reinforced the monetary policy stance during much of this period.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: As I described in earlier contributions, the PEPP was designed with a dual role.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: First, alongside the ECB’s other monetary policy instruments, asset purchases were the most important mechanism for delivering the additional monetary accommodation required to support the economic recovery and safeguard price stability in the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Second, the flexibility embedded in the PEPP – across time, asset classes and jurisdictions – was essential in enabling the ECB to stabilise financial markets in an efficient and effective manner.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The forward guidance for PEPP was connected to the pandemic: net PEPP purchases would continue until the Governing Council judged that the coronavirus crisis phase was over.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In any case, the future roll-off of the PEPP portfolio will be managed to avoid interference with the appropriate monetary policy stance.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: The calibration of the PEPP had to take into account the substantial step up in net issuance of both public and private securities entailed by the pandemic (Chart 3).

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: In the absence of sufficient asset purchasing by the ECB, this extraordinary increase in issuance could have put significant upward pressure on funding costs, putting firms and households under extra financial pressure and running the risk of an adverse real-financial doom loop by which tighter financing conditions and declining activity levels reinforce each other.

titolo: Monetary policy during the pandemic: the role of the PEPP
frase: Taken together, the APP and PEPP portfolios now amount to €5 trillion.
