titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: The period December 2021 to July 2022 constituted a distinct first phase in the normalisation of the monetary policy of the ECB.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Starting with the announcement that net purchases under the pandemic emergency programme (PEPP) would conclude in March 2022 and followed by the curtailment and the eventual cessation of net purchases under the asset purchase programme (APP) by the start of the third quarter, this phase was completed with the lifting of the key policy rates out of negative territory at the July meeting.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: This period saw a remarkable regime change in the behaviour of the euro area yield curve, with a very significant upward shift and an increase in volatility, as markets responded to the implications of the new inflation and cyclical environment for the future path for monetary policy, including the exit from “lower bound” monetary policy calibration.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Having completed this initial stage of monetary policy normalisation, our upcoming September monetary policy meeting will be the start of a new phase.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Our over-riding goal is to make sure that monetary policy will deliver the timely return of inflation to our medium-term two per cent target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In terms of execution, this new phase will consist of a meeting-by-meeting (MBM) approach to setting interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: At a basic level, the transition from rate forward guidance to the MBM approach is in line with our monetary policy strategy, which assessed that forward guidance was primarily an appropriate response to the lower bound constraint.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: As policy rates move away from the lower bound, the inherent flexibility of the MBM approach is better suited to calibrating monetary policy in a highly uncertain environment.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Since monetary policy works through its influence on the entire yield curve, it is important to appreciate that MBM monetary policy essentially has two elements.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: First, it allows for meeting-by-meeting re-assessments of the conditionally-expected medium-term path for interest rates that is required to deliver the two per cent target, in line with the incoming data and evolving outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: The terminal rate over the projection horizon is widely used as a short-hand summary indicator for the orientation of interest rate policy.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: It follows that a primary influence on the interest rate decision in any one meeting is the size of the gap between the prevailing interest rate and the assessed terminal rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Second, at a tactical level, the exact calibration of the interest rate decision should also take into account the appropriate speed to close that gap.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: To state the obvious, the current zero value of the policy rate (taking the deposit facility rate as the relevant policy rate in conditions of excess liquidity) is below any calculation of the appropriate terminal rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Our July monetary policy statement signalled that further normalisation of interest rates will be appropriate: the scale and timeline of rate adjustment will be determined by the evolution of the terminal rate and the appropriate speed in closing the gap between the current rate and the terminal rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In anticipation of further interest rate hikes towards the terminal rate, the euro area yield curve is much higher than the current policy rate, such that the extent of monetary tightening that has already occurred is far greater than the July first step in raising the policy rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In the long-term steady state (with no shocks hitting the economy), the equilibrium nominal risk-free interest rate will be the sum of the two per cent inflation target and the long-term equilibrium risk-free real interest rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: However, within the medium-term horizon of monetary policy, time-varying cyclical factors may require interest rates to move above or below that long-term equilibrium level in order for inflation to stabilise at two per cent.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: It follows that, meeting-by-meeting, an important element of the monetary policy debate will be the discussion of our latest assessment of the appropriate terminal rate that takes into account the evolution of cyclical factors, in addition to assessing a potential role of structural forces in shifting the underlying long-term equilibrium real interest rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In terms of understanding the interplay of cyclical factors, there are no shortcuts in following a data-dependent approach.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: It is essential to maintain an integrated analytical framework that jointly analyses the inflation cycle, the economic cycle and the financial cycle, in recognition of the interactions and inter-dependencies across economic, monetary and financial developments in determining the dynamics of nominal and real variables.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: This integrated framework is a cornerstone of our monetary policy strategy and guides the preparation of each monetary policy meeting, especially in the quarterly meetings in which new staff macroeconomic projections are presented together with comprehensive reports on monetary and financial developments.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: The over-riding focus of this analytical work is to make sure that monetary policy is calibrated to counter the cyclical forces that threaten the timely delivery of our two per cent inflation target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: The over-riding cyclical feature is that inflation is currently very far above the two per cent target, with the prospect of a prolonged phase before inflation returns to the neighbourhood of the target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In particular, inflation is expected to remain high in the near term primarily due to the further upward pressure on the costs for energy (especially gas and electricity) and food over the summer, together with the ongoing pass-through to retail prices of input cost increases incurred in the earlier stages of production chains.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: At a mechanical level, the combination of base effects, the easing of supply bottlenecks and the completion of the re-opening phase of the pandemic recovery will contribute to inflation falling back over time from its current extremely-high levels.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: However, the monetary policy challenge is to assess the strength and persistence of the cyclical adjustment dynamics to these high inflation rates that, if left unattended, could result in an unacceptably-delayed return to the two per cent inflation target, with the associated risk that inflation that remains too high for too long could de-anchor long-term inflation expectations.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In particular, the wider economic cycle will play a critical role in determining the responses of price setters and wage setters to the currently-high inflation rates.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: The toll of unexpectedly-high inflation on real incomes and the real value of accumulated savings, the significant deterioration in the terms of trade (especially since so much energy is imported), the high intrinsic uncertainty associated with the Russian war on Ukraine (both in relation to energy and food costs and geo-political stability), the slowdown in the world economy and the tightening in global and domestic financial conditions that has already occurred all constitute significant economic headwinds for the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Taken together, these forces suggest that cyclical inflation forces will be subject to push-pull dynamics.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In one direction, the catch up adjustment of prices and wages to the steep cost increases that have already occurred constitutes a source of intrinsic persistence that, if excessive, could generate an unacceptable delay in the return of inflation to the two per cent target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In turn, the meeting-by-meeting re-assessment of the appropriate terminal rate will reflect the implications of the incoming data for the relative strength of these opposing adjustment forces, together of course with the incidence of any further inflation shocks.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Turning to the appropriate speed in closing the gap between the prevailing policy rate and the appropriate terminal rate, it is important to appreciate that the middle and longer segments of the yield curve, which are most important for determining financing conditions in the economy, are much more sensitive to the expected terminal rate than to the precise timeline for converging to the terminal rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: First, there is uncertainty about the transmission of policy rate changes to overall financing conditions, such that it makes sense to allow the financial system to absorb rate changes in a step-by-step manner.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In particular, the same cumulative rate hike over a fixed interval is less likely to generate adverse feedback loops (that in turn could pose new risks to price stability) if it takes the form of a multi-step calibrated series rather than a smaller number of larger rate increases.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Of course, in calibrating a multi-step series, the appropriate size of the individual increments will be larger the wider the gap to the terminal rate and the more skewed the risks to the inflation target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Second, the current high uncertainty about inflation dynamics and monetary policy transmission means that a multi-step adjustment path towards the terminal rate also makes it easier to undertake mid-course corrections if circumstances change.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: While upside risks to inflation are currently more intense than downside risks, if the incoming data (new shocks, updates on the relative strength of opposing adjustment forces) call for a downward shift in the terminal rate, this would be easier to handle under a step-by-step approach.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Such risks not only include downside scenarios to the economic outlook but also external factors that could tighten financing conditions independently of domestic monetary policy actions (such as the spillover impact of monetary policy tightening in other countries or shifts in risk sentiment in global markets).

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: For this reason, even if the general direction of monetary policy is shaped not only by the centre of the risk distribution but also by the current net upside skew, the agility to adjust the scale and speed of interest rate hikes remains vitally important.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Clearly, the worst-case scenario would be characterised by the de-anchoring of long-term inflation expectations, which would be very costly to fix.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: Across all available sources, macroeconomic expectations (and prospects at the individual level) suggest a high degree of concern about a potential economic slowdown, a general recognition that supply shocks will generate both near-term inflation surges and a decline in the economic outlook, which in turn will constrain the persistence of inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area: the next phase
frase: In terms of the feedback loop from inflation expectations to nominal and real dynamics, it is important to appreciate that, for any given nominal yield curve, if high near-time inflation expectations are accompanied by expectations of a deteriorated macroeconomic outlook and significant uncertainty then the inflation cycle is less likely to be amplified through an endogenous increase in consumption, investment and credit compared to an alternative scenario in which high near-term inflation expectations are accompanied by macroeconomic optimism.

titolo: Monetary policy and the money market
frase: While the money market is always central to the transmission of monetary policy, its role is especially prominent when the set of policy interest rates is the main active monetary policy instrument.

titolo: Monetary policy and the money market

frase: In particular, the inflation dynamics associated with the energy shock component, to which the euro area is particularly exposed, are of a different nature compared to demand-driven overheating dynamics.

frase: It follows that it is important that money market rates adjust in line with changes in key ECB interest rates.

titolo: Monetary policy and the money market

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: I am honoured to deliver the Karl Otto Pöhl lecture this evening on the topic of monetary policy in the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: After a long period when inflation in the euro area was too low, it is now far too high.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: We are in the tenth consecutive month of record-high inflation rates and we may see this streak continue in the near term.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Inflation is being caused by a series of unprecedented shocks, which have led to turning points in the global economy.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As a result, price pressures have proven much stronger and more persistent than originally projected.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In this setting, monetary policymakers must ensure that inflation does not become entrenched and that it returns to target in the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: First, the nature of the inflation shock we are facing in the euro area today, and second, the implications this has for monetary policy now and in the future.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The shocks hitting the euro area economy In our monetary policy strategy, the appropriate response to a deviation of inflation from our target depends on three factors: the source, size and persistence of that deviation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Typically, when the source of an inflationary shock is stemming mainly from demand, monetary policy will respond proactively to prevent the economy from overheating.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: And when faced with supply shocks, to the extent that such shocks are seen to have no lasting impact on inflation, central banks will “look through” and extend the medium-term policy horizon if necessary.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Instead, the euro area is seeing an increase in inflation driven by two unprecedented shocks.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: These shocks have constrained global supply, but they have also shifted demand and led to a large and persistent inflation response.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: At the same time, the fiscal and monetary policy response to the pandemic has succeeded in protecting nominal incomes, thereby supporting a fast recovery of demand when our economies reopened.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This has led to inflation broadening into both industrial goods and services.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Today, around three-quarters of the items in the core inflation basket have inflation rates above 2%.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This resulted in a spike in energy prices which was a major factor in our underestimation of inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: But the invasion has hugely aggravated the supply squeeze and sent energy prices to extraordinary levels, making it all the more challenging to forecast inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This surge in energy prices has directly contributed around 30% to the headline inflation rate since the start of this year and, indirectly, has added to the broadening of price pressures across the economy.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In fact, the models used by the national central banks indicate that the indirect effects of higher energy costs are currently contributing around one-third to core inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The persistence of inflation Collectively, these shocks have pushed inflation a long way from our target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Headline inflation – which was negative as recently as December 2020 – has risen by 9.4 percentage points from its trough during the pandemic to its peak last month.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Core inflation has risen by 4.1 percentage points.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: And this means, in turn, that it is taking longer for the inflationary effects of those shocks to fade out.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This is likely to reduce efficiency and increase costs, which could create inflation pressures while supply chains are adjusting.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy response So, to sum up, we are currently facing a situation where lingering supply constraints are an important factor causing above-target inflation to persist for longer – and their effect is being exacerbated by the release of pent-up demand.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In this setting, monetary policy needs to avoid deviations from our target becoming entrenched and return inflation to 2% in the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The first is the destination of monetary policy: we need to normalise policy, and be ready to adjust rates by as much as necessary to reach our inflation target in the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The second consideration is the pace of rate increases: since interest rates are rising from very low levels, the pace of rate increases can mobilise the signalling channel of monetary policy directly.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The destination of monetary policy First, when inflation is high and growth is constrained by inelastic supply, monetary policy cannot remain expansionary and add to inflationary pressures by pushing up demand.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: It is therefore appropriate to pursue a strategy of monetary policy normalisation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As I explained in a blog post earlier this year, normalisation implies ending net asset purchases and then raising rates to neutral levels – so levels that are neither expansionary nor restrictive.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: That is why the ECB has not only started raising interest rates, but also communicated that we expect to raise interest rates further over the next several meetings.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: And to ensure that these changes in our policy stance are effective, we have taken several decisions over the last few months to preserve the orderly transmission of our stance throughout the euro area.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As we move forward, we will reassess whether a normalisation strategy is sufficient to bring us back to 2% inflation over the medium term.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Ultimately, the terminal rate at which our hiking cycle ends must be compatible with inflation returning durably to our target – and that rate will depend on how the economic environment evolves around us.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: One key factor will be how the persistence of the shocks we are facing affects inflation expectations and potential output.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: If there were evidence that high inflation risked de-anchoring inflation expectations, then the policy rate that is compatible with our target would lie in restrictive territory.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Another key factor will be how the growth outlook affects inflation.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Negative supply shocks will result in a growth slowdown, which will likely have an impact on the prevailing inflation rate.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In past euro area recessions going back to the 1970s, headline inflation has fallen by about 1.1 percentage points a year later, while core inflation has fallen by about half that amount.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: But this is not a hard-and-fast rule: in some recessionary episodes, such as those triggered by a worsening of supply conditions, inflation has stayed the same or even risen.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: But inflation is expected to be higher at the end of the projection horizon than in the baseline scenario.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Monetary policy will do whatever is needed to return inflation to our target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: But a truly European approach where monetary and fiscal policy complement each other can improve the inflation outlook.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In particular, how fiscal policies support firms and households through the difficult winter ahead will play an important role in inflation dynamics.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: But beyond that, it will make a difference whether fiscal policy focuses mainly on public consumption and transfers – which may add to inflationary pressures – or on public investment and debt sustainability.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As many of the sources of inflation today are on the supply side, government policies that lift supply and redirect investment to where it is needed are necessary to support sustainable growth.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The pace of rate increases The second consideration in responding to current inflation is the pace of rate increases.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: When inflation is high for a long period of time, an important role for monetary policy is to ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored as the shocks work their way through the economy.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: If expectations become de-anchored and trigger a wage-price spiral, it can lead to inflation becoming persistent even after the shocks disappear.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Raising interest rates has a mechanical effect on demand and inflation, and thereby on inflation expectations.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: But when interest rates are starting from unusually low levels, rate hikes are more powerful if they also create signalling effects that influence expectations directly.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In this context, especially compared with the traditional focus on 25 basis-point increments, adjusting the pace of rate hikes is a key tool to signal our determination to fulfil our mandate and keep inflation expectations contained.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: And moving faster at the start of the hiking cycle clearly conveys our commitment to bring down inflation to our medium-term target.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: At present, inflation expectations remain relatively well anchored across a range of measures.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: First, the shock is severely affecting the prices of those consumption items, such as groceries and petrol, that have the greatest influence on households’ inflation expectations.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB’s Consumer Expectations Survey shows that, since February this year, both mean and median expectations for inflation three years ahead have risen by around 1 percentage point.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Second, we are seeing a rapid change in the economic environment, with inflation switching from being very low to being extremely high.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: For example, research finds that differences in inflation expectations between people from the former East and West Germany can largely be explained by the lasting effect of the inflation shock after reunification.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This contrasted strongly with the perceived norm of zero inflation in the German Democratic Republic and seems to have led former East Germans to over-adjust to an environment of rising prices.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This imperative to anchor inflation expectations helps explain why, over the last two policy meetings of the ECB’s Governing Council, we raised our key interest rates by 125 basis points in total.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This is the fastest change in rates in our history and it has sent a strong signal of our determination to return inflation to our medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: Monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This major step also took into account the unusually low level of interest rates and the limited risk of overreacting at the start of the hiking cycle.

frase: Next, I will report on the accumulating evidence about the impact of the policy tightening cycle on the financial system, the economy and inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In view of the long and differential lags in the transmission of monetary policy, this evidence is necessarily partial and of an interim nature.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Still, it is essential to monitor closely the incoming evidence, since the efficient calibration of monetary policy must take into account the feedback loops between monetary policy, the financial system, the economy and inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Beginning in December 2021, the ECB unwound its highly accommodative monetary policy stance in several phases.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: First, the pace of net asset purchases was reduced, including through the ending of net purchases under the pandemic emergency purchase programme in March 2022.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Net asset purchases under the asset purchase programme further shifted down from April 2022 and concluded in June 2022.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In July 2022, we began raising the ECB key interest rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The €STR forward curve – the benchmark for key overnight lending in the euro area – began shifting up in December 2021, as markets began pricing in the start of ECB policy normalisation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This induced a tightening impulse even before we began raising actual policy rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: By now, we have raised rates by a cumulative 300 basis points, bringing the deposit facility rate – which, in the current conditions of ample excess liquidity, constitutes the main instrument for steering the monetary policy stance – to 2.5 per cent.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Furthermore, we have also signalled that we intend to raise the deposit facility rate by another 50 basis points at our March meeting and we will then evaluate the subsequent path of our monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This evaluation will necessarily turn on two basic considerations: first, an updated assessment of the medium-term inflation outlook (both the modal path and the risks to this outlook) second, an updated assessment of the appropriate monetary policy stance to make sure that inflation returns to our two per cent target in a timely manner.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In turn, both parts of this assessment involve judgements on the impact of the monetary policy adjustments that have already occurred since December 2021.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Calibrating changes in the policy stance and monitoring the transmission to the financial system, the economy and inflation presents policymakers with three challenges.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The first is to produce a reasonable (counterfactual) forecast of where inflation would head without an adjustment in monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The second is to develop reasonable estimates of how an adjustment in monetary policy would alter that inflation trajectory.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The third is to carefully monitor each step in this transmission from monetary policy to the economy and inflation, gathering evidence along the way on how this transmission conforms with past regularities or, if it does not, to better understand how and why the specific features of the current macro-financial environment might alter the strength and speed of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: It is worth pointing out that, regardless of the origin of an inflation shock, the working assumption is that monetary policy operates on the demand side, with rate hikes reducing inflation through the dampening impact of tighter financing conditions on the level of aggregate demand.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Let me first review the set of models that ECB staff use to inform policy decisions and present the macroeconomic effects these assign to monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: As the bulk of these effects on the economy and inflation are expected to materialise only over the coming two to three years, I will then go through a set of more timely signals that may be gathered along the way and that can act as checkpoints on the path of transmission.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: To date, these signals for the most part point to a strong and orderly transmission of the ECB’s policy tightening to the relevant financial and real variables.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: But, especially since this transmission process is still unfolding, I will conclude with a set of open questions on the impact of the ongoing policy tightening that can only be settled conclusively at a more mature stage of the process.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The impact of hiking in macroeconomic models At the ECB, we employ a suite of semi-structural, dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) and Bayesian vector autoregression (BVAR) models to study the underlying transmission channels of monetary policy and to quantify the impact of changes to monetary policy on financial conditions, the economy and inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: It is inherently difficult to pin down causal relations in empirical macroeconomic models and this is reflected in the wide range of estimates of the impact of monetary policy impulses on macroeconomic variables.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The level of uncertainty about the impact of monetary policy is arguably greater for the euro area than for other economies, in view of the structural changes associated with the formation of the monetary union in 1999.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Most recently, the MMR model has been developed, which is a DSGE model sharing many similarities with the NAWM II, but which additionally estimates the degree of attention to central bank communication, thereby dampening the forward guidance puzzle encountered in standard DSGE models, and accounts for a time-varying neutral interest rate in line with the trend visible in the data over the last decades.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Due to their ability to capture the inertial behaviour of inflation and the persistence in aggregate variables, BVAR models provide a useful benchmark to evaluate structural and semi-structural models both in terms of their forecasting performance and for what concerns the monetary policy transmission mechanism.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In general, DSGE models (NAWM II and MMR) and BVAR models display a stronger impact of monetary policy on the economy than semi-structural models (ECB-BASE).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: First, the identification of monetary policy shocks is typically clearer in structural models (either DSGE or structural VAR models), allowing for a narrower causal interpretation of the effects of monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This is important, since reduced-form estimates of the relations between interest rates, economic activity and inflation are plagued by the reverse causality syndrome by which, especially if demand shocks predominate, an increase in interest rates is most likely if economic activity is projected to be strong and inflation to be high.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This gives rise to time-series correlation patterns by which any causal dampening impact of monetary policy on activity levels and inflation can be obscured in the data by its proximity to the strong activity and inflation data that actually triggered the policy tightening.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In contrast, a structural approach in which the causal impact of monetary policy can be identified should, in principle, uncover the impact of policy tightening on activity and inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Second, the micro-foundations of the optimisation decisions that form the key foundations of these structural models, and the use of model-consistent expectations, lead to more forward-looking behaviour of economic agents compared to other models, and this in turn strengthens the expectations channel of interest rate policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This explains the stronger initial impact of monetary policy compared to other types of models.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The left and middle panels of Chart 2 show the impact of a policy tightening of 100 basis points on inflation and GDP in these models.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: All simulations are based on a tightening that has a relatively persistent effect on short-term rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Conditional on a 1 percentage point change in the interest rate, on average inflation declines by around 0.3 percentage points and the output gap by 1 percentage point at the peaks of the respective impacts.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: However, the range of estimates is large: the impacts on inflation and output are larger in structural models (DSGE and BVAR) compared to the ECB-BASE model and the BMEs.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Moreover, due to their forward-looking nature and amplification through financial channels, the effect is frontloaded in DSGE models compared to other models, since households and firms more quickly react to the expected declines in future activity and inflation associated with monetary policy tightening.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: These estimates imply that the models generate not only different scales of monetary policy impacts but also heterogeneous lags in the timing of the transmission of monetary policy to the economy and inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Differences in transmission lags of monetary policy across these models arise from the specific modelling frameworks.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In addition to the lags associated with the slow and staggered adjustment of investment and consumption to changes in financial conditions, the full impact of policy rates on financial conditions is not immediate.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In particular, fixed-rate loans and deposits provide some near-term insulation to changes in interest rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: However, as financial contracts expire, more and more firms and households face higher interest rates and the tightening of financial conditions is further amplified by the endogenous shortening of maturities in response to higher interest rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This will be a recurring theme in this lecture, in particular when I turn to how the current tightening is being transmitted.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Finally, our overall policy stance is also affected by our balance sheet polices.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Our models suggest that reducing our asset portfolio by a normalised cumulative €500 billion reduction over 12 quarters contributes to lowering inflation by 0.15 percentage points and output by 0.2 percentage points (Chart 2, right panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Tightening so far according to model estimates Our models indicate that the significant policy tightening that we initiated in December 2021 has had substantial effects on euro area financing conditions so far, while its transmission to real activity and inflation is also starting to materialise.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In discussing the transmission of our policy stance through the lens of our models, it is important to account for all factors driving that transmission collectively, including interactions with other domestic and global shocks potentially shaping macroeconomic dynamics.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: To disentangle these effects, the impact of policy normalisation is estimated by first computing the policy contribution to changes in financial conditions and then using macro models to estimate the impact on the economy and inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Combining information from model-based analysis and market and survey-based information, we estimate that the tightening of monetary policy has contributed to an increase in short-term interest rates of 90 basis points in 2022, rising to around 300 basis points in 2023 and 2024, and 240 basis points in 2025, and to increases in long-term rates of around 130 basis points.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This tightening is estimated to have already lowered inflation by around 0.2 percentage points in 2022 (Chart 3)., The considerable lags between monetary policy actions and their impact on inflation, however, imply that most of the effects are only expected to materialise from 2023 onward.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Inflation is estimated to be around 1.2 percentage points lower in 2023 and 1.8 percentage points lower in 2024 as a result of the tightening, while the negative impact on real GDP growth is estimated to be around 1.5 percentage points on average over the three years.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: At one level, these estimates serve to underline the severe risks to the delivery of our medium-term target if monetary policy had been passive and had not reacted to the inflation shock.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: At another level, especially taking into account the wide range of estimates across the different models, material and persistent errors in the appropriate calibration of monetary policy pose two-sided risks to the delivery of our medium-term inflation target: insufficient tightening would result in inflation persistently above our target, while excessive tightening could see overshooting and a return to persistently below-target inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Model-based analysis also facilitates the building of a more detailed understanding of the transmission of policy rate hikes to different components of demand.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: For example, recent staff analysis employing the semi-structural ECB-BASE model shows that rate hikes may induce stronger investment declines if the initial level of the policy rate is particularly low, as was the case prior to the start of our hiking cycle in July 2022., This result is in line with standard asset price models based on the user cost of capital, which posit a non-linear, negative relation between the level of lending rates and asset prices.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Hence, in the case of business and housing investment, lower interest rates lead to larger discounting effects on future returns (dividends and imputed rents), amplifying the impact of interest rate changes on current stock and house prices.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Spread increases are simulated under exogenous monetary policy.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The risk-free rate scenarios assume short- and long-term interest rates to increase by 100 basis points, without spread increases, and are allowed to trigger an exchange rate adjustment that amplifies the negative impact of rising rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Also, while the models provide a good estimate for the overall effects of policy changes on the economy and inflation, policy transmission usually unfolds in a heterogeneous manner, with the peak impact and duration of transmission varying substantially across sectors and jurisdictions.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Tightening impact according to market and survey information In line with the sequence by which monetary policy passes through the transmission chain, I will start with the impact on short-term money market rate expectations.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Market rates A first indicator is the extent to which moves of our policy rates influence money market conditions.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The evidence suggests that the policy rate hiking that has occurred since July last year has been passed on almost entirely to short-term money market rates, with the transmission occurring relatively smoothly across market segments and jurisdictions.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The €STR forward curve, which is derived from the overnight interest rate swap curve and reflects the market view on the path that the overnight interest rate will follow in the future, has shifted upwards significantly since December 2021 (Chart 5).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Surveys are adjusted for the spread between the latest €STR and the DFR observations; Right panel: Maximum number of respondents is 41 for February 2023 SMA and 29 for December 2022 SMA.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Whether adjusting for risk premia or not, forward rates today see a rate trajectory which, in line with our communication, rises above the range of estimates that can be considered neutral to the monetary policy stance.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Conceptually, the neutral interest rate is the hypothetical level of the interest rate that, when all temporary shocks have faded out, can set the economy on a sustainable path of balanced growth with inflation durably at target.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: As actual rates move beyond that level, policy becomes restrictive – as is necessary when inflation is otherwise set to remain above the central bank’s target for an extended period.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: That is, the monetary policy adjustment since December 2021 can be interpreted as having two elements.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: First, there has been an exit from an accommodative stance: this component can be viewed as essentially permanent (in the absence of a new anti-inflationary shock).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This is reflected in the market pricing of the forward curve, which sees the policy rate settling around 2 per cent once inflation has stabilised at our target, rather than reverting to the low (indeed, negative) levels that were in place until last July.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This long-term exit from the persistently low-rate regime reflects the reanchoring of long-term inflation expectations at our 2 per cent target and the market judgement that the anti-inflationary forces that were in place before the pandemic (such as significant deleveraging by both the private sector and the public sector after the 2008-12 financial crises and favourable global supply-side developments) will not return with the same force.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Accordingly, a significant component of the rate tightening so far is essentially permanent in nature.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: While the associated reanchoring of inflation expectations means that the rise in real rates is less than the rise in nominal rates, the permanent nature of this component of the rate tightening amplifies its impact compared to a purely temporary increase in rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Second, there is an adjustment component that reflects our monetary policy response to the current high inflation.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: It is fully priced (in line with our expressed policy intentions) that the main policy rate (the DFR) will reach 300 basis points in March, and it is priced to rise even higher subsequently.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This component (going beyond the policy rate of around 200 basis points that the market expects to prevail over the long term) can be viewed as restrictive and further adds to the tightening of financial conditions, even if it is less persistent than the normalisation component of our policy adjustment.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The transmission of rate hikes to sovereign bond markets since the start of the hiking cycle since July has been orderly, supported to some extent by the ongoing flexible reinvestment of the pandemic emergency purchase programme, activated in early July 2022, as well as the addition of the transmission protection instrument to our toolkit in late July 2022.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: It is also a material driver of economic activity and inflation through a range of channels.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Reflecting an earlier and more demand-driven updrift in inflation, US monetary policy changed course earlier than in the euro area, which was then also reflected in a sustained euro depreciation against the US dollar, lasting until September of last year.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: But as the actual and prospective interest rate differentials across the two economies were reduced, the euro has reversed some of the previous depreciation, thus confirming the functioning of another important transmission channel for the current tightening cycle (Chart 6).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Bank-based transmission The capacity of a central bank to influence the economy hinges on its ability to alter the broad monetary stance, including the terms and conditions at which the economy has access to bank-provided and market-provided finance.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The tighter financing conditions for banks are also reflected in the results of the latest ECB bank lending survey (BLS) from January.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Euro area banks reported a substantial further tightening of credit standards for loans or credit lines to enterprises in the fourth quarter of 2022 (Chart 9), especially for housing loans and other lending to households (Chart 10).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Consistent with the adverse impact of monetary policy tightening on economic activity levels, risks related to the economic outlook and industry or firm-specific situations are mentioned in the BLS as the main motives currently driving banks towards enforcing tighter credit standards.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Survey data for households and firms More expensive and harder-to-obtain credit is downgrading the prospects of economic sectors that are more sensitive to financing conditions.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: For example, consumer expectations about interest rates have shifted upward since March 2022, according to our Consumer Expectations Survey (CES).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Consumers have raised their expectations for interest rates on mortgages.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The interest rates expected to apply to loans for house purchases in 12 months’ time have increased by about 1.5 percentage points since the beginning of 2022 (Chart 11, left panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In line with these developments, the CES evidence also points to worsening household perceptions about the housing market, both for perceptions of housing as a good investment and 12-month-ahead expectations for house price growth, amid tightening financing conditions.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Overall, the CES evidence suggests that consumers are incorporating the impact of higher interest rates in their economic decisions, particularly in calibrating their plans for discretionary consumption.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Demand for consumer durables is contracting as is the demand for residential construction, driven by rising input costs and interest rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Even if demand for non-durables should be relatively less affected by rising interest rates, retail sales dropped markedly by 2.7 per cent in December month on month, and by 2.8 per cent in annual terms (Chart 13).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The European Commission’s business and consumer surveys suggest that the share of firms in the manufacturing sector reporting that financial constraints are a factor limiting production has doubled to 6 per cent since the start of our policy tightening ( Chart 14, left panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Inflation expectations Inflation expectations anchor inflation dynamics and co-determine real interest rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: A basic task for monetary policy is to make sure that longer-term inflation expectations align with our 2 per cent target.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In addition, deviations from the target will be more prolonged and more costly if households, firms and market participants come to believe that a central bank is not firmly committed to making sure that inflation returns to the target in a timely manner.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In particular, even if long-term expectations remained firmly anchored, even a temporary rise in inflation expectations over the typical monetary policy horizon of one to two years would amplify any initial inflation shock by influencing pricing and wage decisions and, all else equal, by pulling demand forward through a lowering of inflation-adjusted interest rates.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The strong downward sloping ‘term structure’ of inflation expectations in the CES suggests that consumers in the euro area continue to perceive the current spike in inflation as clearly fading out over time.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: They expect inflation to return closer to the levels seen in the past, albeit to remain above two per cent for some time (Chart 15, left panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: This means that, for a given level of the nominal policy rate, the monetary policy stance is expected to become more restrictive over time as inflation declines.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Indeed, measures of long-term inflation expectations from diverse sources – including household surveys, professional forecasters and financial market instruments – have so far remained well anchored around the 2 per cent medium-term target.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Respondents to the Survey of Professional Forecasters (SPF) repeatedly, over several rounds, expect inflation to decline steadily over the course this year and next, and to return to target in 2025 ( Chart 16, right panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The distribution of long-term inflation expectations has remained centred around 2 per cent ( Chart 16, left panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Financial market measures of inflation compensation have also hovered around the 2 per cent target over the medium term.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Financial markets responded strongly to the policy decisions taken by the Governing Council in our December 2022 meeting, which made clear that we would raise interest rates into sufficiently restrictive territory in order to make sure that inflation would return to our 2 per cent medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: In particular, the reaction of market-based inflation compensation measures in response to the December communication – which saw a substantial decrease in near-term inflation linked swap (ILS) rates in line with a policy tightening effect while longer-term ILS rates remained relatively stable – is an example of how our monetary policy decisions are contributing to keeping inflation expectations well anchored (Chart 15, right panel).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Three factors may distinguish the current hiking cycle from previous tightening episodes.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: The sharpest policy tightening on record Comparing the current hiking cycle to previous ones is challenging for three reasons.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Second, in order to understand how monetary policy is filtering through to the economy, it is important to consider not only the level that interest rates have reached today, but also the speed at which these have been raised over a relatively compressed period of time.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Third, the start of the hiking cycle put an end to an era of negative policy rates and marked the first rate hike since 2011.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: As the available literature studying negative rates has found, pronounced non-linearities were evident in the relative impact of equally sized rate reductions depending on whether these occurred in positive or negative territory.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: That said, the path is relatively similar to two historical precedents at least (the response by the Bundesbank to the inflationary risks emanating from the German unification in the early 1990s and the rapid normalisation of policy rates by the ECB following monetary union over 1999-2000).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: However, at least over the period for which we can draw comparisons, the impact of our rate hikes on lending rates and on credit volumes has been stronger and more rapid.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Of course, whether these tighter conditions will succeed in sufficiently dampening demand and thereby decelerating inflation markedly is too early to conclude and remains an open issue.

frase: Given the global drivers of the inflation surge (energy shocks, global supply chain bottlenecks), major central banks around the world have simultaneously increased interest rates at an historic pace.

frase: Empirically, medium-term spillovers from the Federal Reserve tightening to euro area real activity and inflation are found to be large and, along some dimensions, in fact as large as the effects on the US economy itself (Chart 18).

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: Structural shifts in firm and household financing Structural shifts are another challenge that compels us to reassess our modelling frameworks and to augment them with further evidence on the evolution of the monetary policy transmission process.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment
frase: For instance, as policy rates increase, more and more firms can be expected to opt for shorter maturity and flexible rate debt, which could magnify the impact of monetary policy on investment.

titolo: The euro area hiking cycle: an interim assessment

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: When inflation has been far from target for a sustained period and the process of monetary tightening has been under way for some time, there are three primary inputs into monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: First, in view of the medium-term orientation of monetary policy, the inflation forecast over the next one to three years plays an important role.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Second, the incoming information on underlying inflation constitutes an essential additional basis for assessing medium-term inflation dynamics, in view of the conditional nature, the lower frequency of production and the intrinsic uncertainty surrounding macroeconomic forecasts.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Third, especially in view of the transmission lags from shifts in the monetary policy stance to the financial system, the economy and inflation dynamics, assessing the incoming information on the transmission of previous monetary policy decisions is also necessary for the appropriate calibration of monetary policy decisions.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: My focus today is on the second input: underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: The assessment of underlying inflation (which should be understood in a broad sense, including the information contained in wage dynamics and inflation expectations) should be viewed as a complementary cross-check to the inflation forecasting process.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In one direction, if the signals from underlying inflation at a given point in time support the narrative embedded in the inflation forecast, this boosts confidence levels (among policymakers, market participants, firms and households) in the inflation forecasts.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In the other direction, if the signals from underlying inflation at a given point in time are at odds with the inflation forecast, this calls for robust policy decisions that take into account the different signals coming from the forecast and the analysis of underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: First, I will discuss the conceptual issues involved in analysing underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Second, I will review the recent data flows that are relevant for assessing underlying inflation in the euro area.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Third, I will offer some concluding remarks on the role of underlying inflation in the setting of monetary policy over the coming months.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: To this end, measures of underlying inflation are routinely monitored.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Generally, their purpose is to obtain an estimate of where headline inflation will settle in the medium term after temporary factors have vanished.”

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In view of the major dislocations of recent years (the pandemic, the energy shock, the war), it is helpful to think of headline inflation as currently being driven by three factors: (a) pure noise; (b) a reverting component; and (c) underlying inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In particular, the economics of dislocations suggest that there is currently a substantial reverting component of inflation that is sufficiently long-lasting not to constitute pure noise but that can also be expected to fade out over the near term.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: These factors contributed to the sharp rise in inflation since the middle of 2021 and, even if there has been some easing or even a reversal in these factors, the adjustment process to these shocks is still ongoing and is not likely to come to a sudden stop.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: While the adjustment process may also affect medium-term inflation dynamics, the quantitative contribution to inflation is plausibly larger over the near term than over the medium term.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Since the peak impact of monetary policy is further out than one year, this reverting component of inflation should be less important for monetary policy than the medium-term underlying component.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Since the standard measures of underlying inflation typically make a two-level distinction between the transitory and persistent components of inflation, these standard measures should not be taken at face value under conditions in which the slowly-reverting component might be (at least partly) mis-classified as contributing to medium-term inflation dynamics.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Before turning to the analysis of the range of indicators of underlying inflation, it is also necessary to recognise that the trajectory of the underlying inflation component can be affected by shocks to the noise and reverting components of inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: First, even a pure noise shock can have a permanent effect on the price level if a positive inflation shock is not followed by a subsequent negative inflation shock.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: This holds even more strongly for a shock to the reverting component: since a sustained period of high inflation can leave a large footprint on the price level if it is not fully reversed.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In turn, a surprise permanent increase in the price level can trigger medium-term inflation dynamics through its impact on the subsequent path for nominal wages, as some unwinding of the initial decline in real wages can be expected and the wage adjustment process can play out over an extended period.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Second, especially if there is a backwards-looking component in how firms, households and financial market participants form beliefs, a period of high inflation can persistently alter inflation expectations, with a direct and substantial impact on medium-term inflation expectations.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: Again, this risk is more substantial in relation to the reverting component than the pure noise component of inflation.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: For these reasons, actual inflation outcomes and measures of inflation expectations belong in the family of indicators that are relevant in assessing the underlying inflation pressures.

titolo: Underlying inflation
frase: In one direction, strong increases in headline inflation or an upward above-target revision in inflation expectations would reinforce upward pressure on underlying inflation; in the other direction, a material decline in headline inflation or an easing in above-target inflation expectations should alleviate upward pressure on underlying inflation.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: The euro area has been hit by an inflation shock, which is now working its way through the economy.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: While headline inflation is likely to decline steeply this year, driven by falling energy prices and easing supply bottlenecks, underlying inflation dynamics remain strong.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: In such an environment, our ultimate goal is clear: we must – and we will – bring down inflation to our medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: In current conditions, a robust strategy calls for a data-dependent approach to making policy and a clear reaction function so that the public understands the sources of information that will be important to us.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: To that end, our future policy path will be determined by three factors: our assessment of the inflation outlook in light of the incoming economic and financial data, the dynamics of underlying inflation and the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: At the same time, I have made clear that there is no trade-off between price stability and financial stability.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: We have plenty of tools to provide liquidity support to the financial system if needed and to preserve the smooth transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: The path so far Last year, inflation in the euro area surged strongly, and spread deeply, because it was driven by two types of shocks which hit the economy at the same time.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: Our policy stance was starting from highly accommodative levels, having been tailored to the very-low inflation environment of the past decade and the initial deflationary risks of the pandemic.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: demonstrating, through actions and commitments, that monetary policy would cover the necessary ground decisively.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: And we also communicated a clear upward path for rates, so that the public could be confident that monetary policy was on an anti-inflationary path, and that rates would soon leave accommodative territory.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: In a sense, an emphasis on data dependence was less important because monetary policy had distance to cover across all scenarios.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: But as the inflation outlook evolved, it became clear that a pure normalisation of policy – which would imply achieving a broadly neutral stance – would not suffice in itself.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: First, the shocks increased the distance of inflation from our target.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: Even though inflation has likely passed its peak, it is descending from very high levels, and it is projected to be too far above our target for too long.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: The longer inflation is too high, the greater the danger that it remains so.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: Second, the shocks also increased the risk that above-target inflation becomes more persistent.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: In particular, price pressures have broadened and deepened.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: Measures of underlying inflation tracked by the ECB currently range between 4% and 8%.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: In this setting, we needed to bring rates to sufficiently restrictive levels to dampen demand.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: And, in doing so, we could keep a firm grip on inflation expectations and ensure they remain anchored.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: That is a key reason why we committed to raise interest rates significantly and at a steady pace over recent meetings – and why we decided last week that a further 50 basis point hike was necessary.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: The policy path ahead Now a sizeable policy adjustment is already behind us: since July last year we have raised interest rates by 350 basis points.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: However, inflation is still high, and uncertainty around its path ahead has increased.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: First, with high uncertainty, it is even more important that the rate path is data-dependent.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: Indeed, as I explained last week, if the baseline scenario in our most recent projections is confirmed, we will still have ground to cover to make sure that inflation pressures are stamped out.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: Second, while the European banking sector is resilient, with strong capital and liquidity positions, in view of recent financial market volatility, we are ready to act and provide liquidity support to the financial system if needed and to preserve the smooth transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: But it should be clear that there is no trade-off between price stability and financial stability.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: As we have proven many times, we are able to set the appropriate policy stance to control inflation and at the same time use other instruments to address risks to monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The path ahead
frase: The inflation outlook The first input is our assessment of the inflation outlook in light of the incoming economic and financial data.

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

titolo: The path ahead

frase: Inevitably, we need to navigate between the risk of underreacting – which could prolong the inflationary effects of these shocks – and that of overreacting, which could turn volatility into instability.
