frase: My intention is not to signal any future decisions, but rather to frame the issues that monetary policy will face in the period ahead.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: The inflation shock The euro area economy has faced a series of overlapping inflationary shocks since the end of the pandemic.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: For this reason, unit profits contributed around two-thirds to domestic inflation in 2022, whereas in the previous 20 years their average contribution had been around one-third.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: This in turn led to the shocks feeding into inflation much more quickly and forcefully than in the past.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Largely thanks to lower energy prices, year-on-year producer price inflation has already dropped by 42 percentage points from its peak last summer.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: And while this is taking time to feed through to prices more generally, it is partly being reflected in a broad-based decline in headline inflation and a levelling off in some measures of underlying inflation – especially exclusion-based measures and those that capture the persistent effects of energy on economy-wide prices.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: At the same time, high inflation has eaten into domestic demand, which contracted by 2% over the last two quarters, and the consumption impulse created by excess savings is fading.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: The early effects of our policy tightening are also becoming visible, especially in sectors like manufacturing and construction that are more sensitive to interest rate changes.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: A more persistent inflation process But the second phase of the inflation process is now starting to become stronger.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Workers have so far lost out from the inflation shock, seeing large real wage declines, which is triggering a sustained wage “catch-up” process as they try to recover their losses.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: This is pushing up other measures of underlying inflation that capture more domestic price pressures – particularly measures of wage-sensitive inflation and domestic inflation.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: While this “catch up” has long been factored into our inflation outlook, the effect on inflation from rising wages has recently been amplified by lower productivity growth than we had previously projected, which is leading to higher unit labour costs.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Alongside past upward surprises, this is a key reason why we recently revised up our projections for core inflation, even though our expectations for wages remained broadly the same.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: And in this setting, monetary policy must achieve two key goals.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: First, we must ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored as the wage catch-up process plays out.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: While we do not currently see a wage-price spiral or a de-anchoring of expectations, the longer inflation remains above target, the greater such risks become.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: That means we need to bring inflation back to our 2% medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: If monetary policy is sufficiently restrictive, the economy can achieve disinflation overall while real wages recover some of their losses.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: For instance, if firms were to regain 25% of the lost profit margin that our projections foresee, inflation in 2025 would be substantially higher than the baseline – at almost 3%.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: So, faced with a more persistent inflation process, we need a more persistent policy – one that not only produces sufficient tightening today, but also maintains restrictive conditions until we can be confident that this second phase of the inflation process has been resolved.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: The policy stance What does this imply for our policy in concrete terms?

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: We have not yet seen the full impact of the cumulative rate hikes we have decided on since last July – amounting to 400 basis points.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: And as we move further into restrictive territory, we need to pay close attention to two dimensions of our policy.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: It has stated clearly that “future decisions will ensure that the key ECB interest rates will be brought to levels sufficiently restrictive to achieve a timely return of inflation to our 2% medium-term target and will be kept at those levels for as long as necessary”.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Two sources of uncertainty affect the desired “level” and “length” of our interest rate policies.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: First, since we face uncertainty about the persistence of inflation, the level at which rates peak will be state-contingent.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: This is why our policy needs to be decided meeting by meeting and has to remain data-dependent.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Second, we face uncertainty about the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: The strength of transmission connects current decisions with expectations of future policy and therefore affects the policy stance.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: How strong transmission turns out to be in practice will determine the effect of a given rate hike on inflation, and this will be reflected in the expected policy path.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Uncertainty about transmission arises from the fact that the euro area has not been through a sustained phase of rate hikes since the mid-2000s and has never seen rates rise so quickly.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: And this raises the question of how quickly and forcefully monetary policy will be transmitted to firms – via interest-sensitive spending – and households, via mortgage payments.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: For firms, ECB analysis finds that monetary policy shocks are typically transmitted more quickly and forcefully to manufacturing, reflecting the sector’s higher interest-rate sensitivity, while there is a more muted and delayed impact on services.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: The key question today is whether the services sector will eventually “catch down” – which is what we have seen in previous cycles – or whether it will be insulated from the effects of policy tightening for longer than in the past, given the strength of demand and employment in the sector.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: For households, there is evidence that it will take longer for policy changes to pass through to interest burdens in this tightening cycle, as a higher share of households have fixed-rate mortgages than in the mid-2000s.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: At the same time, once mortgages have been repriced, the restrictive effect may be greater: gross debt-to-income ratios, which emphasise debt servicing capacity, are higher than in previous tightening cycles, while the share of homeowners with a mortgage has increased.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: And that is why we have made our future policy decisions conditional on, first, the inflation outlook, second, the dynamics of underlying inflation and third, the strength of policy transmission.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: But to ensure that uncertainty does not interfere with our intended policy stance – in terms of both “level” and “length” – two points are clear.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: First, we need to bring rates into “sufficiently restrictive” territory to lock in our policy tightening.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: And all the while, we need to carefully evaluate the strength of policy transmission in order to avoid an error in calibrating policy in either direction.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: Monetary policy currently has only one goal: to return inflation to our 2% medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: Breaking the persistence of inflation
frase: We have made significant progress but – faced with a more persistent inflation process – we cannot waver, and we cannot declare victory yet.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Introduction Thank you very much for inviting me here today to give the keynote speech on inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Over the past two years inflation has surged across the globe, with the euro area being no exception.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: My comments today will focus on the current inflationary environment in the euro area and the ECB’s monetary policy response.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: I will start by giving you a brief overview of how we got to where we are today and how we see the outlook for growth and inflation developing over the coming years.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: I will then take a more in-depth look at the main drivers of inflation, focusing on how they have evolved over the course of the pandemic and more recently.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Finally, I will turn to the ECB’s monetary policy response so far.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The outlook for inflation and growth in the euro area At the onset of the current inflation surge, the euro area economy was hit by a succession of extraordinary adverse supply shocks which pushed inflation far above the ECB’s 2% medium-term target.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The COVID-19 lockdowns in 2020 led to the enforced closure of large parts of the economy and a sharp drop in activity levels and inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The decisive monetary and fiscal support measures that were put in place during the early stages of the pandemic protected people’s livelihoods, offered support to households and firms and counteracted the deflationary impact of the pandemic during the second half of 2020 and in the first half of 2021.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The gradual reversal of this shock is supporting economic growth and slowly reducing price pressures.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The euro area economy has broadly stagnated in recent quarters as high prices and tighter financing conditions have weighed on household spending and private investment.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Although still too high, inflation fell from its peak of 10.6% in October last year, initially driven by a drop in energy inflation, to 5.5% in June, according to the Eurostat’s flash estimate.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Inflation excluding energy and food – often referred to as core inflation – has been more persistent.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: At the same time, the ECB’s monetary policy tightening is increasingly feeding through to the real economy while fiscal support is gradually withdrawn.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Inflation is projected to continue to slow as energy prices fall, food inflation moderates and supply bottlenecks ease.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Eurosystem staff now see headline inflation decreasing from 8.4% in 2022 to 5.4% in 2023, 3.0% in 2024 and 2.2% in 2025.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: At the same time, underlying price pressures remain strong.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Staff have revised up their projections for inflation excluding energy and food, owing to past upward surprises and the implications of a robust labour market for the speed of disinflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The anatomy of inflation The drivers of inflation today are very different in type and magnitude from those in play before the pandemic as could be suspected in view of the recent unprecedentedly high inflation rates.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Energy prices have been the most important driver of both the previous surge and the current decline in inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in early 2022 pushed up commodity prices further, leading to an energy inflation rate of 44.3% year on year in March 2022, unprecedented in euro area history.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Food inflation was also affected; it reached a historic high of 15.5% in March of this year.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This set in motion an inflationary impulse which pushed durable goods inflation to historically high levels.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: More recently, goods inflation fell to 5.5% in June from its peak of 6.8% in February 2023.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This reflects the easing of global supply shocks, as well as the impact of our monetary policy tightening on interest-sensitive components of demand, such as durable goods consumption.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Although services inflation eased slightly in May, it has been on an upward trajectory since mid-2021, reaching 5.4% in June.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The persistence in services inflation reflects that some cost pressures and reopening effects are still passing through.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: At the same time, rising wages are adding inflationary pressure to labour-intensive services.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This is particularly true for headline inflation, which has seen significant forecast errors by major professional forecasters, central banks and policy institutions since the start of the pandemic.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Disentangling the “signal” on headline inflation from the “noise” has become increasingly difficult.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Underlying inflation measures have therefore become an important pillar in assessing the inflation outlook and risks.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: These measures aim to capture more persistent price developments (for instance, by excluding more volatile items from headline inflation) to provide a clearer signal for medium-term inflation developments.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: However, a key challenge is that the standard set of measures of underlying inflation continue to be contaminated by past energy shocks, supply disruptions and reopening dynamics.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Since the start of the pandemic, the accuracy of both headline and core inflation projections one or two years ahead has in fact deteriorated significantly.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: It is therefore important to monitor a wide range of indicators of underlying inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: First, while underlying price pressures remain strong, most indicators have started to show some signs of softening.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Second, while still wide by historical standards, the range of measures of underlying inflation recently began to narrow.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This suggests that the unusually high level of uncertainty around the downward trajectory of inflation over the medium term has started to ease somewhat.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As the indirect effects of past energy price shocks and other pipeline price pressures gradually fade, labour costs – an important component of prices in the services sector – are becoming a dominant driver of inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Wage pressures are rising and we have factored strong wage growth into our inflation projections.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Given the crucial role of labour costs in the outlook, we are closely monitoring inflation dynamics in the services sector where these costs play a particularly important role.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy response In response to the extraordinary surge in inflation since 2021, the ECB began to considerably tighten its monetary policy stance in several phases to make sure that inflation returns to our 2% medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In December 2021 we announced that we would start normalising monetary policy by reducing the pace of net asset purchases.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: We decided to end net purchases in the first half of 2022, first under the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) and then under the asset purchase programme (APP).

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In July 2022 we began raising the key ECB interest rates, and we have since raised the deposit facility rate by a cumulative 400 basis points to 3.5%.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Finally, to support the overall monetary policy stance, the Governing Council started to reduce the APP portfolio in March by only partially replacing maturing securities held therein, and reinvestments under the programme were discontinued as of this month.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: We expect the transmission of our monetary policy tightening to operate across the entire yield curve.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The recent increases in policy rates affect the very short-term money market rates directly, while expectations of future policy rate changes lead to rising medium to long-term interest rates.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Due to these higher interest rates, households are expected to save more and consume less, while firms tend to reduce investments.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Together, these effects lead to a cooling in aggregate demand that eventually feeds into lower inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The bulk of the impact of our tightening is expected to materialise only in the course of this year and thereafter.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Model estimates by ECB staff suggest that, owing to the tightening, inflation in 2022 was only half a percentage point lower than it would have otherwise been, while the downward impact is expected to average two percentage points over the period 2023-25.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: These model-based estimates provide a useful benchmark for assessing the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: There may also be important non-linear dynamics – such as risks of inflation expectations becoming de-anchored or risks of financial effects being propagated more forcefully – that are not captured by linear models.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: For these reasons, models must be complemented by real-time monitoring of the transmission of policy to financial variables as well as leading indicators of prices and economic activity.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Given the unprecedented nature of the shocks that are working their way through the economy, as well as the uncertainty around the strength and speed of the impact of past rate hikes on inflation, we will continue to follow a data-dependent approach to determining the appropriate level and duration of restriction.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Our future policy rate decisions will be based on (i) the assessment of the inflation outlook in light of the incoming economic and financial data, (ii) the dynamics of underlying inflation, and (iii) the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Our June projections confirmed that, while inflation has moderated, it is expected to remain above our 2% target for too long.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Although underlying price pressures are moderating, they remain strong and confirm the upward revision to both headline and core inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Nevertheless, the transmission of our unprecedented policy rate hikes so far to tighter financing conditions is well advanced and we are now beginning to see the impact on parts of the real economy.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Conclusion To conclude, a succession of unprecedented shocks over the past three years has pushed inflation far above target in the euro area and around much of the world.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB’s Governing Council has responded by increasing interest rates substantially and has so far raised the policy rates by 400 basis points since July last year – the fastest tightening on record.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Services inflation, and labour costs in particular, need to be closely monitored, as they are now an important driver of overall inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The current high inflation environment requires that monetary and fiscal policy work in the same direction.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As energy prices fall and risks around the energy supply recede, it is important that the energy-related government support measures are rolled back to prevent that these drive up medium-term inflationary pressures.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Our future decisions will ensure that the key ECB interest rates will be brought to levels sufficiently restrictive to achieve a timely return of inflation to our 2% medium-term target and will be kept at those levels for as long as necessary.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: As the shocks reverse and the effects of our past rate increases are gradually transmitted across the real economy, inflation is projected to decline further towards our target.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Nevertheless, the inflation outlook is surrounded by significant uncertainty, and we will continue to follow a data-dependent approach to determining the appropriate level and duration of restriction.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The increase in services inflation mainly reflects the increase in services inflation in Germany, which increased to 6.1% from 4.4% due also to an upward base effect following the temporary introduction of the 9 euro ticket in June 2022.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB monitors several indicators of underlying inflation.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: I will focus in this speech on the banking channel of monetary policy.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Starting in December 2021 with the announcement that net purchases under the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) would end in March 2022, the ECB has been tightening its monetary policy stance in response to the extraordinary surge in inflation amid the pandemic shutdowns, supply bottlenecks and, most importantly, the energy crisis triggered by Russia’s unjustified war against Ukraine.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: For a given inflation outlook, the appropriate level and duration of a restrictive monetary policy stance depends on how powerfully and how quickly the economy responds to the tightening of monetary policy.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In view of the predominant role of the banking system in credit provision in the euro area, how banks respond to monetary policy is a central issue in assessing the strength of the transmission mechanism.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Accordingly, in our data-dependent approach to calibrating monetary policy, assessing the strength of the banking channel of monetary policy tightening is a first-order task for the ECB.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: I will discuss some of the challenges in forming a quantitative assessment of monetary policy transmission via the banking channel.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Second, I will assess how the considerable amount of monetary policy tightening injected over the last year is being transmitted in the euro area.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The bank-based transmission of monetary policy Monetary policy affects investment and consumption decisions by setting the level of market interest rates and thereby steering borrowing costs across all economic sectors: this is the “cost-of-capital” channel.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: When banks pass on changes in the policy rate to their borrowers, the real economy is affected via the investment and production plans of firms, as well as through the decisions of households to financing consumption and real estate.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Since for many firms and households the interest rates that matter most are the lending rates and deposit rates set by banks, the pass-through of policy rates to bank lending and deposit rates is a basic step in monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In addition to the transmission via interest rates, there are amplification mechanisms that work via the cost, the availability, and the quality of credit and that are able to generate relatively large real effects even with relatively small monetary policy changes.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The balance-sheet channel of monetary policy predicts that a policy rate hike tends to compress asset prices and weaken activity, thus lowering the net worth of borrowers.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: This translates into a reduced capacity to raise external funding for firms: the increase in the external finance premium faced by borrowers due to a decline in net worth and pledged collateral decreases spending and investment by more than what is predicted by a short-term policy rate change in a framework abstracting from the balance sheet channel.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The lower value of collateral during a policy tightening therefore triggers higher credit risk and tighter credit conditions for both firms and households.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The bank-lending channel focuses on the impact of policy tightening on the supply of bank loans to the economy.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: First, the supply of loans offered by banks is adversely affected by monetary policy tightening via an increase in bank funding costs.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Second, borrower-lender agency costs further reduce the willingness of banks to lend during periods of higher monetary policy rates or lower economic activity.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Third, bank balance sheet constraints amplify the contraction in credit availability brought about by policy tightening.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Broadly speaking, higher interest rates increase the opportunity cost of holding the most liquid assets – overnight deposits – compared with less liquid assets such as term deposits or securities.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Moreover, the unwinding of asset purchases and long-term refinancing operations currently lead to a direct decline in the liquidity available to banks, limiting their capacity to supply credit.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The third amplification mechanism is the risk-taking channel of monetary policy.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: This is the channel through which banks are incentivised to make riskier investments in an environment of lower interest rates, which reduces incentives to engage in costly monitoring.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In addition, asset purchases programmes extract duration risk from the market, increasing the relative attractiveness of riskier investments and therefore triggering a portfolio rebalancing that ultimately leads to a reallocation towards real investments.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: As such, during the period of highly accommodative monetary policy, this may have led banks to build up a stock of risky investments.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: For instance, following a monetary policy tightening, decreased bank risk tolerance coupled with weaker borrower net worth may affect bank profitability and capital and therefore amplify supply constraints via the bank lending channel.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Strong economic conditions can provide countervailing factors that attenuate the impact of monetary policy, while weak macroeconomic conditions may amplify the strength of monetary policy tightening.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In particular, as aggregate demand falls in response to higher interest rates, banks face both lower demand for loans and a deterioration in borrower credit risk which further weigh on bank balance sheets.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: These additional factors may further strengthen the bank lending channel of monetary policy.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: This brief review of the role of banks in monetary policy transmission has highlighted that the balance sheet channel, the bank lending channel, and the risk-taking channel may be relevant in the transmission of the current hiking cycle.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Next, I will review the incoming evidence on the strength of monetary policy transmission via the banking system during the current tightening cycle.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Measuring the banking channel of monetary policy tightening I now turn to an assessment of the incoming information on how the banking channel is operating during the current tightening cycle in the euro area.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In June 2022, the ECB announced that it would start to increase its policy rates from July onwards.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: However, it had already started unwinding its highly accommodative monetary policy stance in December 2021, by announcing a step-by-step reduction in the pace of net asset purchases, which pushed up yields of longer-dated assets from early 2022 onwards.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Against the backdrop of the tightening of monetary policy, the pass-through to bank funding costs has proceeded rapidly, most notably for yields on bank bonds (Chart 1).

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Deposit rates contained the rise in the interest rate expenses of banks during the initial phase of the tightening cycle.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: This initial sluggishness was in part driven by an atypical configuration of interest rates during the negative rates period, in which many banks kept deposit rates higher than the policy rate (Chart 2, right panel).

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: After this initial period, interest rates on term deposits have followed the policy rate, while the remuneration of overnight deposits has remained lower.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Overall, these patterns were also seen in past periods of positive interest rates (Chart 2, left panel).

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The limited increase in overnight deposit rates has incentivised depositors to rebalance their portfolios towards time deposits, after the prolonged period of low interest rates and low term premia in which the opportunity cost of holding overnight deposit had been negligible.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The ECB policy rate is the MRO up to May 2014 and the DFR thereafter.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The latest observations are June 2023 for policy rates and May 2023 for deposit rates.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In addition to the increases in the key policy interest rates, the gradual unwinding of the asset purchase programme (APP) and the phase-out of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III) have also played a role in the transmission of monetary policy through banks.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: In February this year, we moved to partial reinvestments under the APP before fully ending reinvestments in July.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The resulting increase in long-term interest rates pushes up the pricing of bank loans, ultimately increasing lending rates for firms and households.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The phase out of TLTRO III has led banks to partially substitute TLTRO loans with more expensive sources of funding.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: While a large share of the voluntary early repayments at the end of last year and early this year was financed out of outstanding excess liquidity, banks have been more recently raising alternative funding to cover maturing TLTRO loans, in particular in light of the large amount which matured in June.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: The need to replace TLTRO funding requires the issuance of more costly bonds and leads to greater competition in deposit markets to attract funding.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Furthermore, the recalibration of TLTRO in October 2022 increased the cost of TLTRO borrowing, and restored incentives for voluntary early repayments.

titolo: The banking channel of monetary policy tightening in the euro area
frase: Moreover, the winding down of both the TLTROs and the asset purchases has contributed to a rapid reduction in the central bank excess liquidity available to banks.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: It is my pleasure to welcome you all to the 2023 ECB Conference on Monetary Policy.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: Where central banks in advanced economies once wrestled with overcoming the lower bound on interest rates, they have more recently been engaging in the fastest hiking cycle on record.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: The first topic is how the transition from the low inflation regime, which prevailed before the pandemic, to the high inflation rates we are seeing today affected the pass-through of shocks.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: In particular, we will see evidence that the propagation of adverse supply shocks is non-linear: when inflation is high, the propagation is stronger.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: With such a rapid shift in the inflation outlook, there has been an equally rapid shift in the stance of monetary policy.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: For example, we will hear about the challenges for financial stability and how unwinding unconventional measures can affect the control of short-term interest rates – a theme that is relevant for the ongoing review of the ECB’s operational framework.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: This rapid shift in the policy stance is also providing us with new insights into the third topic covered by the conference: the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: And this has injected considerable uncertainty into the current tightening cycle.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: We will hear about how the heterogeneous structure of the housing market in the euro area can lead to the asymmetric transmission of policy across countries.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: And that strong recovery – and the resulting rise in inflation – has been accompanied by global monetary policy tightening, unprecedented in its synchronisation.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: Douglas Diamond will talk to us about interest rate risk, financial crises and bank supervision – a relationship that policymakers everywhere have become more alert to in light of the recent episodes of banking turmoil in the United States and Switzerland.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: And Peter Diamond will discuss the labour market and monetary policy, which is perhaps the greatest puzzle facing monetary policymakers across advanced economies today.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: Specifically, we have made our future decisions contingent on three criteria: the inflation outlook, the dynamics of underlying inflation and the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: This framework has helped us chart a tightening path that began steeply and then slowed to a more normal pace.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: Now, based on our current assessment, we consider that the key ECB interest rates have reached levels that, maintained for a sufficiently long duration, will make a substantial contribution to the timely return of inflation to our medium-term target.

titolo: Welcome address
frase: Our future decisions will continue to be based on these three criteria and they will ensure that the interest rates will be set at sufficiently restrictive levels for as long as necessary.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Introduction I will start by giving you an overview of the economic outlook for the euro area before going on to look at how the ECB has adjusted its monetary policy to this outlook.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: I will then discuss in more detail the transmission of our monetary policy in the current environment and the sources of uncertainty that appear particularly relevant at this stage.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The outlook for inflation and growth in the euro area Economic activity broadly stagnated over the first half of the year and is likely to remain subdued in the coming months.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Weaker foreign demand and tight financing conditions are dampening growth, especially in the manufacturing sector.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In September ECB staff revised down projected GDP growth, particularly for this year and next, due to a greater contractionary effect from tightening financing conditions and the weakening international trade environment.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Beyond the near term, ECB staff expect growth to recover owing to higher real disposable income thanks to rising wages and falling inflation, which is set to underpin spending.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Inflation fell markedly from its double-digit peak last October, with the headline rate having declined to 4.3% in September (flash estimate).

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area

frase: This is on account of tighter financing conditions – which also reflect the restrictive impact of our monetary policy tightening – and a weaker economic outlook.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy response In summary, while inflation continues to decline, it is still expected to remain too high for too long.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The ECB is determined to ensure that inflation returns to our 2% medium-term target in a timely manner.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In order to reinforce progress towards this target, we decided to raise the three key ECB interest rates by 25 basis points at the September meeting of the Governing Council.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: This decision was informed by the three legs of our reaction function: first, the inflation outlook in light of the incoming economic and financial data; second, the dynamics of underlying inflation; and third, the strength of monetary policy transmission.

frase: Having raised interest rates by a total of 450 basis points since July 2022, we consider that the key ECB interest rates have now reached levels that, maintained for a sufficiently long duration, will make a substantial contribution to the timely return of inflation to our target.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Our reaction function will continue to serve as the framework for future decisions, and we will continue to follow a data-dependent approach to determining the appropriate level and duration of a restrictive monetary policy stance.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Uncertainty regarding the transmission of monetary policy As part of this data-dependent approach, we continually assess how monetary policy is transmitted to financing conditions, the real economy and, ultimately, to inflation.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: In the current hiking cycle, the first leg of monetary policy transmission – to financing conditions – has been very strong.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: Moreover, interest rates on outstanding debt will continue to increase as loans are progressively repriced.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: All in all, in my view, the transmission of our policy tightening to financing conditions seems to be well underway.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The second leg of transmission relates to the way in which changes in financing conditions will affect economic activity, as firms and households adjust their plans for consumption, investment and savings accordingly.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: The transmission of monetary policy tightening to the real economy is proceeding at a slower pace, with a substantial share of the transmission still in the pipeline.

titolo: The inflation outlook and monetary policy in the euro area
frase: For the economy as a whole, model-based estimates continue to suggest that, owing to the typical lags in monetary transmission, the bulk of the impact of our tightening is expected to materialise only in the course of this year and thereafter.

frase: Conclusion To conclude, while we can be sure that our monetary policy tightening is transmitted forcefully to financial markets and is increasingly leaving a footprint in the real economy, the speed and scope of the transmission remain uncertain.

frase: This is partly due to the still-fluid economic environment in which we are navigating, with the outlook for inflation and economic activity being rendered particularly uncertain owing to both the legacy effects of previous shocks and renewed risks.

titolo: The last mile
frase: They arise from the statistical observation that, after a large price shock, inflation usually slows measurably once the unusually large monthly price increases of the previous year start to drop out of annual inflation rates.

titolo: The last mile
frase: They are usually limited to highly volatile prices of commodities that are traded in international markets and for which the pass-through to final consumer prices is typically large and, in many cases, imminent, running directly through the energy component of the Harmonised Consumer Price Index (HICP).

titolo: The last mile
frase: Following large commodity shocks, an initial rapid decline in headline inflation is therefore the norm rather than the exception.

titolo: The last mile
frase: That is, when inflation starts falling, it is tempting to conclude that it has been fought off successfully and that it is a matter of when, and not if, inflation will fall back to target.

titolo: The last mile
frase: However, in about 90% of unresolved inflation episodes, inflation declined materially within the first three years after the initial shock, but then either plateaued at an elevated level or accelerated again.

titolo: The last mile
frase: They often turn from being a source of disinflation to becoming a renewed headwind, as they operate in both directions.

titolo: The last mile
frase: They swing like a pendulum, meaning that disinflation is not necessarily a smooth process but can be a rather bumpy road.

titolo: The last mile

titolo: The last mile

titolo: The last mile

titolo: The last mile

titolo: The last mile

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In particular, the creation of central bank reserves on the liability side of the central bank balance sheet is typically matched by an increase in collateralised loans (refinancing operations) to banks or an increase in asset purchases on the asset side.

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: Refinancing operations (including targeted versions that require banks to meet a credit growth or credit composition target to benefit from favourable funding conditions) and asset purchases have direct macroeconomic effects that have been much studied, while the macroeconomic impact of the liability side of these interventions has received comparatively less attention.

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: Over the last decade, much of the expansion in central bank reserves in the euro area has been a by-product of quantitative easing (large-scale asset purchases) or targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTROs).

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In line with the ECB’s 2021 monetary policy strategy statement, from a stance perspective, the activation of such policies is only relevant in the neighbourhood of the effective lower bound (ELB) on policy rates.

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: Away from the ELB, by contrast, the short-term policy rate is the primary instrument to steer the monetary policy stance.

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: Initiated in March 2020, the pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP) was a hybrid of a market-stabilisation programme and a quantitative-easing programme.

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: The ECB’s monetary policy strategy statement recognised that financial stability is a precondition for price stability and that the pervasive role of macro-financial linkages in economic, monetary and financial developments requires that monetary policy decisions, including the evaluation of the proportionality of these decisions and potential side effects, are based on an integrated assessment of all relevant factors.

titolo: Central bank liquidity: a macroeconomic perspective
frase: In addition to the role of central bank reserves under non-standard conditions (whether proximity to the ELB and/or stressed circumstances), it is also important to assess the possible macroeconomic impact of the structural level of central bank reserves in the new steady state that will emerge after the roll back of QE-inspired asset purchase programmes and the expiry of the TLTRO programme.

frase: We see that all of these metrics increased substantially when the ECB implemented its quantitative easing and targeted lending programmes but have eased noticeably from their peaks over the last year (the stock of central bank reserves peaked at EUR 4.92 trillions in November 2022).

frase: As I set out in the introduction, it is difficult to identify separately the role of central bank reserves and the impact of asset-side monetary policy measures (quantitative easing, targeted lending).

frase: In relation to credit creation, increased holdings of central bank reserves on a durable basis provided banks with increased comfort in their liquidity positions and provided incentives to increase their lending rather than sitting on an excessive amount of cash at the negative short-term interest rates that prevailed during the period 2014-2022.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Over the past two years, we have seen a measurable and persistent rise in real interest rates across many advanced economies, partly reversing the secular decline that started in the early 1980s.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This increase in real rates has reignited the debate among academics and policymakers about the level of the natural rate of interest, or r*, the real short-term interest rate that would prevail if the economy was operating at its potential and inflation was at target.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The question is whether the recent reversal is a sign that real interest rates will remain higher once the impact of recent shocks has faded, or whether they will return to the lows seen in the pre-pandemic era.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In my remarks today, I will discuss two hypotheses that can help explain the fall and rise in real interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The savings-investment hypothesis argues that structural determinants of global saving and investment are the ultimate drivers of the natural rate of interest, and hence real long-term rates, which are anchored around r*.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The monetary policy hypothesis argues that monetary policy may have played a role in the persistent downward trend and subsequent rise in real interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Since r* is a theoretical construct that is unobservable, and the economy’s long-run evolution is surrounded by considerable uncertainty, financial markets often look to the central bank for informing and coordinating their views about real long-term interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: By providing long-run guidance, the central bank may influence long-term interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The implications of these two hypotheses for the role of monetary policy are quite different.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: While in the first case, monetary policy merely responds to global structural changes, in the second, it may have long-lasting effects on economic activity.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The fall and rise in real interest rates In the decades following the inflation spikes of the 1970s and early 1980s, we have observed a gradual and persistent decline in real short- and long-term risk-free interest rates globally (Slide 2).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This rise has not just been driven by an increase in spot short-term rates due to the highly synchronised global monetary policy response to the inflation surge.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: It also reflects a reassessment by market participants of the expected level of real short-term interest rates prevailing in the future.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: For example, respondents to the Survey of Monetary Analysts (SMA) expect the ECB’s deposit facility rate (DFR) to level off in a range between 2% and 2.5% over the long run (Slide 4, left-hand side).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Given an expected inflation rate of 2% over the same horizon, this would correspond to an r* of 0% to 0.5%.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: These estimates are around one percentage point higher than before the start of the monetary policy tightening cycle in December 2021, when median survey expectations and model estimates of real short-term rates were in negative territory.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Within a standard macroeconomic framework, changes in equilibrium real interest rates are determined by structural shifts in savings and investments.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: An increase in desired investment, for a given level of desired savings, puts upward pressure on real interest rates (Slide 6, left-hand side).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In a world with free capital flows, real interest rates are determined globally, in line with the remarkable co-movement across major advanced economies.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Over the long run and without any frictions in financial markets that prevent capital from moving freely across borders, there exists a single equilibrium interest rate that clears the global capital market.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: To see this, it is useful to think about the natural rate as having two components: a very slow-moving long-run component and a more cyclical component that can drive the natural rate away from its long-run trend over a protracted period.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This is consistent with recent evidence suggesting that real interest rates have oscillated around a persistent downward trend since the start of the Renaissance in the 14th century (Slide 7).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Temporary but protracted reversals in the interest rate regime happened at times of major and persistent structural shocks, such as the Black Death in the 1350s or extended periods of war.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: As such, an ageing global population and continued subdued productivity growth may remain a drag on real interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The monetary policy hypothesis The second key explanation of the trends of real interest rates suggests that monetary policy itself may play an important role for real long-term interest rates.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This hypothesis starts from the observation that, despite its theoretical appeal, there has been little evidence of a stable relationship between real interest rates and standard proxies of the key determinants of savings and investment across subsamples over the past 150 years.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Some key factors, such as demographics or productivity, have the expected relationship with real interest rates in some subsamples but not in others (Slide 11).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The view that monetary policy may help explain these deviations, at least temporarily, is not new.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Over the past two decades the literature has studied extensively whether and how monetary policy can have long-lasting effects on real interest rates, going in different directions.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: On the one hand, overly tight monetary policy may lower investment and technological growth.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: On the other hand, persistently expansionary monetary policy may lead to the build-up of financial imbalances and contribute to zombification, reducing potential growth.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: However, the most recent literature has added an interesting twist to the debate, arguing that the most important channel of monetary policy relates to central bank communication.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Recent research documents that the descent in US real long-term yields over the past decades can be explained by very narrow time windows around the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy meetings (Slide 12).

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Outside these time windows, changes to real long-term interest rates have been short-lived.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: According to this study, long-run forward guidance, as expressed by the dot plots, appears to have lowered real bond yields by around 130 basis points over the last decade.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: It shows that a 100 basis point US monetary policy shock has historically been associated with a 30 basis points increase in r* over the long run.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: As monetary policy is thought to be neutral over the long run, these findings are puzzling.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In any case, these studies suggest that the recent rise in real long-term rates may be partly due to financial market participants interpreting the policy tightening, as well as recent central bank communication, as a shift in policymakers’ beliefs about the level of r*.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In other words, the impact of monetary policy actions and communication may be stronger than conventionally assumed.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This would also imply that central banks have little to learn about the natural rate of interest from looking at market pricing, as we may just be looking in the mirror.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: For example, easing monetary policy could be seen as signaling a lower r*, inducing firms and households to become less optimistic about the economy.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: This could negatively affect output and inflation insofar as it influences spending decisions.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The central bank may then cut rates even further, validating private sector beliefs and weakening the expansionary effects of the policy rate easing.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: In this interpretation, the inability of central banks in the pre-pandemic period to bring inflation back to target may partly have been due to self-reinforcing dynamics.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: If monetary policy easing during that period was interpreted as containing adverse information about the long-run state of the economy, the contractionary effects of the resulting feedback loops may have contributed to persistent declines in r*.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Conclusion To conclude, protracted reversals in real interest rates have occurred repeatedly in history in the aftermath of large economic, political or social shocks.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: The exceptional investment needs arising from structural challenges related to the climate transition, the digital transformation and geopolitical shifts may have a persistent positive impact on the natural rate of interest.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: Whether the anticipation of these investment needs has directly been driving real rates higher in recent years, or whether monetary policy has been a catalyst for the repricing, remains subject to discussion.

titolo: R(ising) star?
frase: It is possible, however, that the determined monetary policy response to the inflation burst may have shifted market participants’ beliefs about r*, thereby making a return of secular stagnation less likely.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Since the early 1990s, many central banks worldwide have adopted a framework for monetary policy known as “inflation targeting”.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: In this framework, central banks announce a target rate or range for medium-term inflation, typically 2%, and adjust short-term interest rates to steer actual inflation towards the target.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: The rise of inflation targeting was a response to the turbulent inflation episodes of the 1970s and 1980s when most central banks were only loosely committed to price stability.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Inflation targeting was an acknowledgement that monetary policy was most effective when it was given a clear mandate.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Inflation targeting went hand-in-hand with a discernible increase in central bank independence and transparency.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Central banks operating outside the influence of political election cycles played a critical role in making inflation targeting credible and feasible.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Greater transparency was also needed to operationalise inflation targeting.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: The reason is that, given the lags in monetary policy transmission, central banks can only affect future inflation.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: As such, inflation targeting has typically been formulated in terms of inflation forecast targeting where the central bank adjusts policy to offset deviations of its projection of medium-term inflation from the target.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Inflation forecast targeting requires the central bank to provide a coherent narrative to the public that links its current decisions to the way it expects economic activity and inflation to evolve over the policy-relevant horizon, typically over the next two to three years.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Inflation forecast targeting has been implemented differently across the central banking community.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Norges Bank and Sveriges Riksbank, for example, publish inflation forecasts that are conditional on a policy rate path consistent with delivering inflation in line with the target over the policy-relevant horizon.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Similarly, the US Federal Reserve System provides policy rate forecasts through its Summary of Economic Projections.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: While these interest rate paths do not constitute a formal commitment on the part of policymakers, they do provide forward guidance, which potentially raises the ability of central banks to manage interest rate and inflation expectations.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: Other central banks, including the ECB and the Bank of England, publish inflation projections based on financial market participants’ expected path for short-term interest rates.

titolo: The future of inflation (forecast) targeting
frase: In this case, the public typically expects policy to deviate from the market-implied path if the medium-term inflation forecast is inconsistent with the target.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: This was an especially striking tightening campaign in view of the prevailing highly-accommodative monetary stance, which consisted of very low levels of the policy rate that had been in place over the last decade, the considerable net asset purchasing under the APP since 2015 and under the PEPP since 2020 and the scale and pricing of the targeted long-term refinancing operations.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The tightening cycle had two basic aims.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

frase: Second, the descent of inflation from its peak would be assisted by the reversal of some of the factors driving the inflation surge: the easing of supply bottlenecks; the likely expansion of energy supply and contraction in energy demand in response to the spectacular increases in oil and gas prices; and the gradual re-normalisation of the economy through the fading out of pandemic-related distortions in sectoral supply and demand patterns.

frase: That is, the calibration of monetary policy should take account the temporary nature of some of the shocks, while making sure that these temporary shocks would not convert into permanent inflation through the de-anchoring of inflation expectations.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Along one dimension, there was uncertainty about the intrinsic persistence of the inflation process.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In addition to the standard uncertainty about the feedback dynamics by which price increases in one period would trigger subsequent price and wage increases in following periods, the scale of inflation during 2022 also led to shifts in behaviour, with firms switching to more frequent pricing resets.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: While this added to the intensity of inflation, it also held out the possibility that the overall adjustment process could be front-loaded.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Ultimately, the persistence of inflation would turn on the scale of de-anchoring of inflation expectations, which warranted close monitoring.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Along a second dimension, there was uncertainty about the strength of transmission of monetary policy in view of possible shifts in the economic, financial and monetary environment.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: First and foremost, the many years of low inflation and the strategic commitment by central banks to deliver the inflation target over the medium term provided a strong foundation for containing the inflation shock, compared to the costly de-anchoring dynamics observed in the 1970s.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Furthermore, monetary tightening could be taking hold at the same time as a projected rebound in economic activity might protect employment levels, with firms holding onto workers in anticipation of post-pandemic normalisation.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Along a third dimension, the nature of the monetary configuration also created uncertainty about the tightening process.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: After many years of expanding the central bank balance sheet (which had further accelerated during the pandemic), the required shift in the monetary stance called for an exit from net asset purchases and a pull back from the longer-term refinancing operations that had pumped liquidity into the banking system, in addition to the lifting of the policy rate.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In addition, since both balance sheet normalisation and the lifting of policy rates were simultaneously proceeding at a global level, there was also uncertainty about the strength of international spillovers in the tightening process.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: A final uncertainty dimension related to the modelling of monetary policy.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The projected impact of shifts in monetary policy varies across these models, in line with differences in the specification of the economic and financial environment and, crucially, in the sensitivity of inflation expectations to policy actions.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Taken together, these various types of uncertainty underlined the importance of taking a data-dependent approach to the calibration of monetary policy that would take into account the evolving inflation outlook, the realised path for underlying inflation indicators and the incoming evidence on the strength of monetary policy transmission.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: I will now provide an analytical review of the transmission of monetary policy tightening to: the financial and banking systems; the economy; and, finally, inflation.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: I will also briefly draw some lessons from the tightening period for the conduct of monetary policy during the next phase of the cycle.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Transmission to financial markets and the banking sector Our policy rate hikes and the phasing out of asset purchases have been passed smoothly to money markets, risk-free rates, risk assets and lending rates by banks.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Transmission via market interest rates The money market is the immediate locus in the transmission of monetary policy.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Our key ECB interest rates have a direct impact on the rates prevailing in that market, while our balance sheet policies also play an important role.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The transmission of the steep increase in our policy rates to unsecured money market rates has been smooth and complete.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: This is essential for a proper transmission as the euro short-term rate (€STR) and expectations about its future path form the basis of the entire euro area risk-free rate curve: the overnight index swap (OIS) rates.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: As we returned to our policy rates as the primary instruments for steering the monetary policy stance in 2022, the understanding in the market of how we decide the key ECB interest rates has become pivotal again.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: This understanding contributes to the formation of expectations of market participants about the future path of interest rates and thereby has an immediate impact on medium- to longer-term interest rates, which are particularly consequential for the economy.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: ECB staff analysis of euro area risk-free rates and inflation-linked swap (ILS) rates suggests that financial markets have rapidly internalised the ECB’s pattern of reaction to changes in the inflation outlook.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: As a result, the gradual upward shift of the €STR forward curve throughout the tightening cycle (Chart 1) was more than proportional to the upward shift in market-based measures of inflation compensation (Chart 2), bringing real interest rates in the euro area from deeply negative to firmly positive levels.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: When annual HICP inflation stood at 5 per cent in December 2021, markets were still pricing in a steady return of inflation to 2 per cent by the end of 2022.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The repeated upward surprises in inflation thereafter caused an upward repricing of risk-free rates and of measures of inflation compensation, yet without signs that markets were misrepresenting our reaction function or that they were expecting inflation to stay permanently high.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In fact, the inflation path priced into measures of inflation compensation and ECB staff analysis that seeks to extract the genuine inflation expectations component indicate that longer-term inflation expectations have remained well anchored close to 2 per cent throughout this episode.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: The continued anchoring of inflation expectations also helps explain another pattern in euro risk-free rates that has caused concerns among some observers: the slope of the risk-free curve – as measured by the difference between the OIS-ILS spread at a ten-year compared to two-year maturity – has been negative for over a year now and even stood at -0.8 in June 2023, a record-low level since the launch of the euro (Chart 3).

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: At the current juncture, the negative slope of the yield curve points to an assessment by markets which is directionally in line with ours: short-term interest rates stand at high and firmly restrictive levels but medium to longer-term rates are lower, as inflation and with it our policy rates are set to decline over time.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In other words, the current inversion of the yield curve indicates expectations of an eventual normalisation of inflation towards 2 per cent and of interest rates towards more neutral levels.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Longer-term risk-free rates increased in the euro area not only on account of higher expected policy rates, but also due to other measures taken by us and central banks globally.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: In particular, the phasing out of asset purchases has had an additional tightening effect via the decompression of term premia.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Since December 2021, more than one third of the 280 basis point increase in the ten-year euro area OIS rate is estimated by our staff to result from an increase in term premia stemming from quantitative tightening and other factors.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Transmission via the banking sector The transmission of the restrictive monetary policy stance to bank lending conditions has evolved over the course of the tightening cycle.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle

frase: One contributor to the asymmetry in the response of returns on different segments of bank funding to monetary policy was that banks had been reluctant to pass on negative interest rates to their retail depositors during the highly accommodative phase, driving a negative spread between the remuneration of customer deposits and the interest banks were receiving on reserves.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Over the period since September 2023 in which we have held our policy rates constant, bank bond yields have declined somewhat, in part reflecting the anticipation of future rate cuts, while deposit rates have continued to increase, as competition for deposits intensifies and depositors shift funds from lower remuneration overnight deposits towards more attractive time deposits.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Transmission to the economy The restrictive policy stance has also been feeding through to economic activity.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Our restrictive policy stance has transmitted at different speeds to different parts of the economy.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
frase: Estimates suggest that the peak impact of our policy tightening on activity levels is larger for manufacturing than for services, with the peak impact occurring in the fourth quarter of 2023, and larger for business and housing investment than for private consumption, with the transmission to business investment strengthening further in the first quarter of 2024 (Chart 21).

frase: As the structure of the euro area economy evolves, such sectoral heterogeneity in monetary policy transmission may also alter the impact on aggregate economic activity.

titolo: The analytics of the monetary policy tightening cycle
